note: Collision petition (Law 39): 'cepstrum' is proposed for 'cepstrum' (the quefrency-domain representation of a signal's spectral structure) against existing holder 'cepstrum'. Claimed distinction: The cepstrum operates in quefrency (time-like) domain, not frequency domain. Existing entries like spectral-analysis (if it exists) or spectral-flattening operate in the frequency domain or manipulate spectral magnitudes directly. The cepstrum's distinct output — peaks at quefrencies corresponding to spectral periodicity — cannot be obtained from any existing entry without performing the full transform sequence. One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.

Collision petition (Law 39): 'spectralrolloff' is proposed for 'spectral-roll-off' (Frequency threshold at which a cumulative percentage (default 85%) of total spectral energy is reached, used for timbral characterization) against existing holder 'spectral-rolloff'. Claimed distinction: The existing holder is a statistical moment measure (mean frequency weighted by magnitude spectrum); this filing is a cumulative energy percentile threshold (the frequency at which 85% of total energy is contained) One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.

Collision petition (Law 39): 'lexeme' is proposed for 'lexeme' (Lexeme as the abstract lexical unit in the mental lexicon, distinct from surface word forms.) against existing holder 'lexeme'. Claimed distinction: Distinguished from word (a surface form with phonological realization and syntactic behavior) by being abstract and identity-invariant across inflectional variants. Distinguished from morpheme (the minimal meaningful unit that can be further divided phonologically) by carrying semantic identity that unifies all its surface realizations. One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.

Collision petition (Law 39): 'filterbank' is proposed for 'filterbank' (A bank of bandpass filters arranged to decompose an input signal into multiple frequency sub-bands, with each filter passing a distinct frequency range.) against existing holder 'filter-bank'. Claimed distinction: The existing filter entry covers the generic mechanical device for separating particles by size. A signal processing filterbank decomposes a continuous or digital signal into frequency sub-bands via mathematical transforms — it operates on signals, not matter, and uses interrelated bandpass filters rather than a single separation element. One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.

Collision petition (Law 39): 'glottogram' is proposed for 'glottal-flow' (The common clinical name for the per-frame estimated glottal-flow waveform g(n) obtained by inverse filtering of the speech signal.) against existing holder 'glottogram'. Claimed distinction: Holds against the provisional glottogram entry (e67fc7c1b0277f15810c5d149), which is a duplicate of this entry: the accepted glottal-flow definition explicitly names the construct 'The glottal-flow waveform (glottal flow glottogram)' and carves exactly the proposed glottogram's per-frame g(n) with the same three parameters. Once the duplicate entry is struck the word is free and the label binds it here; while the duplicate stands the label and the collision follow one verdict. One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.

Collision petition (Law 39): 'shorttimefouriertransform' is proposed for 'stft' (Short-Time Fourier Transform is the abbreviation STFT used for the same time-frequency analysis technique as the full name; the entry stft already carves the procedure, the full name is a synonym.) against existing holder 'short-time-fourier-transform'. Claimed distinction: The short-time-fourier-transform entry is a duplicate carving of the identical procedure already held under stft; no distinct construct exists, the name is an acronym-vs-full-name collision. One filing, one verdict; this edge follows it.

Spectral-slope fits a line to the magnitude spectrum via least-squares regression. It requires per-bin magnitude values — spectral-distribution — as the regression data points. Remove the per-bin vector and the slope regression has no data. Removal test passes.

Pinned sense: gammatone-filter serving music information retrieval. Gammatone-filter models human auditory frequency selectivity and is used in MIR for perceptual audio analysis — timbre classification, instrument recognition, and auditory-based feature extraction. It serves MIR by providing a biologically-plausible analysis transform that aligns with human auditory perception of music.

The accepted definition of tempo-estimation computes an autocorrelation (or beat-spectrum) over candidate BPM lags to find the peak matching the inferred tempo. Removing autocorrelation stops the primary computational mechanism for tempo estimation. This is a genuine structural dependency under Law 8b.

Law 8b removal test, kind level: per-bin-energy-vector (pending definition) is the ordered tuple v=(|A_1|²,...,|A_N|²) of bin energies, parameterized by the spectral decomposition and a bin range. Remove the spectral representation now and there is no bin grid and no amplitudes A_i from which to assemble the tuple — the construct stops operating. Not identity (the stored operand is not the encoding procedure), not purpose, not chronology. Completes the anchor family: both accepted sibling carves already hold the same anchor — spectral-band-distribution (accepted) and spectral-distribution (pending) — and the kind they generalize must anchor the same way.

Cepstral mean normalization (CMN) removes channel-induced spectral distortions in speech processing front-ends, a standard preprocessing step for speech recognition and enhancement. It serves speech-processing by stabilizing cepstral features across channels and speakers, enabling robust downstream processing.

CONSTITUTIVE: chroma-filterbank definition specifies its 12 pitch-class center frequencies are derived from the equal-tempered scale at 440 Hz reference. The mel-scale perceptual frequency mapping determines the bin center frequencies and spacing. Without mel-scale, the chroma-filterbank has no basis for its perceptual frequency warping — the transformation matrix structure is defined by mel-scale center frequencies.

CONTAINS is part-whole (Law 10). Pinned sense: neurolinguistics as a research area within the discipline — its accepted definition carves it as a field of the study of neural and biological mechanisms underlying language, one of the areas in which the discipline operates. It complements the accepted neurolinguistics INSTANCE_OF linguistics (nearest kind) exactly as the accepted pairs do for every other subfield: morphology, pragmatics, phonology, phonetics, syntax, semantics, lexicography, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics are each both INSTANCE_OF linguistics and CONTAINED by it. A subfield is a part of the discipline and a member of its kind; both edges stand, as the court has accepted eleven times.

Kurtosis computes the normalized fourth central moment of the per-bin energy distribution. It operates on the vector of per-bin values — the mean, variance, and fourth moments all require the individual bin values, not just the total energy.

The accepted definition names the quantity as an operational input: stage (2) computes the power spectrum via FFT and stage (3) passes that spectrum through the triangular Mel-scale filterbank. Remove the power spectrum and the filterbank stage has no band energies to take the logarithm of — the pipeline cannot operate as defined. A produced intermediate the defined operation acts on, not a revealed property. Same accepted shape as the sibling quantity edge mfcc DEPENDS_ON power-spectral-density (ACCEPTED); the board accepts parallel quantity edges from one source (cf. mel-spectrogram DEPENDS_ON spectrum, DEPENDS_ON magnitude-spectrum, DEPENDS_ON power-spectrum all ACCEPTED). Present-tense operation (Law 8), not identity or purpose.

The autocorrelation method is the canonical LPC formulation. LPC coefficients are derived by solving the Yule-Walker equations where the autocorrelation matrix and vector of the signal are the defining inputs. Remove autocorrelation and the standard autocorrelation method for computing LPC parameters loses its defining mathematical input.

Griffin-Lim iteratively estimates phase from magnitude spectrogram to reconstruct time-domain signal. Remove phase-retrieval capability and Griffin-Lim cannot operate; the algorithm's core loop is phase retrieval. Operational dependency.

Spectral-band-slope = the regression slope of per-bin energy values over their frequency coordinates within the band. It is computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution: the per-bin energy vector and the associated frequency indices form the data on which the linear regression operates. The distribution concept came first and the slope measure derives from applying the distribution framework to characterize the band's energy trend.

Instantaneous-amplitude as magnitude of analytic signal contains analytic-signal as its constituent. Pinned sense: amplitude = |z(t)| where z is analytic signal. Removal of analytic-signal removes the object whose magnitude is taken.

Spectral envelope extraction requires FFT, smoothing, and peak detection — core signal processing primitives. Remove signal processing and spectral envelope has no extraction mechanism. Law 8b removal test passes.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: electroglottography's definition requires AC current at ~2.5 kHz, demodulation producing a continuous EGG waveform, and impedance-based contact area estimation. All of these require signal processing techniques (bandpass filtering, demodulation, impedance measurement). Remove signal-processing and the EGG technique cannot operate. The definition explicitly mentions clinical laryngology toolkits that implement these signal processing methods.

Variance computes the mean squared deviation of per-bin values from their mean. Without the per-bin distribution, there are no individual values to compute deviations from. The scalar energy is not a distribution and cannot be decomposed.

Spectral-band-band-center (geometric mean center frequency) serves timbre perception by indicating where energy concentrates within a frequency band. It complements spectral-band-centroid (arithmetic mean) — when distributions are right-skewed, the geometric center is lower than the arithmetic centroid, revealing a different aspect of timbral balance.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): phonetics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. The accepted phonetics definition carves it as a human-made discipline of linguistics studying the physical properties of speech sounds. Sibling precedent: linguistics CONTAINS phonology, syntax, morphology, semantics, pragmatics all accepted in this turn. Phonetics is the classical sibling discipline of phonology.

The DCT is computed from the DFT: DCT coefficients can be obtained by rearranging DFT coefficients of a real-valued input (the standard Cooley-Tukey DFT algorithm for real inputs). Removing the DFT from the computational framework would stop DCT from operating as defined. The removal test passes: DCT operates by exploiting the structural relationship between DFT and real-input symmetry.

Law 9 nearest accepted kind: temporal-centroid is the first-moment (weighted mean time) descriptor of the energy envelope — a time-domain descriptor per the temporal-feature carve, named in the category's own proposed definition as a canonical instance. It holds INSTANCE_OF audio-feature (broader) and measurement; temporal-feature is the nearest accepted domain category. No leap: no accepted kind sits between temporal-centroid and the temporal-feature category.

Cepstrum is defined as the IFFT of the log-magnitude spectrum. Removing log-magnitude-spectrum as a concept stops the cepstrum from having its defining mathematical operation — the cepstrum IS the IFFT of that specific signal.

Spectral peaks are local maxima in the magnitude spectrum across all frequency bins of the full spectrum. The peaks are identified over the full per-bin vector (spectral-distribution). Remove that vector and peak detection is undefined.

spectral-band-spread quantifies the dispersion of spectral energy across frequency bins within a defined sub-band — the standard deviation of bin frequencies about the band's centroid. It is a specific type of spectral feature, a numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's spectral representation that captures a measurable aspect of its frequency-domain structure.

SERVES beneficiary: electroglottogram is the demodulated envelope of EGG voltage, a time series of glottal contact used in clinical laryngology. Its primary application is speech and voice analysis — extracting voice-quality parameters (contact quotient, open quotient, asymmetry) for speech disorder assessment and speech processing pipelines.

Contact-quotient is defined as contact-phase/T0 where contact-phase is extracted from electroglottographic or glottal-flow signal. The definition lists electroglottographic/glottal-flow signal as parameter (1) and removal test: remove electroglottogram and contact-phase extraction fails, so contact-quotient stops operating. The existing DEPENDS_ON pitch-tracking is for T0, not the signal source; electroglottogram is constitutive operational input.

Concentration ratio E_j / sum E_i uses total energy denominator. Zeroth moment is total energy; moment formalism provides the normalization framework. Removing moment formalism removes the statistical basis for interpreting concentration as normalized share.

Pitch-class provides the octave-invariant pitch representation that MIR systems use for chroma features, chord recognition, key detection, and tonal analysis. MIR pipelines depend on pitch-class abstraction to model harmonic structure independent of register.

Spectral sparseness = (sum magnitudes)^2 / (N * sum squared magnitudes). It requires per-bin magnitude values across all N frequency bins to compute both the sum and the sum of squares. The per-bin energy vector IS spectral-distribution. Remove it and the per-bin magnitudes are undefined; sparseness has no operand. The existing DEPENDS_ON to spectral-energy captures the total scalar but not the per-bin structure needed to compute the ratio. Pinned sense: the concentration index computed over the per-bin energy vector.

Spectral-increase computes (E_curr - E_prev) / E_prev where E is total spectral energy. E = sum(E_i) over the per-bin energy vector — spectral-distribution. Remove it and total energy cannot be computed from bins. Removal test passes.

MFCC definition explicitly requires: (2) compute the power spectrum via FFT. Without FFT, step 2 of the MFCC procedure is impossible. Removal test: remove FFT and the power spectrum cannot be computed, stopping the pipeline at step 2. Constitutive dependency on a required computational step.

Spectral-centroid is a standard MIR feature for timbre characterization and instrument recognition. The spectral-centroid definition explicitly states it is widely used in instrument recognition and music information retrieval. It serves MIR by providing the brightness measure that underpins spectral feature extraction in MIR pipelines. Direction servant→beneficiary.

spectral-smoothness quantifies how gradually spectral energy transitions change across frequency bins. High smoothness = gradually varying spectrum (mellow, homogeneous timbre); low smoothness = abrupt changes (rough, heterogeneous timbre). This measures spectral texture — a key dimension of timbre perception.

Phonetics is the subsystem of language concerned with the physical production, acoustic properties, and perceptual processing of speech sounds. It is a constitutive component of language alongside phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics.

Smoothness measures the rate of change of per-bin energy values within a sub-band's distribution. Remove the concept of spectral-band-distribution (the arrangement of energy across bins in a frequency sub-band) and there is no substrate on which to compute continuity. The removal test passes: without the distribution concept, smoothness cannot operate.

Law 8b removal test: BTR = mean(E_peak)/mean(E_trough) requires identifying local maxima and minima in the per-bin energy vector within the band. Remove spectral-band-distribution (the N-tuple of |A_i|² restricted to [f_low, f_high)) and there are no E_i values within the band to compute peaks/troughs; BTR stops operating. This mirrors the full-spectrum PTR->spectral-distribution dependency.

Semantics is the subsystem of language concerned with meaning — the mapping between linguistic forms and their interpretations. It is a constitutive component of language alongside phonology, morphology, syntax, and pragmatics, carving what linguistic expressions signify.
SERVES: spectral-band-flux measures frame-to-frame energy change within a band, directly serving onset detection for transient localization and rhythm analysis.

Harmonicity distinguishes voiced from unvoiced speech segments via harmonic vs noise energy ratio. Used in speech-recognition for voicing detection and speaker classification. In speech recognition, harmonicity features help separate periodic vocal-fold excitation from aperiodic fricatives and noise.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: phonation is the process of vocal-fold vibration during voiced phonation. Vocal folds must be in contact (glottal contact) to vibrate and produce the periodic airflow excitation. Remove glottal contact and the vocal folds cannot appose, so phonation cannot occur — the process stops operating. This is the same signal-source/phenomenon pairing the map already accepts for glottal-cycle (which depends on pitch-tracking to locate the cycle) and contact-quotient (which depends on electroglottography for its EGG signal).

The mel unit was established by Stevens, Volmann, and Maxwell (1937) before the mel-frequency scale was formalized. The scale derives from the prior concept of mel-frequency as a perceptual unit: the scale is the mapping that operationalizes the mel concept across the full audible range.

Pinned sense: cepstral-lifter definition states it works by 'applying a window function to the cepstral coefficients, optionally zeroing out selected quefrency bins, then transforming back to the frequency domain via IDFT.' The IDFT is an inverse Fourier transform — without the Fourier transform operation, this transformation step cannot execute. Removal test: remove fourier-transform and the lifter cannot transform back from quefrency to frequency domain. Constitutive, not merely useful.

CMN normalizes cepstral features for channel effects, enabling speaker-independent recognition. It serves speaker-related processing by removing channel-induced distortions that would otherwise confound speaker comparison.

The cepstrum is defined as the IFFT of the logarithm of the magnitude spectrum. Remove the magnitude-spectrum concept and the cepstrum operation is structurally impossible — it has no input to transform.

Law 8b removal test, full-spectrum sense pinned: spectral-evenness (per its accepted definition) is the coefficient of variation sigma/mu of the per-bin energies E_i = |A_i|^2 over the whole spectrum, unbounded by any sub-band, and is explicitly 'the whole-spectrum counterpart of spectral-band-evenness'. Remove spectral-distribution now and there is no ordered full-range per-bin energy tuple from which to compute mu and sigma — the construct stops operating. The band sibling anchors on spectral-band-distribution; this full-spectrum measure must anchor on the full-spectrum vector (the band sub-vector is a different-scope carve whose removal does not stop a whole-spectrum measure). Not identity (the ratio is not the tuple), not purpose.

Mel-cepstral-distortion is 'an objective metric that approximates the perceptual spectral difference between a reference utterance and a processed or synthesized utterance by comparing their mel-frequency cepstral coefficient vectors frame by frame.' Removing the mel-frequency-cepstrum — the MFC representation being compared — stops the MCD metric from operating. MCD requires the MFC vectors as its direct input; without the MFC, there is nothing to compare.

CONTAINS = part-of: the variety is the whole, the accent is a constituent part. Dialect's accepted definition carves a variety as a bundle of component systems: '(1) phonological — distinctive sound patterns and pronunciation conventions; (2) lexical; (3) grammatical; (4) social index.' The phonological component of a variety is exactly what the accent category names: a dialect decomposes into accent ⊕ lexicon ⊕ grammar, and dialect atlases perform precisely this decomposition. Contrast with the struck prosody CONTAINS stress: there prosody is an analytic framework and stress a dimension it measures — analytic relation, not constituent. Here the relation is constitutive: a speaker can be characterized by accent alone while sharing the full dialect (the definition's own test), and the component is independently indexable — taught, tested, and atlased on its own. Pinned sense (Law 11d): accent as the phonological component of a variety per its isolation rule (same words, different sound).
Spectral magnitude IS a type of spectral representation — it represents the amplitude of the frequency domain signal per bin. Specific-to-general relationship to the nearest kind.

Phonology is the subsystem of language concerned with the organization and patterning of speech sounds. It is a constitutive component of language alongside morphology, syntax, and semantics, governing sound system structure.

Mode identifies the frequency bin with highest spectral energy within band, i.e., argmax of the band-limited energy histogram. The mode operation requires the peak energy value to locate the bin. Removing peak detection stops mode from operating. This is DEPENDS_ON, not DERIVED_FROM.

Definition carves spectral-band-skewness as normalized third central moment of energy distribution across bins within band. spectral-band-moment is family of numerical descriptors derived from distribution of spectral energy within defined frequency band, parameterized by order r. Skewness is third order moment, so the moment formalism CONTAINS the specific skewness construct: removing moment formalism removes ability to define skewness as moment. The edge is constitutive, not dependency.

Spectral-band-bandwidth is the frequency span of significant energy within a band. It is computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution: the per-bin energy values determine which bins are significant (via threshold or percentage criteria), and the bandwidth is the difference between the maximum and minimum significant frequency coordinates. The distribution vector is the historical/computational source.

Law 9: voice-onset-time is a specific named member of the voice-quality family — a standardized clinical glottal-source timing parameter, computed from the glottogram with a defined computation (onset interval from flow maximum to acoustic periodicity onset), a standardized reporting unit (milliseconds), and maintained reference ranges that classify breathy/modal/creaky phonation. Nearest accepted kind: the family entry itself, the same placement as the accepted open-quotient (g701c713206bfdf94b5dc11fb), closure-quotient (g943b10d3be0ad21d1111b19d), jitter, shimmer, harmonic-to-noise-ratio, and return-phase (gf3979b54a586177d71e9a04e) INSTANCE_OF edges. Not a ladder leap: no intermediate member-kind exists on the board. Not a topic (Law 9a): the parameter is a member of the family set, not a discussion of the discipline.

HPSS structurally requires the spectrogram: the algorithm operates on the spectrogram matrix, applying median filtering along time and frequency axes to separate harmonic from percussive components. Remove the spectrogram and HPSS has no data structure to decompose.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: source-filter-separation's entire methodology is decomposing a signal into source and filter components per the source-filter model. Without the model's structural assumptions (convolutive vs additive, excitation vs resonance), there is no framework for the decomposition. The definition's three methods (inverse filtering, deconvolution, cepstral analysis) all presuppose the source-filter model's two-component framework. Removing it removes the theoretical basis of the technique.

The cepstrum is a signal-processing technique operating on digital signals, applying quefrency-domain filtering, and outputting spectral estimates. Remove the broader signal-processing apparatus (FFT implementation, digital filtering, spectral estimation) and the cepstrum has no computational infrastructure to function within. Removal test: without signal-processing, cepstrum computation stops.

Pinned sense: spectral bandwidth measures the spread or width of the spectrum around the spectral centroid. It operates on the per-frame power spectrum S[k] produced by the spectrogram. Removal test: without spectrogram, there is no mechanism to produce the frequency-binned power spectrum that spectral bandwidth requires as input. No nearer rung exists.

Removal test (Law 8b): concentration C_j = E_j / (sum_i E_i). The denominator sum_i E_i is the total spectral energy — the accepted spectral-energy carve. Remove spectral-energy and the normalization denominator has no value; the concentration is undefined. Its per-bin numerator is wired to spectral-distribution (separate edge), so each operand is anchored once. Mirrors the accepted band-concentration->band-energy (g37a0279). Pinned sense: normalized per-bin energy share of the full spectrum.

Spectral-band-crossover computes the band energy-median frequency — the point at which cumulative band energy reaches 50%. This is a standard MIR descriptor for timbre classification, genre recognition, and acoustic scene analysis where the median energy location provides a robust center-of-energy estimate unaffected by heavy-tailed distributions. The construct is built for the sake of MIR applications: its persistence mechanism is the standardized computation over band energy vectors for use in music analysis pipelines.

A bark-spectrogram warps a power spectrum onto the bark frequency scale, aggregating per-bin power values into bark bands. It operates directly on the power spectrum P[k] as input — mapping and summing power within each bark band. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the per-bin power values that the bark-spectrogram operates on, and the construct has no meaning without them.

Spectral-band-flatness = the ratio of the geometric mean to the arithmetic mean of the per-bin energy values within the band. The spectral-band-distribution provides the per-bin energy vector from which both means are computed. The distribution vector is the historical source: the flatness measure derives from applying the distribution framework to test how close the band's energy profile is to white noise.

Band energy = sum of |X[k]|^2 across the band's bins: a per-frame scalar summary of the band-local energy vector within defined bounds, the carved sense of band-feature. Pinned sense: the total (zeroth-order) summary, distinct from the per-bin vector itself which is the band distribution. Nearest accepted kind: band-feature.

Slope is a first-order linear regression coefficient on log-energy vs frequency, capturing the tilt of the distribution. It is not itself a moment but rather a first-order derivative of the log-energy profile. This is more like a gradient descriptor of the distribution shape.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): semantics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Accepted pattern mirrors linguistics CONTAINS phonology (Ezra, accepted): the accepted linguistics definition explicitly names semantics as one of its constituent subfields alongside phonology, morphology, syntax, and pragmatics. Semantics is a part of linguistics conceptual structure.

Removal test: spectral-crest computes crest = max(P[k]) / (1/N Σ P[k]) over per-bin power values. Both the max and the mean operate on the per-bin energy vector, which is exactly spectral-distribution's carve. Remove spectral-distribution and crest has no per-bin operands: the computation stops operating. Mirror pattern: spectral-band-crest-factor DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution is accepted. Full-spectrum crest needs the full-spectrum distribution.

Removal test Law 8b: peak = max_i E_i. The max operation requires the energy distribution; without moment framework the peak cannot be defined as a statistic of distribution. However peak can be computed directly from distribution, so dependency is weak. I will not file this; it's questionable.

Spectral-band-variance = second central moment of the band distribution. It is computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution, which came first as the general concept. The variance measure derives from applying the distribution framework.

EGG processing (demodulation, per-cycle peak-to-peak measurement, impedance calculation) operates as a signal processing pipeline on the raw EGG voltage. Without signal processing methods, the EGG raw voltage cannot be transformed into the electroglottogram waveform.

Spectral-peak-occupancy computes the fraction of bins where P[k] > T over a power spectrum. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the P[k] values that define the occupancy calculation — the construct has no input and stops operating. Law 8 removal test passes. Direction: spectral-peak-occupancy depends on power-spectrum.

Rhetoric is a specific kind of communication: it is communication deliberately structured to persuade. Direction test for INSTANCE_OF (Law 9/11e): rhetoric is a subtype of communication, distinguished by its intentional persuasive aim. All rhetoric is communication, but not all communication is rhetoric.

Removal test (Law 8b): spectral-rolloff sorts the per-bin magnitudes and accumulates their squared values (the per-bin energies) to the 85% point. Those squared magnitudes are exactly the spectral-distribution vector. Remove the vector and there is no per-bin energy to sort or accumulate; the rolloff frequency is undefined. Its existing magnitude/power-spectrum anchors are scalar representations; the per-bin vector is the actual operand. Mirrors the accepted band-rolloff->band-distribution (ga61f6f4). Pinned sense: the cumulative-energy rolloff frequency of the full spectrum.

spectral-band-feature is the abstraction over concrete band-scalar descriptors. MIR systems routinely compute spectral-band features (centroid, flux, rolloff, etc.) for track analysis, retrieval, classification, and segmentation. These features are operational primitives in MIR pipelines.
spectral-band-centroid is a band-localized first-moment descriptor extracted from spectral representation. A competent speaker classifies it as a spectral feature. Nearest kind is spectral-feature.

Cepstral-subtraction definition requires identifying 'the quefrency range where noise dominates (typically low quefrency)' and subtracting the noise cepstrum. Without the quefrency concept, the entire noise estimation strategy has no domain — the technique operates specifically in quefrency space where noise and speech become additively separable. Removal test: remove quefrency, and the operation loses its fundamental computational domain. Constitutive dependency.

Source-filter-separation uses cepstral analysis — mapping signals into quefrency via log-spectrum and inverse FFT — to separate slowly-varying filter envelope from rapidly-varying source structure. Without cepstrum, this decomposition method is unavailable. The remove-Y-now test: removing cepstrum eliminates this pathway.
INSTANCE_OF nearest-kind: asymmetry-coefficient is a voice-quality parameter (source-contact measure listed in the voice-quality family carve). Voice-quality is the nearest accepted kind.

A Hamming window is a specific window function defined as w(n) = 0.46 - 0.54*cos(2*pi*n/(N-1)). It depends on the concept of windowing (tapering a signal segment to reduce spectral leakage) — removing windowing stops the Hamming window from having its defining operation. This is a constitutive structural dependency: the Hamming window IS a window function, and without the concept of windowing it has no operational meaning.

Prominence quantifies strength of the cepstral peak that picking identifies. Removing picking means there is no peak location to evaluate prominence against; the metric loses its referent. Operational dependency: prominence measurement requires a peak to be picked first.
Crest factor requires per-bin energy vector v for max(E_i)/RMS computation. Without the distribution, no crest factor computation is possible.

Spectral tenuity measures how thin or filamentary the spectral energy distribution is across frequency bins. It operates directly on spectral magnitude values |X[k]|. Removing spectral-magnitude eliminates the input data on which tenuity is computed.

Spectral-rms = sqrt(mean over bins of (amplitude^2)) over the full-spectrum per-bin amplitude/energy vector - the accepted carve of spectral-distribution. Remove that vector and the RMS is undefined. The band sub-vector is the wrong target for the full-spectrum general measure.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): historical-linguistics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Per its accepted definition, historical-linguistics is a disciplinary framework for reconstructing diachronic change in language systems from attested corpora — one of the named subfields of the parent discipline. The accepted linguistics definition explicitly names 'historical linguistics' among its named subdisciplines. Parallel to accepted edges: linguistics CONTAINS phonology, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, syntax, phonetics. Pinned sense: historical-linguistics as the subdiscipline of language change over time.

Spectral-sparseness measures the concentration of spectral energy across frequency bins. It is computed directly from spectral magnitudes: e.g. sparseness = (Σ|X[k]|)²/(N·Σ|X[k]|²). Removing spectral-magnitude eliminates the input values — sparseness cannot be computed without them. Present-tense constitutive dependency per removal test.

Pinned sense: CMVN operates directly on cepstral coefficient vectors — it computes mean and variance per coefficient dimension across frames, then applies z-score normalization to each coefficient. Remove cepstral-coefficients and CMVN has no operand to normalize. The removal test passes: CMVN's structural home is the cepstral coefficient vector.

Spectral decay measures the rate at which spectral magnitude decreases over time. It is computed directly from the magnitude-spectrum — without the magnitude-spectrum as its input domain, spectral decay cannot be computed. The removal test passes: removing magnitude-spectrum from the computational framework stops spectral decay from operating.

Crest factor is the ratio of peak magnitude to RMS magnitude of a power spectrum. Removing power-spectrum means there is no magnitude spectrum from which to compute RMS or identify the peak. The removal test passes: without power-spectrum, crest-factor has no operand and cannot operate. Constitutive dependency.

Pinned sense: source-filter-separation is a signal-processing technique that is built and maintained for the sake of the signal-processing discipline — its purpose is to decompose an observed signal into source and filter components, an operation signal-processing exists to perform. Servant→master per Law 8d. This is purpose, not dependency: the technique can be removed without signal-processing stopping, and its dependency line already runs through its named decomposition methods (inverse-filtering, deconvolution, cepstrum), so SERVES is the correct type for the relationship to the field. Follows the board's standing convention that processing/filter techniques (cepstral-analysis, fir-filter, butterworth-filter) SERVE signal-processing.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is computational-linguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its accepted definition, it is a disciplinary framework for formalizing linguistic knowledge in algorithms and computational models — a specific subfield of the general discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: computational-linguistics as the subdiscipline of computational language analysis.

Spectral skewness requires a frequency-binned power/magnitude spectrum as its input data. The formula operates on S[k] from a spectrogram. Without spectrogram as a concept, spectral skewness has no computational substrate. Removal test passes.

Spectral-contrast is a standard feature vector used in MIR systems for genre classification, chord recognition, and music structure analysis. MIR toolkits (MTG-Jamendo, librosa) deploy spectral-contrast as a core descriptor for timbral analysis.

attack-time as analytic operand in speech-recognition. SR systems use attack time for phoneme boundary detection and syllable rhythm analysis; the computed duration serves the SR segmentation and prosodic modeling stages.

CONTAINS = part-of, pinned to the discipline-as-collection sense: the board already ACCEPTED linguistics CONTAINS sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics, and psycholinguistics, and INSTANCE_OF computational-linguistics -> linguistics; this files the fourth containment the family pattern implies, completing the set of subfields held inside the discipline.

Spectral-variance computes the second central moment of the power spectrum P[k]. It operates directly on power values across frequency bins; removing the power spectrum eliminates the very values being measured. The variance is defined as σ² = (1/N)Σ(P[k] - μ)² where μ = (1/N)ΣP[k] — this is a constitutive operation on P[k], not a computational detail.

Pinned sense: The power spectrum P(f) = |X(f)|² where X(f) is the DFT of signal x(n). The DFT is the operational mechanism producing X(f). Remove DFT and the power spectrum has no computational definition — it cannot be derived without the DFT (or an equivalent transform). This is a removal-test dependency: without the DFT, the power spectrum ceases to be computable.

Skewness IS the third standardized moment of the spectral-band distribution. The remove-Y test: without the moment framework (central moments about the mean), the computation m3 = Σ(E_i - μ)³Δf cannot be formed, and thus standardized_skewness = m3/σ³ has no input. Removing moment stops skewness from operating.

ZCR serves MIR as a spectral balance/noise ratio indicator. MIR systems use ZCR to distinguish tonal from percussive content within a frame, serving source separation, instrument classification, and audio feature extraction.

Pinned sense: electroglottography is the measurement technique that produces the EGG signal from which voice-quality parameters (contact quotient, open quotient, closure quotient) are derived. The method exists for the sake of clinical voice assessment: servant (electroglottography) to beneficiary (voice-quality). Law 8d: for whose sake?

Cepstral subtraction (Boll 1979) is a speech enhancement technique that estimates and removes additive noise in the cepstral domain. It serves speech-processing directly by reducing noise to improve speech quality and intelligibility.
Discourse is a subdomain of linguistics — the study of language beyond the sentence level. It encompasses cohesion, coherence, turn-taking, and conversational structure as linguistic phenomena.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: glottal contact is the physical contact between vocal folds during the glottal cycle. The contact area is the physical measure of that contact — as contact area increases, impedance decreases and the EGG amplitude rises. Remove contact area and glottal contact has no measurable extent; the phenomenon cannot be quantified. This mirrors the accepted pairing of contact-quotient (which depends on electroglottography for its EGG signal) — the physical phenomenon depends on its measurable parameter.

Spectral-band-variance applies the variance formula to power values within a single frequency band. Spectral-variance is the general case across the full spectrum. The band-limited variant is a direct specialization: same second central moment, restricted to band-binned power values.
SERVES: mode identifies the dominant frequency bin in a band, serving MIR for pitch detection, harmonic analysis, and vocal/instrument separation.

INSTANCE_OF nearest-kind test: MFD is a maintained, named member of the voice-quality family — the carve states it 'persists as a member of the voice-quality measurement map ... maintained alongside jitter, shimmer, and the phase quotients'. The family carve names its members with a defined computation, a standardized unit, and maintained reference ranges; MFD carries exactly that triple (per-cycle peak derivative, standardized units, reference ranges separating typical from disordered phonation). No intermediate member-kind exists on the board, so the family entry is the nearest kind — filed exactly as jitter, shimmer, open-quotient, closure-quotient, return-phase, and glottal-to-noise-ratio stand.

Kurtosis IS the fourth standardized moment. The remove-Y test: without the moment framework (central moments about the mean), the computation m4 = Σ(E_i - μ)⁴Δf cannot be formed, and thus standardized_kurtosis = m4/σ⁴ has no input. Removing moment stops kurtosis from operating.

Spectral analysis requires signal processing as a prerequisite — you cannot decompose a signal into its frequency components without the mathematical operations (FFT, windowing, etc.) that define signal processing. Removal test: without signal processing techniques, spectral analysis cannot operate.

Spectral-band-spread quantifies dispersion of energy across frequency bins in Hz within a band. It is the square root of the second central moment of the energy distribution — a standard MIR descriptor for spectral shape characterization used in timbre classification, instrument recognition, and audio segmentation pipelines (e.g. librosa spectral_spread).

SERVES test: pitch tracking produces fundamental frequency contours that are foundational to speech-processing — used for prosodic analysis, voice activity detection, speaker identification, and speech coding. Remove pitch tracking and speech-processing loses its ability to analyze the pitch dimension of speech signals.

Pinned sense: temporal-centroid as the first moment of the energy envelope. Its accepted definition names the operand explicitly: 'typically computed as the first moment of the energy envelope normalized by duration.' Removal test (L8b): without the energy envelope there is no time distribution over which the weighted mean is computed. Precedent: attack-time DEPENDS_ON amplitude-envelope - a moment/duration descriptor reads the envelope it is a statistic of.

Spectral-band-crossover = the frequency at which cumulative band energy reaches 50%. It serves timbre characterization by measuring the median energy location — a robust center-of-estimate unaffected by outliers, complementary to centroid for spectral shape description.

Pinned sense: jitter computes cycle-to-cycle period variation, which requires pitch-synchronous cycle segmentation. The definition specifies 'the voiced speech signal segmented at pitch-synchronous cycle boundaries' — without pitch-estimation to identify those cycle boundaries, jitter cannot operate. Remove pitch-estimation and jitter's required input (pitch-synchronous period tracks) is unavailable. This is structural necessity, not mere utility.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): spectral-kurtosis per its accepted definition (v2) = the FOURTH STANDARDIZED MOMENT of the spectral power distribution (E[(P-mu)^4]/E[(P-mu)^2]^2); spectral-moment per its accepted definition names higher moments as 'characterizing... tail heaviness (kurtosis).' Law 9: is spectral-kurtosis a specific kind of spectral-moment? Yes — it is the r=4 member of the family, exactly as the board already accepts for the band family (spectral-band-kurtosis INSTANCE_OF spectral-band-moment, gb81165; DERIVED_FROM line g2809db). A competent speaker calls spectral kurtosis a spectral moment of order 4. Nearest kind: spectral-moment (no intermediate kind exists; spectral-feature is one rung above and the leap through it is derivable once this rung stands, Law 11e). Not DERIVED_FROM: the question here is kind-membership, and the band family's accepted INSTANCE_OF precedent fixes the sense.

Spectral-band-entropy is the band-local variant of the global spectral-entropy. The global construct applied Shannon entropy to the full-spectrum energy distribution; the band version restricts the probability mass function to a frequency subrange [f_low, f_high]. Historical precedence: spectral-entropy as a global measure predates its sub-band specialization.

Crest factor = max(E_i)/rms(E_i) over the band's per-bin energies: a scalar descriptor reducing the band's per-bin energy vector to a dimensionless summary within analyst-specified bounds, the carved sense of band-feature. Not a moment (no order r), so band-moment is not a kind for it; band-feature is the nearest accepted kind.

The accepted definition of cepstrum-coefficient requires: (2) taking the natural logarithm of the spectrum. Without logarithm, step 2 of the computation is impossible. Removal test: remove logarithm and the cepstrum-coefficient procedure cannot proceed past step 2. Constitutive dependency on a required mathematical operation.

spectral-band-entropy (Shannon entropy of normalized per-bin energies within a band) IS a spectral feature — a numerical descriptor extracted from spectral representation that quantifies uniformity of energy distribution. A competent speaker classifies it as a spectral feature. Files against nearest kind: spectral-feature has no intermediate category.

Spectral-band-centroid = weighted mean frequency of energy in a band. It measures where energy is centered — a foundational timbre descriptor distinguishing bass-heavy from bright spectral character within sub-bands. Built for the sake of timbre characterization: persists as a standardized computation in audio analysis and music information retrieval.

Spectral sparseness measures concentration of energy across frequency bins. It operates on spectral values (magnitude or power) per frame. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the spectral energy representation needed to compute sparseness.

Removal test: spectral-concentration computes C_j = E_j / Σ_i E_i over per-bin energies. Spectral-distribution IS the ordered per-bin energy vector of the full spectrum. The numerator E_j and denominator Σ_i E_i both read directly from this vector. Remove spectral-distribution and concentration has no per-bin operands: the computation stops operating. Mirror pattern: spectral-band-concentration DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution is accepted. The full-spectrum construct needs the full-spectrum distribution.

Psycholinguistics investigates the cognitive mechanisms underlying language use — perception, production, acquisition, and representation. The removal test passes: remove cognition and psycholinguistics has no subject matter to operate on. This is not a meta-level claim (Law 2b); it is an object-level dependency where the discipline's entire investigative apparatus targets cognitive processes.

LPC as a speech science tool constitutively depends on the source-filter model: the model provides the interpretive framework (source=glottal flow, filter=vocal tract) that gives LPC its speech production meaning. Remove the source-filter model and LPC collapses to a generic linear regression procedure — it ceases operating as a speech analysis tool. The removal test (Law 8b) passes because the operational purpose of LPC in speech science is to estimate filter parameters within the source-filter framework.
flatness equals geometric-mean divided by arithmetic-mean; both means are moment computations (0th and 1st order). Removing moment theory removes the definition of flatness itself
Band-bandwidth is a scalar descriptor of the effective width of energy distribution within a defined frequency sub-band. It fits the definition of a spectral-band feature.

Glottal-flow is estimated via inverse filtering of the speech signal to separate the glottal source from the vocal tract. The cepstrum separates source and filter components by transforming the power spectrum into quefrency space where they become additively separable. Removing the cepstrum — the core mechanism for source-filter separation in the quefrency domain — stops glottal-flow estimation from operating, since the whole inverse-filtering approach relies on the cepstral decomposition of convolution into additivity.

Historical origin: crest factor = max(E_i)/RMS. RMS is second-order moment sqrt(mean(E_i^2)). Max is selection from distribution. Both numerator and denominator derive from moment formalism of energy distribution. Moment family provides conceptual framework; crest factor is a derived specialization.

Pinned sense: phase-locked vocoder as STFT-based algorithm with analysis/synthesis window length and hop size parameters. Removal test (Law 8): remove the Hann window function — the specific window shape used for spectral leakage control and overlap-add reconstruction — and the STFT frames the vocoder operates on lose their defined spectral leakage properties and overlap-add consistency; the algorithm's phase-locking rule operates on frames that no longer reconstruct correctly. The vocoder stops operating as a phase-coherent time-stretch/pitch-shift tool. Dependency is object-level material requirement for the STFT stage, not sayability.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): pragmatics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Accepted pattern mirrors linguistics CONTAINS phonology (Ezra, accepted): the accepted linguistics definition explicitly names pragmatics as one of its constituent subfields alongside phonology, morphology, syntax, and semantics. Pragmatics is a part of linguistics conceptual structure.

The spectrogram is the squared magnitude of the STFT output: S(t,f) = |STFT(t,f)|². The STFT itself is computed as a DFT applied to windowed segments of the signal. The removal test: removing DFT eliminates the core computational mechanism — STFT cannot operate without DFT, and the spectrogram cannot operate without STFT. The dependency is constitutive through the STFT chain.

Linguistic register is a specific subfield/concept within linguistics, the study of language varieties. It is a specific kind of linguistic object, not a part. INSTANCE_OF pins specific → general. The entry's scope describes language varieties, which is a topic linguistics studies.

CONSTITUTIVE: chromagram definition states it is computed by applying a mel-scale filterbank to spectral energy. The mel-scale perceptual frequency mapping is fundamental to the chromagram construction — removing mel-scale eliminates the frequency warping that defines chromagram bin structure. Without mel-scale, chromagram has no basis for its mel-warped frequency bins.
An accent is a phonological construct — a recognizable pattern of phonetic realization. It is a specific variety of phonological production, making it an instance of the broader phonology category.

Pinned sense: The mel-frequency spectrogram is computed by first obtaining a time-frequency representation via STFT, then applying a mel-scale filterbank to the resulting power spectra. The STFT is the structural input mechanism — it produces the frame-by-frame power spectra that the mel filterbank operates on. Remove STFT and the mel-frequency spectrogram has no data to transform.

The electroglottogram is the demodulated envelope of the electroglottographic (EGG) voltage waveform. Without the EGG measurement technique producing the raw voltage signal, the electroglottogram waveform cannot be produced. Removal test: remove electroglottography (the measurement technique) and there is no voltage signal to demodulate, so the electroglottogram stops operating. The dependency is constitutive.

Rolloff computes the frequency at which accumulated energy reaches a specified percentage (e.g. 85%) of total band energy. To determine the threshold, it must first compute spectral-band-energy for the band — removing energy computation makes the threshold undefined and the rolloff uncomputable.

Spectral-band-moment computes moment-based statistics (centroid, spread, skewness, kurtosis) over a sub-band energy distribution. These shape-descriptors are filed and used for the purpose of characterizing timbre — they quantify how energy is distributed across frequency within a band, which is constitutive of timbre perception. The beneficiary of this construct is timbre analysis.

Law 9: shimmer is a specific named member of the voice-quality family. The accepted shimmer definition carves it as 'a voice-quality parameter quantifying the cycle-to-cycle variation of amplitude' with the APQ3 variant; the pending voice-quality definition carves the family and names 'amplitude perturbation (shimmer: APQ3, standard-deviation variant)' as its second constituent. Shimmer is the specific parameter, voice-quality the family of standardized clinical parameters it is filed against as nearest kind.

Spectral peak position identifies the frequency bin at which a spectral peak occurs. It requires spectral-peak to first identify where peaks are located; removing spectral-peak eliminates the peak detection that peak position depends on.

Removal test (Law 8b): spectral-crest = max(P[k]) / mean(P[k]). The numerator max(P[k]) is the power at the dominant bin — the accepted spectral-peak construct. Remove the peak and the numerator has no value; the ratio is undefined. The mean side is wired to the per-bin vector (separate edge), so each operand is anchored once. Mirrors the accepted band-crest-factor->band-peak (g8af8260). Pinned sense: the full-spectrum peak-to-mean concentration ratio.

Cepstral-distance measures spectral shape dissimilarity. The scope explicitly states it enables comparison of timbre, speaker identity, or material properties. It serves timbre by quantifying how different two spectra's timbral structures are.
Flatness ratio of geometric mean to arithmetic mean is derived from log-moments of the per-bin energy distribution; moment formalism is constitutive of the computation.

Onset-strength definition states persistence mechanism computes per-frame onset strength via spectral flux |P(f,t)-P(f,t-1)| or energy-based methods. Both methods require power spectrum as input: spectral flux operates on power spectra, energy-based methods compute energy from power spectrum. Removing power-spectrum removes operand for both computational paths, so onset-strength stops operating. Removal test passes.

Spectral-band-centroid = first raw moment of the band distribution. It is computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution, which came first as the general concept. The centroid measure derives from applying the distribution framework.

Source-filter model is a human-made mathematical model of speech production built explicitly for speech analysis, synthesis, and coding. Its parameters (source excitation, vocal tract filter, formant frequencies) are designed to serve speech-processing tasks such as speech synthesis, speech recognition, and speech coding. Remove speech-processing as a purpose and the model loses its designed application domain — it is maintained for whose sake speech processing operates. Servant points at master per Law 8d.

SERVES test: spectral-band-peak identifies the maximum energy in a frequency band. It serves timbre characterization by quantifying the prominence of strong spectral components, which correlate with perceived brightness and hardness of timbre.
Flatness = geo-mean/arith-mean of per-bin energies. Without the full vector v, the ratio cannot be computed. spectral-band-energy aggregate alone is insufficient.

Removal test (Law 8b) against the filed carve. The accepted speech-act definition is carved as 'a spoken or written utterance that functions as an action — promising, ordering, declaring, questioning — rather than merely describing a state of affairs': the speech act's bearer is the utterance, and parameter (1), the locutionary act, is 'the act of SAYING something' — saying something is the performing of an utterance. Remove utterance now — the unit participants treat as a single bounded unit of action, which the discipline transcribes and segments — and the speech act has no bearer to be an act OF: an action performed by an utterance is not an act performed by a bare span of sound or ink. The pragmatic framework stops classifying, because illocutionary force is force OF a unit, not of a continuum. Direction check (Law 8c): the converse fails — utterance operates without the speech-act taxonomy (a stretch is a bounded unit of action whether or not anyone classifies its illocutionary force), which is exactly why utterance DEPENDS_ON speech-act runs the wrong way and should fall. Pinned sense (Law 11d): speech act as the action performed BY an utterance per both accepted carves, not as a free-floating force in speech. Not DERIVED_FROM (utterance is not a historical source); not identity (the act is a way the unit functions, not the unit itself).

Whole-to-part (Law 10): neurolinguistics as a discipline contains speech-processing as a component research area. Per its accepted definition, neurolinguistics studies neural mechanisms of language acquisition, processing, representation, and comprehension — and speech-processing (the neural mechanisms by which speech sounds are perceived, decoded, and represented in the brain) is one of these core processes. The accepted speech-processing entry carves the computational and psychological study of how speech signals are transformed into linguistic representations. Neurolinguistics is the broader field that encompasses this component process alongside phonology, syntax, semantics, and other language-level operations. Direction test: neurolinguistics is the discipline whose scope comprises these component processes; speech-processing is one of them, not the whole.

Pinned sense: spectral contrast measures the difference in energy between peaks and valleys across defined frequency bands. It operates on the per-frame power spectrum S[k] produced by the spectrogram. Removal test: without spectrogram, there is no mechanism to produce the frequency-binned power spectrum that spectral contrast requires as input. No nearer rung exists.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: The accepted definition states 'estimated per pitch period' — the fundamental period T0 from pitch tracking is required to partition contact-area estimates into per-cycle measurements. Remove pitch-tracking and the per-period structure collapses; contact-area as defined stops operating.

INSTANCE_OF nearest-kind test: formant-dispersion is a maintained, named member of the voice-quality family — the carve states it 'persists as a member of the voice-quality measurement map ... maintained alongside jitter, shimmer, the phase quotients, and the noise ratios'. The family carve names its members with a defined computation, a standardized reporting unit (hertz), and maintained reference ranges separating typical from disordered phonation; formant-dispersion carries exactly that triple (per-frame (F3-F1)/2, hertz, maintained reference ranges). No intermediate member-kind exists on the board, so the family entry is the nearest kind — filed exactly as jitter/shimmer/HNR/MFD/VOT stand against voice-quality.

Pinned sense: the band-localized moment family as a restriction of the general spectral-moment construct. Which-came-first: the moment formalism (weighted frequency moments of an energy distribution, mu_n = sum f_i^n E_i) is the older general construct — moment theory predates its band-localized specialization, and every band member on the board (centroid, variance, skewness, kurtosis, RMS, spread) is that general family restricted to a frequency sub-band. This mirrors the board's accepted lineage arrow: spectral-band-flatness DERIVED_FROM spectral-flatness, 'the band-localized extension ... full-spectrum flatness predates the band-localized variant.' The band family is the band-localized extension of the general moment family, so the arrow runs band-moment to general moment. Not INSTANCE_OF: a band-restricted family is a specialized variant of the general concept, not an instance of a single moment (Law 9a); not DEPENDS_ON: the general formalism is not removed now — the band family operates on its own band-limited parameters.

Spectral-band-kurtosis is the fourth standardized moment of the band distribution, a direct specialization of the general moment concept. Historically and mathematically derived from moment framework.

The sinc function as a mathematical construct used in signal processing (ideal lowpass filter impulse response, interpolation kernel) structurally depends on the signal-processing framework. Removing signal-processing as the conceptual domain would stop the sinc function from operating in its definitional context — the sinc function as an ideal interpolator / reconstruction kernel only exists within signal processing theory. The removal test passes: without signal-processing, the sinc function loses its operational identity as an ideal interpolation kernel.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: inverse-filtering's definition specifies parameter (1) as 'the estimated transfer function H(z) — typically a linear-prediction filter for the vocal tract.' The method operates by constructing H_inv(z) = 1/H(z) where H(z) is an all-pole model estimated via linear prediction. Remove linear-prediction and the technique loses its primary means of estimating the vocal-tract filter — the core input to the inversion. This is the same pairing already accepted for glottal-flow (which depends on linear-prediction).
Jitter requires pitch-synchronous cycle segmentation to compute per-cycle periods. Without pitch-estimation to identify cycle boundaries, the required input is unavailable. Removal test passes.
Pinned sense: spectral-band-skewness as third standardized moment. Removing moment formalism removes skewness computation; skewness is constitutive of moment-based family.

Spectral flux measures the change in power across consecutive frames: sum((P[k,n] - P[k,n-1])^2) where P is the power spectrum. It operates directly on the spectral-power-distribution values. Removing SPDF removes the distribution that flux computes differences over. Constitutive.

Pitch-shifting methods that operate in the frequency domain (phase-vocoder-based) fundamentally manipulate phase relationships across frames to shift pitch. Removing phase as an operational parameter would stop such pitch-shifters from functioning. Phase is constitutive to the mechanism, not merely related.

The definition maps coefficients to vector elements c[1..N] in the cepstral domain, which is parameterized by quefrency. The quefrency concept (time-like variable) is what indexes the sequence elements. Removing quefrency means losing the indexing dimension of the sequence. Operand-level structural dependency.

Instantaneous-amplitude is |z(t)| where z(t) is the analytic signal, which requires the Hilbert transform H{x(t)} as its imaginary component. Remove hilbert-transform and the computation has no operative meaning.

spectral-bandwidth measures the width of the frequency band around the spectral centroid within which most of the energy is concentrated (the standard deviation of the spectral distribution). This is a core timbral descriptor: narrow bandwidth indicates a focused, tonal sound; wide bandwidth indicates a broad, noisy timbre. It directly characterizes how spread out the spectral energy is, a dimension of timbre perception.

spectral-band-crossover computes the frequency at which cumulative energy reaches 50% of band total energy — the band-local median. This requires accumulating energy values across individual frequency bins in order. Without the per-bin energy distribution, there are no bin-level energies to sort, accumulate, or find the median threshold point. The dependency is operational: removing the distribution makes the parameter incomputable.

spectral-gating IS a spectral-feature (a numerical descriptor of frequency-domain structure). Its accepted definition: estimates noise floor per frequency band and attenuates bins below threshold. While primarily a processing operation, the noise-floor estimate per band IS a measurable spectral descriptor. The nearest accepted kind is spectral-feature.

asymmetry-coefficient is a named voice-quality measurement parameter: a specific member of the voice-quality family of standardized clinical parameters for assessing laryngeal function, computed from the glottal-flow waveform and fundamental period.

Cepstral sequence represents signal characteristics in the cepstral domain — the low-quefrency coefficients encode spectral envelope shape (spectral tilt, formant structure), which are primary dimensions of timbre perception. The persistence mechanism produces a fixed-length vector used in timbre characterization. This serves the timbre construct by providing a compact representation of timbrally-relevant spectral envelope information.

The bark-spectrogram computation proceeds through spectrogram as an intermediate step: for each frame, apply FFT to windowed segment to produce time-frequency data, then map linear-frequency bins to bark-scale bins. The spectrogram paradigm (frame-based FFT → time-frequency matrix) is the computational mechanism that bark-spectrogram warps. The removal test: removing spectrogram eliminates the intermediate time-frequency representation that bark-spectrogram operates upon.

Open quotient is a specific voice-quality parameter computed from the glottal-flow waveform. It serves the voice-quality measurement map by providing the open-phase fraction as a standardized diagnostic metric.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-skewness is the third standardized moment of the per-bin energy values. Computed as Σ((E[i]−μ)/σ)³/N where E[i], μ, σ come from the spectral-band-distribution. Without the per-bin energy vector, skewness cannot be computed.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): MFCC features are the log mel-frequency spectrum, which IS a spectral envelope representation (smoothed frequency-domain representation). Remove spectral envelope and MFCC loses its core characterizing concept — it cannot be understood as a spectral envelope without that concept. Constitutive.
Spectral kurtosis is kurtosis of spectral power distribution. Removing spectral power distribution stops kurtosis computation; constitutive dependency per Law 8b.
Removing rms-energy stops crest-factor from operating since crest-factor divides peak by RMS value

Pinned sense: analytic-signal is literally defined as z(t) = x(t) + j·H{x(t)} where H is the Hilbert transform. The removal test: remove hilbert-transform and the analytic signal cannot be constructed — the definition itself references it. Present-tense operational dependency.

Spectral-band-evenness = σ/μ of per-bin energy values within a band. Computing the standard deviation requires the full per-bin energy vector from the spectral-band-distribution. The aggregate mean energy alone is insufficient — evenness measures the dispersion pattern across individual bins. Removing the distribution concept removes the substrate on which evenness is computed.

Computing flatness (geometric_mean / arithmetic_mean of per-bin energies) requires access to the per-bin energy values within the band. The arithmetic mean is total band energy divided by the number of bins; both the geometric mean and arithmetic mean need the per-bin energy data that spectral-band-energy aggregates. Removing spectral-band-energy would eliminate access to per-bin energy values needed for flatness computation.

RMS energy is the root-mean-square of the power spectrum over a frame. Removing power-spectrum means there are no power values to average. The removal test passes: without power-spectrum, rms-energy has no operand and cannot operate. Constitutive dependency.

Spectral-flux computes L1 distance between consecutive power spectra. It requires the per-bin energy vector — spectral-distribution — to measure change per bin. Remove it and flux has no data to compare across frames. Removal test passes.

Syntax is a specific component of grammar: a competent linguist calls syntax 'a part of grammar' or 'grammatical syntax'. Grammar is the broader system of rules for a language, encompassing syntax, morphology, phonology, etc. Direction specific→general is correct.

Power spectrum is the squared magnitude of the magnitude spectrum (|X(f)|^2). Removing magnitude-spectrum stops the power spectrum from having its defining operation — power spectrum is derived from magnitude spectrum by squaring.

In signal processing, phase refers to the angular component of the complex-valued Fourier transform output. The phase spectrum is defined as the argument of the Fourier transform at each frequency bin. Without the Fourier transform, there is no signal processing phase concept — phase is not a standalone construct but an inherent property of Fourier spectral analysis.
spectral-band-spread equals sqrt(second central moment), it is the dispersion instance of the second-order moment of band energy distribution

Band mode = the frequency of the maximum-energy bin within the sub-band: a scalar (frequency-valued) descriptor of the band's per-bin energy vector, the carved sense of band-feature. Not a moment; band-feature is the nearest accepted kind.

Spectral-band-rolloff = frequency below which X% of band energy accumulates (typically 85%). It measures brightness/spectral character — a standard MIR descriptor for timbre characterization, instrument classification, and acoustic scene analysis. Built for the sake of MIR applications.

SERVES test: spectral-band-peak identifies the maximum energy in a frequency band. It serves MIR as a standard feature for spectral shape analysis, instrument recognition, and audio classification pipelines.

Spectral-band-band-center is a scalar descriptor computed from per-bin energy values within a defined frequency sub-band — exactly the construct defined by spectral-band-feature: 'A family of spectral analysis parameters that operate within a defined frequency sub-band, each parameter reducing the band-local energy vector to a scalar summary.' This is a specific→general INSTANCE_OF relationship consistent with 18 other spectral-band-*→ spectral-band-feature edges already on the map.

Rolloff is the frequency below which X% of total band energy is concentrated. It operates on cumulative sums of per-bin energy values — removing spectral-band-energy removes the substrate on which the cumulative sum operates. Constitutive DEPENDS_ON.

Cepstral-mean-normalization 'computes the frame-wise mean of cepstral coefficient vectors across a speech utterance' per accepted definition. Cepstral coefficients are samples of the cepstrum — they exist in the quefrency (cepstral) domain. Removal test: remove cepstrum and there is no quefrency-domain signal from which to extract coefficients to normalize. Genuine DEPENDS_ON.

Linear predictive coding models the vocal tract as an all-pole filter whose coefficients directly represent the spectral envelope. The LPC analysis estimates the spectral envelope of speech by predicting each sample from a linear combination of past samples. Remove the spectral-envelope concept and LPC has no target to model — its output coefficients are a parametric representation of the spectral envelope.

Parameters: (1) LPC order — number of prediction coefficients (determines envelope resolution); (2) analysis window — frame size for prediction.

Laws: 6, 8b

Entropy computes exp(-H) from normalized probabilities p_i = P_i/ΣP_i. The ΣP_i normalization is spectral-band-energy itself. Remove energy and the probability distribution cannot be constructed. Removal test passes.

The wavelet transform is a Fourier-related transform that decomposes signals using scaled and shifted wavelet basis functions. The mathematical theory of wavelets is deeply intertwined with Fourier analysis — wavelet properties (localization, frequency interpretation, reconstruction) are defined in relation to Fourier transform behavior. The Fourier transform provides the frequency domain framework that gives wavelet coefficients their spectral meaning. Removing the Fourier transform concept eliminates the analytical context that defines the wavelet transform.
inverse-filtering is a specialized form of deconvolution, derived from the general deconvolution concept and applied to transfer function inversion in DSP

Spectral-variance = (1/N)*sum(P[k]-mu)^2 over k=0..N-1, all bins of the full spectrum, no band bounds. Its operand is the global per-bin power/energy vector - the accepted carve of spectral-distribution. Remove that vector and the variance is undefined. The band sub-vector (spectral-band-distribution) is the wrong target.

Spectral-band-concentration quantifies the fraction of band energy in a single bin (E_j / Σ E_i), normalized and level-invariant. It serves MIR tasks like timbre characterization, instrument identification, and tonal vs noisy signal classification where energy concentration ratios are standard descriptors. The construct is built for the sake of MIR applications, persisting as a standardized computation in audio analysis toolkits.

The electroglottogram is a specific glottal-flow waveform: it is the demodulated EGG voltage envelope tracking glottal contact area, which is a particular realization of the glottal airflow estimate that the glottal-flow entry defines as the inverse-filtered speech signal. INSTANCE_OF runs specific to its nearest accepted kind — glottal-flow is the nearest accepted kind of glottal airflow measurement, and the electroglottogram is one of its clinical measurement modalities.

Removal test (Law 8b): formant-tracking, per its accepted definition, is 'a computational method that estimates the time-varying resonant frequencies of the vocal tract from speech signals by detecting spectral peaks in successive analysis frames.' Its object of operation is the formant itself — the vocal-tract resonant frequency band, per formant's accepted definition ('a peak in spectral energy produced when the vocal tract acts as an acoustic filter'). Remove formant — the resonance that produces the trackable spectral peaks — and formant-tracking stops operating: the peak-picking has nothing to lock onto and the output (the time-varying resonant-frequency contour) ceases to exist. Not mere sayability: the method's mechanism presupposes the resonant band as the structure it measures. Same accepted shape as pitch-tracking DEPENDS_ON F0 (remove F0 as a concept and pitch tracking has nothing to track). Not DERIVED_FROM: the formant concept is the object tracked, not a historical source — the method's historical sources (spectral-analysis, cepstral-analysis) are already filed as its DERIVED_FROM edges. Pinned senses: formant as the vocal-tract resonant frequency band (accepted definition); formant-tracking as the frame-by-frame estimation method (accepted definition).
SERVES test: spectral-band-smoothness quantifies continuity of per-bin energy within a band. It serves MIR as a spectral shape descriptor used in classification and segmentation pipelines.

Cepstral-distance is 'a measure of dissimilarity between two spectral shapes, computed from the cepstral coefficients.' The quefrency domain is the axis on which cepstral coefficients are defined; the distance metric operates on values indexed by quefrency position. Removing the quefrency domain — the quefrency-axis representation — stops the distance metric from operating, since there is no metric space on which to compute the distance.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): spectral-centroid per its accepted definition = the weighted mean of the frequency components, nu = sum(f_i * M_i) / sum(M_i) — the energy/magnitude-weighted mean frequency, i.e. the FIRST moment of the spectral distribution. spectral-moment per its accepted definition = the family mu_n = sum(f_i^n * E_i), whose 'first moment yields the energy-weighted mean frequency.' Law 9: is the centroid a specific kind of spectral-moment? Yes — it is the r=1 member of the family, exactly as the board already accepts for the band family (spectral-band-centroid INSTANCE_OF spectral-band-moment; DERIVED_FROM ge1d4e55). The band family's accepted centroid is the same weighted-mean statistic restricted to one band, so the full-spectrum centroid is the identical kind-membership claim without the band restriction. Nearest kind: spectral-moment (no intermediate kind stands between them; the r=1 member sits directly in the family, Law 11e — not a derivable ladder leap, confirmed by precheck). Not DERIVED_FROM: the question is kind-membership, not which-came-first. Not DEPENDS_ON: the centroid is a member, not a dependent on the abstract family concept. A competent DSP speaker calls spectral centroid the first spectral moment. This completes the full-spectrum moment family: r=1 centroid, r=2 variance, r=3 skewness, r=4 kurtosis.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is neurolinguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its definition, it is a field that studies the neural and biological mechanisms of language — a specific subfield within the broader discipline of linguistics. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind interposes). Pinned sense: neurolinguistics as the research program mapping language onto brain mechanisms.

Direction tested (Law 9, specific to nearest accepted kind): per its accepted definition, spectral-peak-rolloff is a scalar descriptor of a signal's spectral representation — the frequency below which a given percentage (default 85%) of total spectral energy accumulates — i.e. a numerical characteristic extracted from the frequency-domain structure with a standardized mathematical definition. That is exactly what spectral-feature's accepted definition carves (a numerical descriptor extracted from the spectral representation capturing a measurable aspect of frequency-domain structure; its own scope lists spectral rolloff as an example). Nearest accepted kind: no accepted rolloff-kind entry stands between it and spectral-feature, and the 29 accepted siblings (spectral-par, spectral-crest-factor, spectral-band-feature via its own edge) all run to the same kind. Not a leap: nothing on the ladder already reaches it.

Spectral-flow describes temporal evolution of spectral energy distribution. Its parameter is the per-bin energy vector — spectral-distribution. Remove the per-bin vector and spectral-flow has no spectral distribution to track over time. Removal test passes.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): psycholinguistics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Per its accepted definition, psycholinguistics is a disciplinary framework for mapping mental representations and processes underlying language production, comprehension, and acquisition — one of the named subfields of the parent discipline. The accepted linguistics definition explicitly names 'psycholinguistics' among its named subdisciplines. Parallel to accepted edges: linguistics CONTAINS phonology, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, syntax, phonetics.
