Pinned sense: psycholinguistics as the subdiscipline of cognitive language processing.

The n-th spectral moment mu_n = sum_i(f_i^n * E_i) sums across ALL bins of the full spectrum, no band bounds. Its operand is the global per-bin energy vector - the accepted carve of spectral-distribution. Remove that vector and no moment can be computed. The band sub-vector is the wrong target for the full-spectrum general kind.

Excitation-signal is computed by applying inverse-filtering to an observed signal. Without the inverse-filtering algorithm (computing H_inv(z) = 1/H(z) and filtering the observed signal with it), there is no method to produce the excitation signal. The remove-the-target test: remove inverse-filtering → no recovery of the input signal → no excitation signal. This is the same dependency that glottal-flow has to inverse-filtering.

Law 9 test: spectral-distribution IS a per-bin-energy-vector at the full bin range — its accepted definition names the ordered N-tuple of bin energies covering all bins, and defines itself as 'the full-spectrum counterpart of spectral-band-distribution, which restricts the same vector to the bins within [f_low, f_high)'. The two constructs are instances of one shared vector construct distinguished only by bin range; per-bin-energy-vector is the nearest accepted kind. Pinned sense: the full-range per-bin energy tuple, not the descriptors computed from it.

Rhetoric as a practice contains narrative as a tool: the deployment of story and sequenced events is one of the core techniques within the rhetorical repertoire. Direction test: rhetoric is the broader practice that incorporates narrative as one of its methods. Narrative within rhetoric serves persuasion; narrative outside rhetoric serves other ends.

LPC computation requires the autocorrelation matrix as its core input: the Yule-Walker equations are solved via the Levinson-Durbin recursion applied to the signal's autocorrelation sequence. Remove autocorrelation and the LPC algorithm has no data to solve — the prediction coefficients cannot be computed. The definition carves this step explicitly. Operational dependency (Law 8b), distinct from the historical DERIVED_FROM that already records that autocorrelation predates LPC.

MFCCs operate on a power spectrum as their input: the short-time Fourier spectrum is converted to a power spectrum, then warped onto the mel scale and transformed. Remove the concept of power spectrum and MFCCs lose their input domain — there is no spectral energy representation to apply the mel filter bank to.

spectral-band-peak-to-average-ratio = peak_energy / mean_energy. The mean energy is exactly spectral-band-energy (arithmetic mean of per-bin energies in the band). Removing spectral-band-energy and the normalization by mean energy fails — PAR cannot be computed without the average energy reference.

Spectral-band-energy is the band-local variant of the global spectral-energy concept. The global spectral-energy summed over the full spectrum was the original construct; band-local versions constrain the summation to a frequency subrange [f_low, f_high]. The band version inherits the same mathematical definition but restricts scope.

Crest factor = max(|A_i|) / RMS(|A_i|). The peak amplitude is the first constitutive input to the crest factor formula — it came first and is required to compute crest factor. Without the peak concept, crest factor cannot be defined.

A formant IS a specific acoustic resonance — a peak in the speech spectrum corresponding to a vocal tract cavity resonance. Resonance is the accepted nearest kind (formant already has DEPENDS_ON and DERIVED_FROM to/from resonance), making this the missing INSTANCE_OF link on the kind ladder.

Cepstral mean-variance normalization (CMVN) is cepstral mean normalization (CMN) extended with variance normalization. CMN computes and subtracts the mean; CMVN adds division by the standard deviation. The removal test: removing CMN stops CMVN from operating, since CMVN is built on CMN's mean-subtraction step and extends it. You cannot have CMVN without CMN — CMN is the foundational operation.

Direction test (Law 9): discourse is a specific kind of linguistics — the subdiscipline studying language use beyond the sentence level, including conversation structure, coherence, and contextual meaning. A competent linguist calls discourse analysis "a part of linguistics" or "discourse linguistics." INSTANCE_OF runs specific→general, and linguistics is the nearest accepted kind. Pinned sense: discourse as the linguistics subdiscipline of language use in context.

Computing concentration (E_j / sum(E_i)) requires the total band energy (sum of all per-bin energies) as the denominator. Removing spectral-band-energy would eliminate access to the total energy value needed to compute the concentration ratio.

spectral-band-rolloff (frequency at which cumulative energy reaches a threshold fraction) derives from spectral-band-energy. The concept of cumulative energy relative to total band energy preceded the rolloff threshold construct. The DERIVED_FROM direction follows historical precedence: the total energy concept came first, then rolloff was defined as a threshold on its cumulative distribution.

The source-filter model decomposes speech into source and filter components, where the filter is the vocal tract transfer function that produces formants. Formants are peaks in the spectral envelope — the model's filter component is defined by its shaping of the spectral envelope. Remove spectral-envelope and the model's filter concept (formant shaping) has no structural framework to operate. The removal test passes.

Law 8d pinned sense: pitch as the prosodic feature speech-recognition pipelines analyze. The note states the actual relationship: SR systems compute pitch contours and prosodic features from the pitch percept for voicing, intonation, and prosody-aware recognition (the SR carve's feature-extraction stage); the maintained analytic feature is the servant of that analysis, not vice versa. Distinct from the F0->SR line already filed: pitch is the perceptual construct (the board keeps pitch and fundamental-frequency separate), and the pitch node holds no accepted SERVES edge. Consistent with the board's accepted feature-to-field SERVES texture (harmonicity, F0, pitch-class->SR/MIR in the same sitting). ADVANCE posture.

spectral-band-skewness IS the third central moment of spectral energy within a frequency band, measuring asymmetry of the energy distribution. It is a specific instance of spectral-band-moment (r=3, central moment). Nearest kind is spectral-band-moment.

The definition states computation from a windowed frame. Removing windowing would change the frame basis, but the metric can still operate on unwindowed frames with different spectral leakage. Windowing is a parameter choice, not a constitutive dependency. This edge should be struck, not filed.

PTR characterizes the peakedness of a spectrum — a core timbral dimension. High PTR indicates tonal, pitch-like timbre; low PTR indicates noise-like timbre. It serves timbre perception by quantifying the prominence of harmonic structure over the spectral floor.

Prosody is a subdomain of phonology — the study of suprasegmental features (stress, intonation, tone, rhythm). The accepted prosody definition carves it as a systematic framework of pitch, loudness, and duration patterns; this IS a phonological construct, just operating above the segmental level.

Spectral-band-energy = Σ E_i over the band bins. The remove-Y test: without the distribution vector (the per-bin energy values E_i), there is no array to sum over, and energy has no input. Removing distribution stops energy from operating.

Pinned sense: ERB serving music information retrieval. ERB is used in MIR to set perceptual filter spacing in auditory-based feature extraction — gammatone filter banks, bark-scale representations — for timbre classification, instrument recognition, and perceptual audio analysis. The ERB(f) formula determines the bandwidth of auditory channels that underlie these perceptually-aligned representations. SERVES direction: servant→beneficiary (Law 8d).

Spectral flatness is the ratio of geometric mean to arithmetic mean of the power spectrum values. It operates directly on the spectral-power-distribution P[k] as prod(P[k])^(1/N) / mean(P[k]). Removing the SPDF removes the distribution upon which flatness is computed. Constitutive dependency.

MFCC warps the frequency axis onto the mel scale before computing power spectrum and cepstral coefficients. Remove the mel-scale mapping and the MFCC pipeline cannot operate as defined. The mel-scale frequency warping is a constitutive step in the MFCC computation.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): vocabulary per its accepted definition — the structured inventory of the words and terms that a language, register, or discipline employs; word per its accepted definition — a discrete linguistic unit consisting of one or more morphemes, organized by convention to carry specific meaning. Directional test (CONTAINS runs whole→part): an inventory contains its items, and the vocabulary definition explicitly carves it as 'the structured inventory of words and terms' — the words it organizes are the constituent items of the whole. Remove the words and the inventory is empty: the whole is constituted by its items. The part is not dependent on the container for its operation (Law 8c: identity is not dependency) — word DEPENDS_ON language stands on its own, and words persist in use regardless of any inventory. The board has already ruled vocabulary a kind of catalog (vocabulary INSTANCE_OF catalog accepted); a catalog contains its entries. Direction whole→part is consistent with the accepted language CONTAINS vocabulary one level up.

Harmonicity quantifies the periodic vs noise-like quality of speech signals, used in speech-processing for voicing detection, speaker classification, and voice quality analysis. Removing harmonicity from speech-processing pipelines removes a feature that distinguishes periodic vocal-fold vibration from aperiodic fricatives and noise.

Formant frequencies are vocal tract resonances — they exist only because the vocal tract acts as an acoustic cavity with specific geometry. The removal test (Law 8b): remove the vocal tract and formant frequencies cease to exist. Formants are not independent acoustic phenomena; they are produced by and inseparable from the vocal tract filter. This is a constitutive dependency.

Historical linguistics studies language change across time. The removal test passes: remove chronology (the ordered sequence of temporal events) and historical linguistics loses its temporal dimension entirely, ceasing to operate as a discipline. Pinned sense: chronology as the framework of ordered temporal relations that makes historical analysis possible.

MFCCs operate in the mel-frequency domain: the mel-frequency concept defines the perceptual frequency scale that MFCCs use for their triangular filter bank and subsequent processing. Remove the concept of mel-frequency and MFCCs lose the domain in which they operate — there is no perceptual frequency scale to transform the spectrum onto.

Law 9, specific→general: spectral-octave-band IS a spectral-subband — its accepted definition states it is 'a frequency subband covering one octave (ratio 2:1 between upper and lower bounds)', a contiguous range [f_lo, f_hi] on the frequency axis, which is exactly what the accepted definition of spectral-subband carves (a contiguous index range [k_1,k_2] with f_lower = k_1·F_s/N, f_upper = (k_2+1)·F_s/N). The octave spacing (2:1 ratio) is the specific parameterization of the general subband; no intermediate kind exists between an octave band and a general subband. Pinned sense: the octave band as a frequency subband, not as a filter or a band-limited measure.

Direction tested (Law 9, specific to nearest accepted kind): per its accepted definition, spectral-sparseness is a dimensionless concentration index computed from the full-spectrum per-bin magnitudes (sum and sum-of-squares across all N bins), reducing the vector to a single scalar. It is a quantitative descriptor of the per-bin energy vector, matching spectral-feature's carved sense. It has no band bounds, so spectral-band-feature is not the nearest kind; spectral-feature is. Pinned sense: the concentration index over the per-bin energy vector.

LPC is fundamentally a linear algebra problem: solving the Yule-Walker equations via matrix inversion to estimate prediction coefficients. Without linear algebra, LPC has no computational mechanism. Law 8b removal test passes.

Spectral-band-distribution is a band-restricted per-bin energy vector. Its definition states the distribution is the ordered vector v = (|A_i|^2) for bins within [f_low, f_high). The full-spectrum spectral-distribution is the ordered vector v for all bins. Removing spectral-distribution (the full-spectrum substrate) removes the operational definition of how per-bin energies are obtained; the band construct cannot operate without the full-spectrum substrate mechanism. DEPENDS_ON removal test passes: without the full-spectrum distribution construct, the band distribution cannot be computed or stored as defined.
The constitutive input is the moment-to-moment distribution: removing it stops peak from being identifiable within the band

Auditory-filters are used in MIR as cochlear models for feature extraction (gammatone filter banks, bark-scale transforms). They serve MIR by providing perceptually-motivated spectral decomposition that better matches human hearing than linear FFT, used in timbre analysis, instrument classification, and audio retrieval systems.

Sociolect provides social-indexical linguistic resources that discourse actors deploy. The sociolect is built for the sake of enabling contextually appropriate discourse — speakers draw on sociolectal conventions to perform social positioning within discourse. SERVES: sociolect (resource/tool) → discourse (practice that uses it). Law 8d: servant points at master.

Spectral-band-spread computes σ = √(Σ(P_i·(f_i - μ₁)²)/Σ(P_i)), which is the square root of the second central moment of the frequency-weighted power distribution. The spread metric directly derives from the moment formalism — it is the square root of the second central moment, making moment computation its historical and computational source.

Spectral-band RMS is mathematically defined as the square root of the 2nd raw moment of the distribution. Remove the concept of moment and RMS loses its mathematical foundation — there is no moment framework from which to derive the RMS value. The removal test passes: RMS as a spectral concept operates within the moment framework.

Spectral leakage occurs when windowing a signal in time domain causes frequency-domain smearing: the DTFT of a windowed signal equals the circular convolution of the true spectrum with the window's DTFT. Removing the window-function concept eliminates the convolution mechanism that defines leakage — without a window function, there is no leakage to measure. The removal test passes.

Sense: temporal features as inputs to timbre analysis. Temporal descriptors (attack time, temporal centroid, spectral flux envelope) are fundamental to timbre perception — the temporal envelope defines the articulation character of a sound, distinct from its spectral content. Direction tested (Law 8d): temporal features exist for the sake of timbre classification and analysis, not vice versa.

spectral-tile arranges spectral data in a 2D time-frequency matrix, used for visual and computational audio analysis, source separation, and pattern recognition. It serves as the core data structure for audio feature extraction.

Spectral-band-flux measures frame-to-frame spectral change within a sub-band. This is a widely used feature in MIR for tasks including chord change detection, segment boundary identification, and timbral transition analysis. The construct exists to serve MIR systems that require temporal spectral change descriptors.

Evenness is the coefficient of variation of per-bin energy: σ/μ where μ is the first moment (mean) and σ is the square root of the second central moment (standard deviation). The concept was developed as a normalized moment-based descriptor enabling cross-band comparison independent of absolute energy level. Historical origin: moment theory in spectral analysis, where evenness/flatness metrics derive from the first and second moments of the energy distribution.

Spectral increase captures the temporal rise of spectral energy between consecutive frames. It is computed as the difference in total spectral energy across frames. Removing spectral energy eliminates the input data on which increase is computed.

Band entropy = Shannon entropy of the normalized per-bin energy shares within the sub-band: a scalar descriptor of the band's per-bin energy vector, the carved sense of band-feature. Not a moment; band-feature is the nearest accepted kind.

Spectral skewness is the third standardized moment (skewness) of the spectral-power-distribution. Skewness is a statistical property defined only over a distribution. Removing the SPDF removes the distribution that skewness describes. Constitutive dependency — the removal test passes.

spectral-band-mode identifies the frequency bin with the highest spectral energy within a band — the argmax of the band-limited energy histogram. The concept is directly derived from spectral-band-peak: the mode is the frequency (not the energy value) of the peak bin. The peak concept was established first as the maximum energy scalar; the mode extends it to return the bin index/frequency of that maximum. Historical origin: in spectral analysis, mode-based peak tracking (peak-picking algorithms) emerged as extensions of simple peak detection to track dominant frequencies across frames.

Spectral-difference computes |P(f,t)-P(f,t-1)| per bin. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the operand P(f,t) and P(f,t-1); the difference operation has no input and stops operating. Removal test passes.

DEPENDS_ON removal test on the pinned sense: the carve names parameter (1) as 'the glottal flow waveform g(n) — the inverse-filtering estimate of the glottal source', and the computation reads it directly (max_n g(n) per pitch-synchronous cycle). Remove glottal-flow and peak-flow has no waveform to take the maximum of — the defining operand is gone, so the measure stops operating. Same direct-operand anchor pattern as the family's accepted anchors (MFD on glottal-flow, voice-onset-time on glottal-flow, jitter/shimmer on pitch-tracking).

Law 9/9a, nearest accepted kind: PTR is a specific scalar spectral descriptor - a specific kind of spectral-feature, the accepted kind that carves quantitative descriptors of the spectrum. It is a NON-moment summary (mean(E_peak)/mean(E_trough); no order-r statistic), so it is not INSTANCE_OF spectral-moment, exactly as the board has ruled for its nearest relatives: spectral-par, spectral-crest, spectral-concentration, spectral-tenuity, spectral-sparseness all hold accepted INSTANCE_OF spectral-feature and none points at -moment. No intermediate kind exists between a specific scalar and spectral-feature, so no ladder leap. Same specific->general relationship as the 18 accepted band-scalar -> spectral-band-feature lines, at full scope.
Spectral flatness is used to evaluate and select whitening algorithms that aim for spectrally flat output. The purpose of whitening is to achieve spectral flatness.

spectral-band-energy (total energy in a frequency band) is a fundamental type of spectral feature. It is one of the basic descriptive statistics computed from spectral data, alongside moment-based descriptors and flatness measures.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): Cepstrum computation requires the STFT to produce the log-magnitude spectrum that the cepstrum operates on. Remove STFT and the cepstrum loses its computational mechanism — it cannot compute quefrency without the time-frequency decomposition STFT provides. Constitutive.

Cepstral-liftering operates by applying a window-like function in the quefrency domain to selectively smooth or accentuate cepstral coefficients. Its operational mechanism IS windowing — the liftering procedure is the application of a window in quefrency space. Removing windowing as a concept stops the liftering procedure from being defined: there is no quefrency-domain windowing without the windowing operation. The removal test passes.
flatness computes means over the per-bin energy values within the band; it requires the band energy substrate to compute the geometric mean and arithmetic mean
Pinned sense: spectral-band-kurtosis as fourth standardized moment. Removing moment formalism removes kurtosis computation; kurtosis is constitutive of moment-based family.

Pinned sense: gammatone-filter serving speech-processing. Gammatone-filter is reused as a transform in speech-processing front-ends, modeling cochlear frequency selectivity in auditory-based speech feature extraction (e.g. gammatone cepstral coefficients). It serves speech-processing as the auditory-periphery front-end in speech analysis pipelines. Teleological SERVES direction: servant→beneficiary (Law 8d). Distinct from DEPENDS_ON — gammatone-filter is used TO SUPPORT speech-processing tasks, not because removing speech-processing would stop the filter operating.

attack-time serves MIR for instrument recognition and audio retrieval. MIR systems use attack-time as a discriminative feature for instrument classification (percussive vs. bowed/struck vs. wind onset), serving similarity matching and classification tasks.

spectral-band-smoothness is the band-local version of the full-spectrum smoothness concept. Following the pattern established by spectral-band-flatness (DERIVED_FROM→spectral-flatness) and spectral-band-slope (DERIVED_FROM→spectral-slope), the band-local construct derives from its full-spectrum parent.

Source-filter-separation decomposes the input signal using inverse-filtering to recover the excitation component. Without inverse-filtering, the technique cannot compute e(n) = x(n) * H_inv(z) to separate source from filter. The removal test: removing inverse-filtering stops the technique from operating in its primary mode.

Spectral-band bandwidth measures the spread of the band distribution around its centroid. Remove the centroid concept and bandwidth loses its reference point — there is no center from which to measure spread. The removal test passes: bandwidth cannot operate without centroid.

Y existed first and fed into X. The global peak-normalized effective bandwidth (rectangular-pulse-equivalent width, sum(E)/max(E)*delta_f) is the older, more primitive construct of RF and spectroscopy practice; the band version is its direct descendant — the identical computation applied within a defined frequency band [f_low, f_high), with delta_f = (f_upper - f_lower)/N. The from-endpoint's accepted definition carries the same formula with the same parameters (the band bounds replacing the full spectral support). This is the correct global parent, not spectral-bandwidth (the centroid-spread second central moment), which shares no term with the formula.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): spectral-variance per its accepted definition = the SECOND CENTRAL MOMENT of the power spectrum over the frequency index (sigma^2 = (1/N) sum (P[k]-mu)^2); spectral-moment per its accepted definition = the family mu_n = sum f_i^n E_i, whose 'second central moment yields variance.' Law 9: is variance a specific kind of spectral-moment? Yes — it is the r=2 member of the family, exactly as the board already accepts for the band family (spectral-band-variance INSTANCE_OF spectral-band-moment, g539af; DERIVED_FROM line gfb0444). A competent speaker calls spectral variance a spectral moment of order 2. Nearest kind: spectral-moment (no intermediate kind exists; spectral-feature is one rung above and the leap through it is derivable once this rung stands, Law 11e). Not DERIVED_FROM: the question here is kind-membership, and the band family's accepted INSTANCE_OF precedent fixes the sense.

A mel-spectrum is a spectral representation obtained by applying the mel-frequency-scale to a power spectrum. The mel scale provides the frequency transformation; without it there is no mel-spectrum. The scale concept is prior: the spectrum is the result of applying that scale to spectral energy data.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): working-memory per its accepted definition — a bounded system for the temporary storage and manipulation of information (capacity-limited ~4±1 chunks, time-limited, domain-general, sustained by attentional control and rehearsal loops); memory per its accepted definition — structured retention and retrieval of information across time, parameterized by encoding, storage, retrieval, and fidelity. Directional test (CONTAINS runs whole→part): the memory system's storage parameter decomposes into its component stores — temporary (working) and durable (long-term) — and the court has already accepted working-memory as a kind of memory (INSTANCE_OF). Working memory is a component of the whole: it performs the temporary-storage-and-manipulation function the whole's storage parameter requires during complex cognition. Part, not identity (Law 8c): remove working memory and memory still operates — durable retention and retrieval across time persist — so this is part-of, not DEPENDS_ON. The board's subfield convention accepts both edge kinds on the same pair (syntax INSTANCE_OF linguistics and linguistics CONTAINS syntax are both accepted).

Law 8b removal test: VOT's defining endpoint is the first flow maximum — the first glottal closure of the glottal-flow waveform g(n). Without the glottogram there is no glottal-source onset to measure against, and the parameter stops being computable; the acoustic endpoint alone yields only half the interval. The glottogram is the carve's named operand, exactly as return-phase (g5e2734c6c6320ffb01d2d1d8, ACCEPTED) and the open/close quotients each anchor on the same accepted node. The other endpoint (acoustic voice onset) reads the raw speech signal, which is no carved construct on the board.

spectral-tile IS a spectral-feature (a numerical descriptor of frequency-domain structure). Its accepted definition: T[t,f] stores magnitude/power per time-frequency cell — this IS a measurable aspect of frequency-domain structure extracted from the spectral representation. The nearest accepted kind is spectral-feature (37 accepted instances). spectral-tile is a 2D variant of spectral descriptors, not a distinct kind.

spectral-band-flatness IS a specific kind of spectral-feature. It measures uniformity of energy distribution within a band via the geometric/arithmetic mean ratio. A competent speaker classifies it as a spectral feature (it's a numerical descriptor extracted from spectral representation that quantifies a measurable aspect of frequency-domain structure). Nearest kind: spectral-feature (no intermediate category between spectral-band-flatness and spectral-feature).

DEPENDS_ON removal test on the pinned sense: parameter (2) of the accepted definition is 'the fundamental period T0 from pitch tracking'; the return phase is computed 'within the period' — time from the flow maximum to the flow's return to baseline in that period. Remove pitch-tracking and the period segmentation stops, so the return phase cannot be located or measured. The same T0 pairing the family's accepted jitter and shimmer DEPENDS_ON pitch-tracking edges carry; distinct from the accepted glottal-flow edge, which names the signal-source pairing, not the period.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is psycholinguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its accepted definition, it is a disciplinary framework for mapping the mental representations and processes underlying language production, comprehension, and acquisition — a specific subfield of the general discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: psycholinguistics as the subdiscipline of cognitive language processing.

The cepstrum IS the sequence of cepstral coefficients: it is the DFT of the log power spectrum, yielding coefficients indexed by quefrency. Removing cepstral-coefficients as a concept means there is no construct for what the cepstrum computes. The removal test passes.

spectral-band-moment (r-th central moment of energy distribution within a band) IS a spectral feature — a family of quantifiable properties of spectral energy distribution within a band. A competent speaker classifies moment-based descriptors as spectral features. Nearest kind: spectral-feature (band-level moments are a specific class of spectral feature).

The magnitude spectrum is structurally derived from the power spectrum: magnitude = sqrt(power spectrum). Remove the power-spectrum concept and the magnitude spectrum loses its defining computational relationship — there is no power concept from which to derive magnitudes.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: asymmetry-coefficient's accepted definition lists T0 from pitch tracking as parameter (2). spectral-band-flatness computes the geometric/arithmetic mean ratio of per-bin energies within a band. Removing spectral-band-energy (the per-bin band energy) makes flatness inoperable: there are no Eᵢ values for the ratio computation.

Pinned sense (L11d): energy-envelope as a per-frame time series of signal energy - a numeric representation of signal content. It is a specific kind of representation: the board keeps amplitude-envelope INSTANCE_OF representation (and INSTANCE_OF envelope) accepted; the energy envelope is the energy-domain member of that family, with per-frame scalar readings. The DCT is a Fourier-related transform that uses a subset of the Fourier transform basis functions with specific symmetry conditions. The DCT computes real-valued frequency coefficients by exploiting the even-symmetry extension of input data, which is fundamentally a Fourier transform construction. Removing the Fourier transform concept eliminates the mathematical framework from which the DCT is derived.

Spectral-band spread (the standard deviation of energy around the band centroid frequency) quantifies how broadly energy is distributed across the band — a timbral descriptor of spectral width. A wide-spread band produces a diffuse, inharmonic timbre; a narrow spread produces a pure, tonal timbre.
SERVES: RMS energy provides magnitude measure across all bins, serving MIR for loudness estimation, segmentation, and audio classification.

Spectral-flatness is a standard MIR feature distinguishing tonal vs noise-like spectral content, used in speech/music classification, instrument recognition, and audio analysis. The spectral-flatness definition states it is implemented in DSP libraries and audio analysis software — MIR's core toolset. It serves MIR by providing the tonality-noise dimension for spectral classification. Direction servant→beneficiary.

The definition states cepstral-sequence represents characteristics in the cepstral domain. The sequence is parameterized by coefficient type (MFCC, DFT, DCT) — all defined within cepstral-domain. Removing the domain means losing the mathematical space of definition. Operand-level dependency.

Removal test: spectral-effective-bandwidth computes BW_eff = (sum(E_i) / max_i E_i) * delta_f over per-bin energies. Both sum_i E_i and max_i E_i operate directly on the per-bin energy vector, which is exactly spectral-distribution's carve. Remove spectral-distribution and the computation has no per-bin operands: it stops operating. Mirror pattern: spectral-band-concentration (band version) DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution, and the formula structure (ratio of sum to max) is analogous.
spectral-rms (root-mean-square amplitude of a power spectrum) IS A spectral-feature — a fundamental type of spectral statistic. Nearest accepted kind.

SERVES test: spectral-band-flatness = geometric-mean/arithmetic-mean ratio of per-bin energies measures how noise-like vs tonal the spectrum is within a band. It serves timbre characterization as a key correlate of roughness and brightness. Used in instrument classification and audio analysis for timbre discrimination.

The STFT produces time-varying spectral data from which the spectrogram (magnitude of STFT) is derived. The removal test: removing magnitude-spectrum eliminates the derived construct that depends on STFT output. However, this is the wrong direction — STFT does not depend on magnitude-spectrum; rather, magnitude-spectrum depends on STFT. Let me reconsider.

The bark-spectrogram computation requires bark-scale for its frequency axis warping step: converting linear-frequency bins to bark-scale units via Bark(f) = 13*arctan(0.00076*f) + 3.5*arctan((f/7500)^2). Without bark-scale as a functional transform, the bark-spectrogram cannot compute its defining frequency mapping. The removal test: removing bark-scale eliminates the bark-spectrogram's ability to produce its output.
Concentration is a normalized ratio of bin energy to band total, a specific quantifiable property of spectral energy structure. Spectral-feature is the nearest accepted kind.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: the glottal-cycle measurement construct is computed from the glottal-flow waveform g(n) and the fundamental period T0; removing glottal-flow removes the data from which the glottal-cycle phases (opening, closed, closing) and its parameters (open quotient, asymmetry coefficient, return phase) are extracted, so the construct stops operating.

Stress as a linguistic phenomenon depends on the prosodic framework — it is realized through prosodic mechanisms (pitch, duration, intensity variation) and functions within prosodic organization. Without the prosodic system that provides prominence dimensions, stress as a linguistic contrast cannot operate.

The accepted definition of cepstral-sequence uses 'cepstrum' as its formal name. The sequence maps coefficients c[1..N] from the cepstrum — the quefrency-domain representation produced by the cepstrum transform. Removal test (Law 8b): removing the cepstrum means there is no quefrency-domain representation to sequence. The sequence's elements are defined as elements of the cepstrum. Operand-level structural dependency.

Removal test (Law 8b), full-spectrum sense pinned: spread = sqrt( sum_i E_i (f_i - c)^2 / sum_i E_i ), c = sum_i f_i E_i / sum_i E_i. Every operand — the per-bin energies E_i and the centroid c built from them — is read directly from the full per-bin energy vector that spectral-distribution carves (all N bins, unbounded by any sub-band). Remove the vector and spread stops operating. This is the same anchor shape as the accepted band-side edges (spectral-band-spread DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution; its siblings DEPENDS_ON their distributions) — filed against the full-spectrum counterpart because the band-limited vector (spectral-band-distribution, defined over [f_low, f_high)) cannot serve the whole-spectrum measure: its bounds are a parameter of the band, not of the full spectrum. Not chronology (the two constructs stand or fall together), not identity, not purpose.

Spectral-band-slope computes the regression slope of log10(E[i]) against frequency within a band. The E[i] values are per-bin spectral-band-energy (squared magnitudes within the band). Remove spectral-band-energy and the slope has no data to regress — the removal test passes. Direction: newer (slope epoch 0.02) depends on older (band-energy epoch 0.01).

DEPENDS_ON removal test on the pinned sense: the carve names parameter (1) as 'the glottal flow waveform g(n) — the inverse-filtering estimate of the glottal source', and the computation reads it directly (max |g(n+1) - g(n)| per cycle). Remove glottal-flow and MFD has no waveform to differentiate — the defining operand is gone, so the measure stops operating. Same direct-operand pattern as the accepted closure-quotient→glottal-flow, open-quotient→glottal-flow, and glottal-to-noise-ratio→pitch-tracking (T0 as operand 2 here, framed per cycle).

DEPENDS_ON test: remove spectral-band-moment now stops spectral-band-concentration operating. Concentration via exp(-H) requires distribution moments for normalization; without moment formalism the concentration metric cannot be computed consistently.

temporal-centroid serves MIR for tempo estimation and beat tracking. MIR systems use the energy envelope centroid to locate the temporal balance point of musical segments, serving rhythmic analysis and structure segmentation.

In speech processing, the excitation signal is the residual waveform r(n)=x(n)-x_hat(n) obtained by inverse-filtering the speech signal through the vocal-tract filter — the per-sample error between the observed speech and its model-based reconstruction. It is a speech-specific instance of the general residual-signal construct.

The electroglottogram tracks the open/close cycle of the glottis and provides the measured waveform from which voice-quality parameters (contact quotient, open quotient, closure quotient) are derived. It serves as the foundational measured signal that voice-quality parameter computation operates on.

Cepstral-sequence encodes coefficients as a fixed-length vector for speech processing pipelines. Scope states it enables pattern recognition and feature extraction in speech/audio processing. MFCC (core feature rep in speech recognition) is a coefficient type in its definition. By Law 8d, it serves speech-processing — designed for that discipline's use.

MFCC (Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients) are computed from the log of the power spectrum values mapped through a mel filterbank. The mel filterbank operates on the spectral-power-distribution. Removing SPDF removes the power distribution that MFCCs are derived from. Constitutive.

Pinned sense: the accepted open-quotient carve computes OQ from the frame-aligned glottal-flow waveform g(n) and T0 — the open phase is read off the glottogram between Fmax and Fmin. Removal test (Law 8b): remove the glottal-flow estimate and there is no waveform to measure an open phase from, so OQ stops operating in the pinned sense. Not chronology (the measure postdates the estimate's role, which would argue DERIVED_FROM), not identity (the ratio is not the waveform), not purpose.

SERVES runs servant to beneficiary: contact-area is a core physiological parameter used in speech analysis toolkits for voice-disorder assessment, vocal tract modeling, and articulatory synthesis. Speech-processing systems that analyze or synthesize speech based on vocal fold mechanics depend on contact-area measurements.

DEPENDS_ON test: remove spectral-band-moment now stops spectral-band-evenness operating. Evenness = 1 - sigma/mu, sigma = sqrt(second central moment), mu = first moment. Without moment computation, evenness cannot be computed.

DERIVED_FROM (Law 7): the full-spectrum coefficient-of-variation formula (sigma/mu over all per-bin energies) is the historical origin — the band variant computes the same ratio over bins within [f_low, f_high); the general form existed first and fed the band-limited one, matching the accepted band-variant pattern (e.g., spectral-band-par DERIVED_FROM spectral-par).

Spectral-kurtosis quantifies the tailedness of a spectral distribution — whether energy concentrates in sharp peaks or is spread with heavy tails. This is a timbral dimension: instruments with sharp spectral peaks sound different from those with spread energy. It serves timbre analysis by providing the higher-order spectral shape measure that complements centroid (brightness) and bandwidth (sharpness). Direction servant→beneficiary.

Aliasing is the phenomenon described by Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorem. The theorem defines the precise condition (sampling rate > 2× bandwidth) under which aliasing is avoided. Removing the sampling-theorem from the conceptual framework would stop aliasing from being understood as a precise mathematical condition rather than a vague error. The aliasing concept structurally depends on the sampling-theorem for its definitional content.

Onset-strength is the time-varying feature function that onset-detection algorithms operate on. The accepted definition of onset-detection states it extracts 'a time-varying energy or spectral feature' and onset-strength is precisely that per-frame scalar — spectral flux, energy difference, etc. The onset-detection algorithm depends on onset-strength as its input signal.

The cepstral-lifter applies a window function to cepstral coefficients in the quefrency domain. Its operational mechanism IS the windowing function (e.g. rectangular, exponential, cosine-tapered lifter). Without the windowing function, the lifter has no mechanism for selective attenuation and cannot operate. The removal test passes.

SERVES beneficiary: excitation-signal is the residual waveform obtained by removing a system transfer function. In speech analysis, it IS the glottal-flow waveform — the core construct used for voice-quality parameter extraction, source-filter analysis, and acoustic modeling. The entire purpose of computing excitation-signal in the speech domain is to serve speech-processing applications.

Removal test (Law 8b) against both accepted definitions: pitch-detection's accepted definition carves its operating purpose as 'a computational technique that estimates the fundamental frequency (F0) of a periodic or quasi-periodic signal,' with algorithm classes (autocorrelation, cepstral, FFT-based, hybrid, learning-based) that are all F0-estimation methods and an output resolution in hertz of the F0 estimate. fundamental-frequency's accepted definition carves F0 as 'the lowest frequency of a periodic waveform' and persists through exactly these estimation algorithms (YIN, SWIPE, pYIN) and pitch-tracking conventions. Remove fundamental-frequency - the periodic cycle rate the method locks onto - and pitch-detection stops operating: the peak-picking has nothing to lock onto and the output (the F0 estimate, the pitch contour) ceases to exist. Not mere sayability: the mechanism presupposes the periodic cycle rate as the structure it measures. Not identity (Law 8c): F0 is the quantity estimated, not the technique renamed. Not purpose (Law 8d). Same accepted shape as pitch-tracking DEPENDS_ON fundamental-frequency (ACCEPTED; the time-varying twin carves the identical 'estimates the fundamental frequency (F0)' purpose), and the same test as formant-tracking DEPENDS_ON formant (pending, filed by me). Not DERIVED_FROM: the F0 concept is the object estimated, not a historical source - the technique's historical line is already filed as DERIVED_FROM signal-processing. Pinned senses: pitch-detection as the F0-estimation technique (accepted definition); fundamental-frequency as the lowest frequency of a periodic waveform (accepted definition).

SERVES beneficiary: source-filter-separation is a technique for decomposing speech signals into source and filter components. Its primary application domain is speech analysis — separating glottal excitation from vocal-tract resonance. The technique serves the field of speech-processing by enabling source-specific analysis, voice disorder assessment, and speech synthesis pipelines.

Direction tested (Law 9, specific to nearest accepted kind): per its accepted definition, spectral-peak-position is the frequency-bin index (or Hz) of the maximum spectral-energy magnitude within a spectrum or subband, with parameters search_range and resolution — a numerical descriptor extracted from the signal's spectral representation that quantifies a measurable aspect of its frequency-domain structure (the location of the dominant resonant component). That is exactly what spectral-feature's accepted definition carves. Nearest accepted kind: no accepted kind entry stands between it and spectral-feature; the 29 accepted siblings all run to the same kind. Not a leap: nothing on the ladder already reaches it.

Cepstral-sequence is defined in terms of cepstral coefficients computed via DCT (discrete cosine transform) of the log power spectrum. The persistence mechanism maps coefficient type to DCT-based computation. Removing dct eliminates the transform used to produce the coefficients — the sequence cannot be generated. Present-tense constitutive dependency per removal test.

spectral-band-smoothness (sum of sqrt of per-bin energies normalized) derives from spectral-band-energy. The band energy concept preceded the smoothness statistic — smoothness is a transformation of the per-bin energy values relative to the band energy total.

Narrative is a specific kind of discourse: it is discourse organized around a sequence of events with a structured temporal arc. Direction test for INSTANCE_OF (Law 9/11e): narrative is a subtype of discourse, distinguished by its sequential event structure and temporal organization. All narratives are discourse, but not all discourse is narrative.

Spectral-envelope is the smooth curve tracing peak amplitudes across frequencies. It is computed by signal processing algorithms (smoothing of the magnitude spectrum, interpolation, etc.). Remove signal-processing and spectral-envelope has no computational method to exist or be derived. The removal test passes.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is corpus-linguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its definition, it is an approach to linguistics that studies language patterns through systematic analysis of large, representative collections of real-language data — a specific methodological framework within the discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: corpus-linguistics as the empirical subdiscipline studying language through annotated text collections and statistical analysis.
spectral-band-variance is the second central moment of spectral energy within a band. A competent speaker classifies it as an instance of spectral-band-moment. Nearest kind is spectral-band-moment.

Spectral phase computes arg(X[f,t]) from the STFT output. Removing stft means there are no complex STFT coefficients from which to extract the angular component. The removal test passes: without stft, spectral-phase has no input and stops operating.
temporal-centroid as analytic operand in speech-recognition onset/segmentation. SR pipelines compute temporal centroid of the energy envelope to locate acoustic event boundaries.

Rhetoric as the art and study of effective communication contains argument as a core component: the structured deployment of claims with support is the mechanism by which rhetorical persuasion operates. Direction test: rhetoric is the broader discipline/practice that encompasses argument; argument is a part of rhetoric, not the other way around. Rhetoric CONTAINS argument because argument is one of the tools within the rhetorical repertoire.

The accepted definition of cepstral-domain states it is 'Constructed by: (1) computing the power spectrum of a signal via FFT; (2) taking the natural log of each frequency bin's magnitude; (3) applying the inverse Fourier transform.' Logarithm is a constitutive operand — without it, the representation space ceases to exist.

Spectral band energy is the sum of spectral energy within a specific frequency band, a localized version of total spectral energy. Removing spectral-energy eliminates the concept of energy at each frequency bin from which band energy is computed, so the construct cannot operate without it.

Spectral tenuity = peak magnitude divided by mean magnitude across active bins. The mean magnitude requires per-bin magnitude values across the spectrum — the spectral-magnitude vector. But tenuity operates on energies (|A|^2) to compute its ratio, and the definition explicitly references the spectral energy distribution across bins. Remove the per-bin energy vector (spectral-distribution) and there is no per-bin data to compute peak or mean. The spectral-energy dependency captures the total scalar but not the per-bin structure needed to compute the ratio. Pinned sense: the peak-to-mean energy ratio computed over the per-bin energy vector.

Spectral peak rolloff is the frequency below which a cumulative percentage of the peak-weighted spectral energy is contained. It requires spectral-peak to identify the peak region over which energy is accumulated; removing spectral-peak eliminates the peak detection that rolloff computation requires.

Spectral-flow tracks evolution of spectral energy distribution across frames; its energy distribution is defined over subbands. Removing subband partitioning removes the band structure the flow measures, so operation stops.

Spectral-band-centroid is the weighted mean of frequencies, where weights are per-bin energy values. Computed as Σ(f[i] × E[i]) / Σ(E[i]). The denominator Σ(E[i]) IS spectral-band-energy. Without energy computation, the normalizing sum is undefined and centroid is uncomputable.

Speech acts are a fundamental pragmatics construct. The pragmatic function of language — how utterances perform actions (promises, declarations, requests) — is exactly what speech-act theory studies. This IS a pragmatics-level construct, not a generic "language" dependency.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-flux computes the rate of change of total spectral energy between consecutive frames. The flux calculation requires the actual per-bin energy vector E[i] within the band to compute delta = E[t] - E[t-1]. This operates on the distribution, not on a scalar aggregate.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-mode identifies the most frequently occurring energy value among spectral bins within the band. This requires analyzing the full per-bin energy distribution vector E[i], not just a scalar aggregate.

Spectral-band-rms is the band-local variant of the global spectral-rms. The global RMS computed over the full spectrum established the construct; the band version applies the same RMS computation over a frequency subrange [f_low, f_high]. Historical precedence: spectral-rms as a full-spectrum descriptor predates its sub-band specialization.

The cepstral-transform produces the cepstral coefficients that are then arranged into a sequence. The definition of cepstral-sequence explicitly describes the output as vectors of cepstral coefficients, and the transform is the procedure that produces those coefficients. The transform came first conceptually — you need the coefficients before you can order them into a sequence. DERIVED_FROM captures this generative lineage: transform → coefficients → sequence.

Chroma features are core MIR descriptors representing pitch-class energy distributions. MIR systems deploy chroma vectors for chord recognition, key finding, and harmonic analysis — operational use where chroma serves MIR by providing the fundamental spectral-pitch representation for these tasks.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): spectral-crest-factor per its accepted definition = max |X[k_max]| / RMS(|X|) over all bins — a dimensionless scalar ratio of peak-to-RMS magnitude of the full spectrum. A numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's magnitude spectrum that captures a measurable aspect of frequency-domain structure (peak concentration relative to the spectral RMS). The band-local analogue spectral-band-crest-factor is already INSTANCE_OF spectral-band-feature; crest-factor's own definition names it a dimensionless descriptor computed per frame. spectral-feature is its nearest accepted kind.

Skewness = E[(X-μ)^3] / σ^3 requires σ (standard deviation, square root of variance) as a computational prerequisite. Removing spectral-band-variance means spectral-band-skewness cannot be computed — the formula depends on variance as its denominator component.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-bandwidth is the span between the lowest and highest bin frequencies that carry significant energy in a band. Computing this requires the per-bin energy vector (spectral-band-distribution) to determine which bins are significant. Without the distribution, bandwidth cannot be defined.

Law 8d for-whose-sake on the pinned sense: glottal-flow (the inverse-filtered glottal-flow waveform g(n)) is the non-member input to the voice-quality family. The family's accepted carve lists source-contact measures derived from the electroglottographic or glottal-flow signal, and the family's accepted members (open-quotient, closure-quotient, return-phase, asymmetry-coefficient, voice-onset-time) each hold an accepted DEPENDS_ON glottal-flow reading their values off g(n). The waveform is built and maintained for the sake of that parameter family: servant to beneficiary. This is the same accepted posture as the ruling glottogram SERVES voice-quality (g96e6ba3): a non-member input waveform serves the family; a MEMBER of the family is typed INSTANCE_OF, not SERVES (which is why the member-to-family SERVES edges in this cluster are struck, not this one). The removal test is not the right test here - the beneficiary test of Law 8d is.

Spectral-band moments (2nd, 3rd, 4th) are central moments computed about the centroid (mean of the distribution). Remove the centroid concept and higher-order moments lose their reference point — there is no center about which to compute deviations. The removal test passes: moments cannot operate without centroid as their anchor.

Premeditation is deliberation performed in advance of an action. Direction test for DEPENDS_ON (Law 2b/8b): remove deliberation and premeditation ceases to operate — premeditation IS deliberation (the forward-looking kind), so without the capacity to deliberate, premeditation cannot exist. The dependency is definitional: premeditation derives its operation from the general capacity for deliberation, applied temporally.

INTONATION operates through F0 contours: the definition explicitly carves 'the way fundamental frequency rises and falls across the duration of an utterance.' F0 is the physical substrate that intonation patterns modulate. Removal test: remove F0 and intonation loses its mechanism — pitch contours have no physical referent. Not DERIVED_FROM (F0 is the object of operation, not a historical source). Not identity (F0 is the quantity being patterned, not the pattern itself). Direction: intonation depends on F0; F0 operates independently without intonation.

Chroma features encode pitch-class energy distributions — the fundamental signal for tonality analysis. Music analysis systems use chroma vectors to estimate key, chord sequences, and tonal stability. The chroma feature serves tonality by providing the spectral representation from which tonal structure is extracted.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): historical-linguistics per its accepted definition as a disciplinary framework for reconstructing diachronic change in language systems from attested corpora. DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): remove language — the language systems that historical linguistics reconstructs and the attested corpora it uses — and the discipline loses its entire domain. Without language there are no diachronic changes to reconstruct, no attested corpora, no comparative method, no sound change laws. The discipline's operations have nothing to operate on. Object-level dependency on language. Sibling precedent: morphology DEPENDS_ON language, phonology DEPENDS_ON language.
Pinned sense: spectral-band-crest-factor as peak-to-RMS ratio. Removing moment formalism removes RMS computation (second moment); crest factor is constitutive of moment-based statistics.

spectral-phase IS a spectral-feature (a numerical descriptor of frequency-domain structure). Its accepted definition: the angular component φ[k,t] = arg(X[k,t]) of the STFT, a measurable aspect of the signal frequency-domain structure. The nearest accepted kind is spectral-feature. spectral-phase is a specific descriptor of spectral structure, not a distinct kind.

The mel-frequency spectrogram is computed by applying a mel-scale filterbank to the spectrogram and downsampling. The removal test: removing spectrogram eliminates the input to the mel filterbank — without the spectrogram as input, the mel-spectrogram cannot be computed. The mel filterbank operates ON the spectrogram; it is a transformation of it, not an independent construct.

Pinned sense: the Hilbert transform operates as a frequency-domain operator with transfer function H(f) = -j·sgn(f). Discrete implementation requires the DFT (or FFT) as its computational core — the transform's operative definition IS a phase multiplier in the DFT domain. Remove DFT and the Hilbert transform has no computational mechanism.

Spectral-crest computes the ratio of peak bin magnitude |X[k]| to mean across all bins. It operates directly on the power spectrum or magnitude spectrum P[k]/|X[k]|; removing power-spectrum eliminates the input values it aggregates. Constitutive dependency — the construct's computation is defined over P[k].

Memory as a cognitive capacity contains recall as a core process: the act of retrieving stored information is one of the fundamental operations of memory. Direction test for CONTAINS: memory is the broader capacity that encompasses encoding, storage, and recall; recall is a distinct component process within the memory system. The mechanism of recall (retrieval from storage) operates as part of the general memory function.

Spectral slope computes the gradient of spectral energy across frequency bins: slope = Σ(k-μ)(P[k]-μ_P) / Σ(k-μ)² where P[k] is the power spectrum. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the spectral shape from which slope is computed. The removal test passes.

Grammar as a linguistic system comprises several component sub-systems: phonology, morphology, syntax, and semantics. Phonology (the study of sound patterns) is literally a part within the grammatical system — one of its core components. Whole-and-part relation: grammar CONTAINS phonology as a constitutive sub-system.

An argument is a structured reasoning construct consisting of premises and a conclusion. Premises ARE literal parts of an argument — the supporting claims that, together with the conclusion, constitute the argument's structure. Remove the premises and the argument collapses; they are constitutive components within the whole. Whole-and-part relation: argument CONTAINS premise.

Cepstral peak prominence is computed from the log magnitude spectrum; the logarithm is a constitutive operand — removing the logarithm operation (computing cepstrum from raw magnitude spectrum) stops the construct from operating. The accepted definition explicitly specifies 'log magnitude spectrum' as the input to the cepstral computation.

Removal test (Law 8b): historical-linguistics' accepted definition carves its object as 'reconstructing diachronic change in language systems from attested corpora.' Remove language and the discipline has no subject matter — no language systems to reconstruct, no sound change laws to state, no attested corpora to analyze. It ceases to operate as a discipline. Same shape as the accepted morphology DEPENDS_ON language: subdiscipline depends on its carved subject matter.

Cepstral-distance measures spectral shape dissimilarity. Its primary application is speaker recognition/identification — comparing cepstral vectors to distinguish speakers. It serves the speaker construct by enabling speaker comparison and recognition.

Spectral-envelope is the smooth amplitude profile of a signal's spectrum. The cepstral-envelope definition states it is 'extracted from cepstral coefficients by applying low-pass liftering.' The spectral-envelope as a concept — the general idea of smoothing the spectral envelope — operates by being instantiated through cepstral coefficients. Removing the cepstral-coefficients removes the mechanism by which the cepstral-envelope variant of spectral-envelope operates. But more precisely, the cepstral-envelope IS the spectral-envelope extracted via cepstral means — without cepstral coefficients, there is no cepstral-envelope and the cepstral pathway to spectral-envelope ceases to operate.

spectral-density (ESD = |X(f)|², PSD = F{R(τ)}) IS a property of the spectral representation. Remove spectral-representation and there are no Fourier coefficients X(f) or autocorrelation to transform — the density measure has no operand. Not identity, not purpose.

Spectral-band kurtosis quantifies the peakedness or flatness of energy distribution within a frequency band. This peakedness discriminates musical content — tonal sounds produce peaked spectral energy (high kurtosis) while noise has flatter distributions (low kurtosis) — a fundamental MIR classification signal.

The discrete cosine transform (DCT) computes real-valued frequency coefficients using discrete sinusoidal basis functions — specifically, it applies the discrete Fourier transform to a real symmetric extension of the input. Removing the concept of discrete fourier transform stops the DCT from having its defining mathematical operation. The DCT IS a variant of the DFT; without DFT as a foundation, the DCT has no operational meaning.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-kurtosis is the fourth standardized moment of the per-bin energy values within the band. It is computed as Σ((E[i]−μ)/σ)⁴/N where E[i], μ, σ are derived from the spectral-band-distribution (per-bin energy vector). Removing the distribution removes the values on which kurtosis is computed, making it undefined.

Following the established precedent of attack-time→timbre and temporal-centroid→timbre: decay-time is the counterpart temporal descriptor of the amplitude envelope. It quantifies the release phase of spectral energy, which contributes directly to timbre perception (e.g., distinguishing percussive from sustained sounds). Timbre analysis uses decay-time as a discriminative temporal feature.

Band spread = the energy-weighted standard deviation of bin frequencies about the band centroid: a scalar dispersion descriptor of the band's per-bin energy vector, the carved sense of band-feature. Pinned sense: the spread as the square-root statistic of the second central moment, not the moment itself (no order-r parameter in its definition), so band-moment is not its kind and band-feature is the nearest accepted kind.
return-phase is computed from the glottal-flow waveform g(n) and the fundamental period T0: removing glottal-flow removes the waveform the phase measures, stopping return-phase from operating.

critical-band is the psychoacoustic concept informing auditory-filter parameterization and filter-bank design in speech processing systems. Speech processing uses critical-band-based spectral analysis (e.g., Bark-scale feature extraction) as an operational component of speech recognition and enhancement pipelines.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): psycholinguistics per its accepted definition as a disciplinary framework for mapping the mental representations and processes underlying language production, comprehension, and acquisition. DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): remove language — the mental representations and processes that psycholinguistics maps — and the discipline loses its entire domain. Without language there are no production/comprehension/acquisition processes to study, no lexical access patterns, no syntactic parsing, no processing models, no developmental stages. The discipline's operations collapse. Object-level dependency on language. Sibling precedent: morphology DEPENDS_ON language, phonology DEPENDS_ON language.

Spectral-band-bandwidth is the band-local variant of the global spectral-bandwidth concept. The global construct measures the effective width of spectral energy; the band version restricts the computation to a frequency subrange [f_low, f_high]. Historical precedence: the global bandwidth descriptor was established before analysts specialized it into sub-band versions.

Removal test: spectral-kurtosis v2 computes kurtosis = E[(P - μ)⁴] / E[(P - μ)²]² over per-bin power values P. These per-bin values are exactly spectral-distribution's per-bin energy vector. Remove spectral-distribution and kurtosis has no per-bin operands: the computation stops. Mirror pattern: spectral-band-kurtosis DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution is accepted. Full-spectrum kurtosis needs the full-spectrum distribution.

Chromagram is a time-frequency representation that bins spectral energy into mel-warped frequency bands per frame. It is computed from power spectrum values by applying mel-scale filterbank weights and summing energy per band. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the input data — chromagram has no energy values to bin. Present-tense constitutive dependency per removal test.
Pitch-class distribution is computed by projecting the power spectrum onto musical pitch class bins. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the spectral energy data that gets binned into pitch classes.

Spectral-band-mode is the frequency bin with the highest energy in a spectral band. It is computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution vector: the mode is the index i that maximizes E_i among the distribution's per-bin energy values. Historically and computationally, the distribution must exist first; the mode is a reduction operation finding the argmax of that vector. The distribution is the historical/computational source.

Flux measures the frame-to-frame rate of change of the spectrum. This temporal variation is a timbral attribute — it quantifies how quickly a sound s timbral character changes over time, which is essential for describing dynamic timbre (attack, tremolo, vibrato). The construct exists to serve timbre characterization.
Spectral kurtosis operates on a power spectrum S[k]. Removing power-spectrum stops kurtosis from operating as a spectral statistic.

spectral-band-flatness (geometric_mean / arithmetic_mean of per-bin energies) derives from spectral-band-energy. The arithmetic mean of per-bin energies is spectral-band-energy. The flatness concept depends historically on the band energy construct — it normalizes per-bin energies relative to the total band energy.

Removal test (Law 8b): sociolinguistics' accepted definition carves its object as 'mapping systematic correlations between linguistic variation and social structure.' Remove language and the discipline has no subject matter — no linguistic variables to correlate with social structure. It ceases to operate as a discipline. Same shape as the accepted morphology DEPENDS_ON language: subdiscipline depends on its carved subject matter.

Spectral-onset computes frame-to-frame difference of power spectrum P[k,t], which is |X[k]|² — the square of spectral magnitude. Removing spectral-magnitude eliminates the fundamental input; power spectrum is derived from magnitude, so removing magnitude collapses the entire pipeline. Present-tense constitutive dependency per removal test.

Removal test (Law 8b) against the filed carve. The accepted dialect definition carves a dialect as 'a variety OF A LANGUAGE distinguished by systematic differences in phonology, lexicon, and grammar' — its genus is language, and its own parameters are parameters of a sign system: (1) phonological — sound patterns and pronunciation conventions; (2) lexical — vocabulary items; (3) grammatical — syntactic structures and morphological patterns. Remove language now (the maintained system of symbolic signs) and 'a variety of a language' has no genus to vary: what remains is idiosyncratic vocalization without shared conventions, and none of the dialect's parameters — sound conventions, vocabulary items, syntactic structures — can be distinguished, since they are distinguished against the shared system. The construct stops operating, not merely stops being sayable: the variety is a unit of the sign system, exactly as utterance, phrase, and speech-act are. Same accepted shape as speech-act DEPENDS_ON language and discourse DEPENDS_ON language, both standing; dialect INSTANCE_OF language (accepted) marks the kind, this edge marks the operation. Direction check: language operates without the notion of dialect (a language stands even where no regional variety is carved), so the dependency runs dialect→language, not the reverse. Pinned sense (Law 11d): dialect as a variety of a language per its filed carve.

The cepstral-envelope is constructed by applying low-pass liftering to cepstrum-coefficients. The envelope IS a sequence of values derived from each cepstrum-coefficient — the low-quefrency coefficients that survive the lifter. Removing individual cepstrum-coefficients stops the envelope from having the values it smooths into an envelope. The removal test passes: without the coefficient values, no envelope can be constructed.

Removal test (Law 8b): the accepted definition of vocoder carves its first operating parameter as 'the analysis stage decomposing the signal into components - classically a glottal source plus a vocal-tract filter, in spectral vocoders a frame of STFT magnitude and phase', with the transmitted parameter set being 'spectral envelope plus excitation, or per-frame spectral coefficients'. STFT frames and spectral coefficients are the output of exactly the practice spectral-analysis's accepted definition names: decomposing a signal into its constituent frequency components via a mathematical transform (Fourier, wavelet, STFT). Remove spectral-analysis - the transform-based decomposition into frequency components - and the vocoder loses its analysis stage: there is no mechanism left to produce the parametric representation, and the synthesis stage (parameter 3) has nothing to reconstruct from. The technique stops operating, not merely stops being sayable. Not DERIVED_FROM: spectral-analysis is not a historical source of the vocoder (the founding lines are the Fletcher source-filter vocoders and the phase vocoder); this is present-tense operational dependence. Precedent: both accepted nearest subkinds already hold this exact edge - phase-vocoder DEPENDS_ON spectral-analysis and formant-vocoder DEPENDS_ON spectral-analysis (both ACCEPTED) - the general kind carries the edge its accepted members carry. Pinned senses: vocoder as the analyze-manipulate-resynthesize technique with spectral parametric representation (accepted definition); spectral-analysis as the transform-based frequency decomposition practice (accepted definition).

Spectral-band-smoothness (continuity measure of per-bin energy changes within a sub-band) IS a spectral feature — a specific quantifiable property of spectral energy structure within a frequency band. A competent speaker classifies it as a spectral feature. Nearest kind: spectral-feature (no intermediate category between smoothness and spectral-feature). Sense: spectral-band-smoothness as a spectral feature category for audio analysis and classification.

Spectral-band-centroid computes the weighted-mean frequency using band energies as weights: Σ(f_i * E_i) / ΣE_i. The E_i values ARE spectral-band-energy. Remove spectral-band-energy and the centroid has no weights to compute with — the removal test passes. Direction: newer (centroid epoch 0.01) depends on older (band-energy epoch 0.01).

The mel scale maps frequencies to a perceptual scale using the formula: mel = 2595 * log10(1 + f/700). This logarithmic transformation is constitutive of the mel scale itself — removing the concept of logarithm stops the mel scale from having its defining mathematical operation. The mel scale IS defined by this logarithmic mapping; without logarithm it has no operational meaning.

Cepstral-coefficients are the coefficients used in speech recognition and audio processing. They are computed via cepstrum analysis which involves matrix operations and linear algebra techniques. Remove linear-algebra and cepstral-coefficients cannot be computed. The removal test passes.

Law 9/9a: spectral-band-peak-trough-ratio is a specific scalar spectral-band descriptor quantifying peak-to-trough energy contrast within a band. spectral-band-feature is the nearest accepted kind. No intermediate kind exists. Same pattern as the 26 accepted spectral-band-* -> spectral-band-feature INSTANCE_OF edges.

Formant detection operates on power spectrum peaks — the peaks in the spectral envelope that correspond to resonant frequencies. Removing power-spectrum stops formant extraction since formants ARE spectral peaks. Constitutive operational dependency.

Spectral envelope is the smooth curve that traces the peaks of the magnitude spectrum. Removing magnitude-spectrum stops the spectral-envelope from having any data to trace — there is no spectral content to envelope.

Morphology studies word formation and the structure of words from morphemes. Lexicon is the stored inventory of words and morphemes that morphology operates upon. Removal test: remove the lexicon and morphology has no material to analyze or combine — no stored forms to decompose or build. The dependency is constitutive: morphology is the study and manipulation of lexically stored morphological material.

Prosody is a phonetic phenomenon that operates only through spoken language. Removing speech-processing (the cognitive mechanism for perceiving, producing, and interpreting speech) would stop prosody from operating — prosody depends on the capacity for speech processing as its operational substrate.

Band flux = the frame-to-frame absolute difference of the band's per-bin energies, summed: a scalar descriptor computed from the band-local energy vector (across two consecutive frames), the carved sense of band-feature. Its temporal parameter does not move it out of the family; nearest accepted kind: band-feature.
Variance is a moment-to-moment statistic of the distribution: removing the distribution concept stops variance from being a meaningful measurement

Spectral-band centroid (weighted mean frequency of energy distribution within a band) is a core MIR feature used in instrument classification, audio similarity search, and query-by-example. It provides a band-local version of spectral brightness that improves retrieval precision over global centroid alone.

Discourse is the phenomenon of language extended beyond single utterances — it is inherently a form of communication. Removal test: remove communication and discourse ceases to operate, since discourse IS multi-utterance communication. The dependency is constitutive at the object level: discourse is not merely associated with communication; it is communication operating over extended stretches of talk/text.

Cepstral coefficients are computed from the log power spectrum. The log power spectrum is the logarithm of the spectral-power-distribution values. Removing the spectral-power-distribution removes the distribution from which the log power spectrum is derived. Without SPDF, cepstral coefficients have no operand and cannot be computed.
crest-factor equals max divided by RMS; RMS is the square root of the 2nd raw moment of band energy. Removing moment theory removes the definition of RMS and thus of crest factor

Removal test (Law 8b): remove the language system (the accepted definition: the human-made system of symbolic signs structured for encoding, transmitting, and decoding meaning) and the field's object of study disappears — the neural mechanisms that implement language no longer exist, because there is no language to implement. The paradigm methods named in the accepted definition (fMRI/EEG mapping of language tasks, lesion-symptom mapping in aphasia patients) lose the very tasks that define them: the field stops operating, not merely stops being sayable. Same shape as the accepted DEPENDS_ON language edges from every other subfield: phonology, morphology, pragmatics, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics, linguistics itself. Pinned sense: the field of study, not its practitioners.

INSTANCE_OF nearest-kind test: the glottal cycle is a voice-quality measurement construct, one of the standardized clinical parameters in the voice-quality family for assessing laryngeal function; voice-quality is the nearest accepted kind.

The concept of "mel-frequency-scaled" data derives from the mel-frequency scale. The scale provides the transformation formula; "scaled" is the result of applying that scale to linear-Hertz data. The scale concept existed as a formal mapping before the adjective "mel-frequency-scaled" was used to describe transformed data.
Peak-to-average ratio requires the peak energy value within the band. Removing peak removes the numerator needed for the ratio.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b). speech-processing's accepted definition carves its parameters as: (1) representation domain (time-domain waveform, short-time Fourier transform, mel-frequency cepstral coefficients, linear prediction coefficients), (2) temporal scale, (3) task objective. These representations — STFT, MFCC, LPC — are all signal-processing constructs. Remove signal-processing and speech-processing loses its operational techniques: no FFT, no filter design, no spectral analysis — the discipline has no computational mechanisms left. This is an operational dependency, not a generic "every entry needs X" appeal: signal-processing is the specific methodological substrate named in the definition.

Law 8d pinned sense: EGG is a standardized measurement in clinical laryngology and voice-disorder assessment, persisting as an electroglottogram time series through laryngeal analysis systems (Kay PENTAGRAM, the laryngograph). For whose sake? speech-processing systems that analyze voice: the accepted speech-processing definition carves analysis of human speech signals as its first processing direction, and voice-quality assessment is that analysis. Same servant shape as the accepted shimmer SERVES speech-processing line (ge46f8f414c82b8c815cc8c86, accepted today).

Computational dependency: spectral-band-crest-factor is defined as peak/rms ratio. Removing rms (the denominator) makes the ratio computationally undefined. Crest-factor's definition is literally peak/rms where both refer to band-level values.

Spectral-smoothness computes smoothness = 1 - (1/N) * sum|E[i+1] - E[i]| / mean(E) where E[i] is the per-bin energy vector across all N frequency bins. The per-bin energy vector IS spectral-distribution - the ordered N-tuple of non-negative scalars. Remove spectral-distribution and there is no per-bin energy data to compute adjacent differences; the smoothness value is undefined. This is the same pattern as accepted edges from spectral-rolloff, spectral-skewness, spectral-kurtosis to spectral-distribution. Pinned sense: the full-spectrum mean-absolute-derivative index computed over the per-bin energy vector.

spectral-band-crest-factor (ratio of peak to RMS energy within a band) IS a spectral feature — a specific quantifiable property of a spectrum within a frequency band. Removing spectral-feature as a category would remove the class under which crest factor is classifiable. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF with precise computational meaning.
The constitutive input is the moment-to-moment distribution: removing it stops skewness from being computable

The cepstral-domain is constructed by: (1) computing the power spectrum of a signal, (2) taking the log of each frequency bin's magnitude, (3) applying the inverse Fourier transform. Removing the power-spectrum construct eliminates step 1 of this construction, stopping the cepstral-domain from being formed. DEPENDS_ON is distinct from the accepted DERIVED_FROM edge: the domain not only historically derives from power-spectrum analysis but structurally requires it as a necessary input.
