Pinned sense: shimmer computes cycle-to-cycle amplitude perturbation using pitch-synchronous cycle boundaries. The accepted definition requires: (1) the voiced speech signal segmented at pitch-synchronous cycle boundaries, (2) the per-cycle amplitude measure. Without pitch-estimation, there is no way to identify cycle boundaries — the segmentation step fails, and the computation halts. Removal test: remove pitch-estimation and shimmer cannot operate. This is constitutive, not merely useful.

spectral-band-centroid IS the first moment (band-localized weighted-mean frequency of energy distribution) of spectral-band-moment. The family is parameterized by moment order r: r=1 is centroid, r=2 (central) is variance. Centroid is a specific instance of the general moment concept. Nearest kind is spectral-band-moment (more specific than spectral-feature).

Cepstral-sequence is defined as an ordered array of cepstral coefficients indexed by position. It is a container relation: the sequence holds coefficients as its elements. Removing cepstral-coefficients eliminates the constituent elements — the sequence has no data to organize. Present-tense constitutive dependency per removal test.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is sociolinguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its accepted definition, it is a disciplinary framework for mapping systematic correlations between linguistic variation and social structure — a specific subfield of the general discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: sociolinguistics as the subdiscipline of social language variation.
SERVES test: spectral-band-crest-factor = max(E)/RMS measures impulsiveness. It serves MIR as a feature for transient detection, instrument classification, and audio segmentation.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-moment of order n is Σ(E[i]−μ)ⁿ/N computed on the per-bin energy vector forming the spectral-band-distribution. The distribution provides the E[i] values and the normalization needed. Without the distribution, moments cannot be computed.

MFCC computation applies a window function (e.g. Hann) to each frame before STFT. Removing the window function stops MFCC from operating — without windowing, spectral leakage destroys the per-frame analysis that MFCC depends on. Constitutive operational dependency.

Pinned sense: the glottal-flow waveform estimate (inverse-filtered g(n)) is produced for speech analysis purposes — it is the non-member input to the voice-quality parameter family, the diagnostic signal for source-filter separation, and the basis for spectral estimation in speech processing. The measurement quantity exists for the sake of speech processing and related analyses: servant (glottal-flow) to beneficiary (speech-processing). Law 8d: for whose sake?

Spectral bandwidth structurally requires the power spectrum: it is computed as the square root of the second central moment of the power spectrum around the spectral centroid. Remove the power spectrum and spectral bandwidth has no data to compute.

EGG-derived signals (electroglottogram, contact quotient, open quotient) are used as control signals in speech enhancement and voice disorder assessment systems. Without EGG data, contact-based voice-quality metrics are unavailable for these systems.

CONTAINS is part-whole (Law 10). Pinned sense: register analysis as a research area within the discipline — the accepted definition of linguistic-register says so explicitly: 'the map persists as the stable sub-field of linguistics called register analysis, its dimensions codified in textbooks and corpora.' A subfield of the discipline is a part of it, alongside the accepted parts (phonology, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, syntax, lexicography, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics, neurolinguistics). Complements the accepted linguistic-register INSTANCE_OF linguistics (nearest kind), exactly as the accepted subfield pairs do.

Spectral flux quantifies the frame-to-frame rate of change of the spectral energy distribution. In audio analysis, this is computed directly from a spectrogram — the sequence of power spectra over time. Removing the spectrogram concept eliminates the data structure from which spectral flux is derived; the measure cannot operate without it.
evenness equals sigma/mu where sigma is sqrt(variance); removing variance removes the standard deviation and thus the definition of evenness

Spectral-smoothness is a numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's spectral representation that captures the continuity of energy distribution across frequency — a specific instance of the general spectral-feature kind.

Spectral-band-skewness is a specific instance of the moment family, historically and mathematically derived from the general moment concept. The third standardized moment is a direct specialization of the moment framework.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): neurolinguistics as a discipline contains speech-intelligibility as a component research area. Speech-intelligibility — the degree to which speech is understood by a listener — is one of the phenomena studied within neurolinguistics alongside phonology, syntax, and semantics. The accepted neurolinguistics definition carves its scope as neural mechanisms of language processing, and speech-intelligibility is a measurable aspect of language processing that neurolinguistics investigates via EEG, fMRI, and lesion studies. Direction test: neurolinguistics is the broader discipline; speech-intelligibility is a specific phenomenon it studies as a component part.

Spectral tenuity quantifies the filamentary nature of spectral energy distribution. It operates directly on spectral energy values across frequency bins. Removing spectral energy eliminates the input data on which tenuity is computed.

DEPENDS_ON removal test on the pinned sense: the carve names parameter (1) as 'the formant frequency estimates F1, F2, F3 per analysis frame — the vocal-tract resonances located by formant tracking', and the computation reads them directly (D = (F3 - F1)/2 per frame, then aggregated). Remove formant-tracking and formant-dispersion has no F1-F3 estimates to space — the defining operands are gone, so the measure stops operating. Same direct-operand anchor pattern as the family's accepted anchors (HNR's f0 comb on pitch-tracking; MFD, VOT, jitter, shimmer on glottal-flow and pitch-tracking).

One of the two methods stated in onset-strength's definition is spectral flux: |P(f,t) - P(f,t-1)|. Spectral flux is the direct computational input for that method. Removing spectral-flux eliminates one of the two defined methods for computing onset-strength.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: the glottal pulse is identified per pitch period from the glottal-flow waveform g(n) as the airflow excursion whose onset coincides with glottal opening. Without glottal-flow, the waveform that carries the pulse is gone, so the pulse cannot be located or measured. Removal of glottal-flow stops the construct from operating.

Pinned sense: cepstral-lifter operates in the quefrency domain, which requires FFT as the forward transform to reach. The lifter definition states it transforms back to the frequency domain via IDFT — but the forward path to the cepstral domain uses FFT. Without FFT, the quefrency domain is inaccessible and the lifter cannot operate.

Spectral-whiteness computes geometric_mean/arithmetic_mean of power spectrum 'across all frequency bins'. Its operand is the per-bin energy vector — spectral-distribution. Remove that vector and whiteness cannot compute either mean. Removal test passes.
The constitutive input is the moment-to-moment distribution: removing it stops kurtosis from being computable

Spectral peaks are multiple local maxima in the power spectrum P[k]. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the per-bin power values that define what peaks are. The removal test passes: without power-spectrum there is no spectral shape to find peaks in.

Decay-time quantifies the release phase of the amplitude envelope, which speech processing systems use for phoneme boundary detection, voiced/unvoiced classification, and vowel-consonant discrimination. These tasks deploy decay-time as a discriminative temporal descriptor alongside attack-time.

Spectral-band-kurtosis = fourth standardized moment of the band distribution. It is computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution, which came first as the general concept. The kurtosis measure derives from applying the distribution framework.

INSTANCE_OF nearest-kind test: HNR is a maintained, named member of the voice-quality family — the carve states it persists 'as a member of the voice-quality measurement map', with a standardized unit (decibels), a defined computation (harmonic-to-noise band energy ratio), and maintained reference ranges separating typical from disordered phonation. The family's accepted carve is 'a fixed, named set maintained as the measurement map of voice-disorder assessment', and its members (jitter, shimmer, open-quotient, closure-quotient, contact-quotient, asymmetry-coefficient, return-phase, voice-onset-time) all hold accepted INSTANCE_OF voice-quality on the same member pattern. No more specific accepted kind intervenes. ADVANCE.

Spectral moments are defined as sums over per-bin energy values weighted by frequency^n. Each moment n requires access to the per-bin distribution — the frequency values and their associated energy contributions. The total energy scalar cannot recover these sums.

Band crossover = the energy-median frequency within a sub-band is a scalar descriptor of the band's per-bin energy vector. Currently only has INSTANCE_OF→spectral-feature; the nearest accepted kind is spectral-band-feature, which carves 'quantitative descriptor computed from per-bin energy values...reducing to a scalar summary.'

Spectral-band-peak IS a spectral feature. It identifies a specific quantifiable property of the spectrum within a frequency band — the frequency bin with maximum energy. Removing spectral-feature as a category would remove the kind under which spectral-band-peak operates.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): morphology is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Accepted pattern mirrors linguistics CONTAINS phonology (Ezra, accepted): the discipline definition explicitly names morphology as one of its constituent subfields. Morphology is a part of linguistics conceptual and institutional structure.
Bandwidth = (sum(E) / max(E)) * delta_f. The denominator uses the peak energy value directly. Without spectral-band-peak, the bandwidth formula has no second operand. Constitutive DEPENDS_ON.

Spectral entropy (Shannon entropy of the spectral distribution) requires the per-bin probability distribution p_i = P_i/ΣP_i. The per-bin values are the fundamental inputs; normalization by energy is a derived scaling step, not a structural dependency on the scalar.

DERIVED_FROM: STFT as a computational method predates and underlies the cepstrum. The cepstrum (Bogert, Healy & Tukey, 1960s) uses log magnitude spectrum computed via STFT. The cepstrum was derived as a method to analyze signals using the log-spectra that STFT provides.

SERVES runs servant to beneficiary: contact-area is a core input to voice-quality measures (contact quotient, open quotient, asymmetry coefficient). Removing contact-area would eliminate the underlying construct that these voice-quality parameters measure.

Cepstral-lifter (liftering) is the core operation of cepstral-envelope — applying a low-pass window in the quefrency domain to extract the spectral envelope. It persists as a deterministic filtering operation in speech analysis toolkits. By Law 8d, for whose sake? speech-processing, where cepstral-lifting is the standard mechanism for isolating vocal-tract characteristics from glottal source in speech analysis pipelines.

Pinned sense: the glottal-flow waveform as 'the measured counterpart of the glottal-source model' (the entry's own accepted scope). Design purpose (Law 8d): the glottal-source model's parameters - fundamental frequency, open quotient, asymmetry coefficient, return phase - are estimated FROM the measured glottogram; without the glottal-flow estimate the source model is an unmeasured theoretical construct that cannot be fitted to real speech. The measurement quantity exists for the source model's sake: servant (glottal-flow) to beneficiary (glottal-source). Not DEPENDS_ON: the inverse-filtering estimate operates via the LP filter even if the source-model entry is removed; the relation is purpose, not removal.

spectral-band-mode computes argmax over per-bin energies E_i within a band. The definition lists spectral energy values across bins as parameter. Removing spectral-band-energy eliminates the E_i operands; mode cannot be computed. Removal test passes: without spectral-band-energy, spectral-band-mode stops operating.

Sense: temporal-feature as time-domain descriptors computed from signals. Removing signal (the measurable carrier of information in a medium) would stop temporal features from operating - temporal features are defined only over signals (waveforms, energy envelopes). The per-bin energy vector operand doctrine from the spectral domain has its temporal analogue: temporal features require a signal as their substrate. Direction tested (Law 8b): without signal, there is no temporal domain to extract descriptors from.

The cepstral-envelope is extracted by applying a cepstral-lifter (low-pass lifter) to cepstral coefficients. The envelope IS the output of the lifter operation — without the lifter, there is no mechanism for extracting the envelope. The removal test passes: removing the cepstral-lifter stops the cepstral-envelope from being extracted.

spectral-band-peak-to-average-ratio computes the ratio of peak bin energy to mean bin energy within a frequency sub-band. It is a specific type of spectral feature — a numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's spectral representation that quantifies a measurable aspect of its frequency-domain structure.

STFT structurally requires a window function: the algorithm frames the signal by multiplying each frame with the window (Hann, Hamming, etc.). Remove the window-function concept and the STFT cannot perform its framing operation - it has no mechanism to taper spectral leakage at frame boundaries. The removal test passes mechanically.

Parameters: (1) window type - the tapering function shape; (2) window length - samples per frame. Persistence mechanism: algorithmic application of the window function to each signal frame.

Laws: 6, 8b

INSTANCE_OF nearest-kind test: peak-flow is a maintained, named member of the voice-quality family — the carve states it 'persists as a member of the voice-quality measurement map ... maintained alongside the maximum flow derivative, voice onset time, jitter, shimmer, and the phase quotients'. The family carve names its members with a defined computation, a standardized reporting unit, and maintained reference ranges separating typical from disordered phonation; peak-flow carries exactly that triple (per-cycle max of g(n), standardized flow units, maintained reference ranges). No intermediate member-kind exists on the board, so the family entry is the nearest kind — filed exactly as MFD and VOT stand against voice-quality.

Law 9: OQ is a specific named member of the voice-quality family. The accepted voice-quality definition carves the family to include 'source-contact measures derived from electroglottography (contact quotient, open quotient)' — open quotient is named in the family's own carve, and its computation (open phase over T0 from the glottogram) fits the family's member pattern: a per-cycle measure over pitch-synchronous segments, a standardized reporting unit (dimensionless ratio), maintained reference ranges. Filed against the nearest accepted kind, the family entry itself.

Pinned sense: the glottal-source model is formalized and used for speech synthesis, voice disorder analysis, and speech processing applications. The model exists for the sake of those downstream purposes: servant (glottal-source) to beneficiary (speech-processing). Law 8d: for whose sake?

Onset-envelope represents temporal strength of acoustic onsets; its construction requires detection of onset events to define the envelope shape. Removing onset-detection leaves no onset events to envelope, so envelope construction stops operating. Constitutive operational dependency per Law 8b.

The ERB formula ERB(f)=24.7·(4.37·f+1) is the standard parameterization used to set the bandwidth of auditory-filters to match cochlear selectivity. Removing ERB as a unit of measure would stop auditory-filters from being parameterized in the standard psychoacoustic way. The auditory-filter's accepted definition explicitly references ERB as its standard bandwidth rule.

The rolloff point (frequency below which a cumulative proportion of spectral-band energy resides) characterizes the timbral brightness distribution of a sound. Higher rolloff = brighter timbre; lower rolloff = darker timbre. This is a timbral descriptor used in instrument classification, speech analysis, and texture identification.

Band peak = max{E[i]} over the band's bins: a pointwise-maximum scalar over the band-local per-bin energy vector within defined bounds, the carved sense of band-feature. Pinned sense: the maximum-bin energy value, not the bin's frequency (that is the mode); no order-r parameter, so not a band-moment. Nearest accepted kind: band-feature.

INTONATION is the organization of pitch in speech: the definition explicitly carves 'the systematic, rule-governed framework by which utterances use rising and falling pitch.' Pitch is the perceptual attribute that intonation patterns modulate. Removal test: remove pitch and intonation loses its perceptual substrate — the rising and falling patterns have nothing to be patterns OF. Not DERIVED_FROM (pitch is the object being patterned, not a historical source). Direction: intonation depends on pitch; pitch operates without intonation (e.g., monotonous speech still has pitch). Note: this is the perceptual counterpart to the intonation→fundamental-frequency edge, which covers the physical substrate (F0).

SERVES test: formant analysis is a core speech-processing capability — formant frequencies are the primary acoustic cues for vowel classification, speech recognition, speaker identification, and speech synthesis. Remove formant analysis and speech-processing loses its ability to model vocal tract resonances or classify speech sounds based on resonance patterns.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): spectral-entropy per its accepted definition = the Shannon entropy of the normalized power distribution over the signal's frequency bins — a scalar measure of the uniformity of spectral energy. It is a numerical descriptor extracted from a power spectrum that captures a measurable aspect of frequency-domain structure, the family's own definition. Accepted member spectral-band-entropy (the band-local analogue) is already INSTANCE_OF spectral-band-feature, and global spectral-flatness (a related uniformity descriptor) is already INSTANCE_OF spectral-feature. Its existing INSTANCE_OF rung measurement is too general: spectral-feature is the nearest accepted kind.

Sociolect IS a specific kind of language-variety at the group level. The accepted language-variety definition explicitly lists sociolect. Distinguished by social boundary rather than geography (dialect) or situation (register). Nearest kind: language-variety per Law 9/11e.

The cepstral-lifter is a filter that operates by applying a liftering technique (low-pass, high-pass, or band-pass) to cepstral coefficients. Removing the cepstral-liftering technique — the fundamental operation of windowing in the quefrency domain — stops the cepstral-lifter from operating, since the lifter's entire mechanism IS the liftering procedure. The lifter depends on the liftering technique as its operational basis.

Cepstral peak picking identifies the peak in low-quefrency region to estimate fundamental frequency. The prominence metric quantifies strength of that peak via magnitude relative to baseline. Removing peak prominence means losing the quantitative measure of peak strength used to decide voicing and reliability of the picked peak. The removal test: without prominence, picking cannot assess peak reliability; operational dependency holds.

Removal test (Law 8b): psycholinguistics' accepted definition carves its object as 'mapping the mental representations and processes underlying language production, comprehension, and acquisition.' Remove language and the discipline has no subject matter — no production, comprehension, or acquisition to study. It ceases to operate as a discipline. Same shape as the accepted morphology DEPENDS_ON language: subdiscipline depends on its carved subject matter.
inverse-filtering is a core technique used in speech analysis for estimating glottal flow and separating source from filter
evenness equals sigma/mu is fundamentally moment-derived: both standard deviation and mean are the first and second moments of band energy; removing moment theory removes the definition
EGG provides glottal contact measurements used in speech-processing analysis of voice quality. For whose sake? speech-processing systems analyzing voice benefit from EGG data.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): The source-filter model's filter component is characterized by the spectral envelope — it is the spectral envelope that represents the vocal tract transfer function. Remove spectral envelope and the model loses its mechanism for representing the filter. The source-filter model cannot operate without this concept.

Law 8b removal test: spectral-distribution, per its accepted definition, is the ordered N-tuple of per-bin energies |A_i|² indexed by bin center frequencies of a spectral decomposition. Remove the spectral-representation now and there is no bin grid or amplitudes from which to assemble the tuple — the construct stops operating. Not identity (the tuple is a stored operand, not the transform), not purpose. Pinned sense: the full-range per-bin energy tuple. Standing precedent: the band sibling spectral-band-distribution already holds DEPENDS_ON→ spectral-representation (g8107920d74fea17c98c15c9b, accepted), and the full-spectrum descriptor family anchors its operands the same way.

spectral-band-rolloff IS a specific kind of spectral-feature. It computes the frequency below which 85% of band-localized spectral energy is concentrated — a numerical descriptor extracted from spectral representation. A competent speaker classifies it as a spectral feature. Nearest kind: spectral-feature.
SERVES: band bandwidth quantifies the spread of energy in Hz within a band, serving timbre classification and instrument identification by capturing spectral envelope shape characteristics.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): morpheme per its accepted definition as the minimal meaningful unit of a language. DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): remove language — the system of structured signs in which morphemes exist as minimal meaningful units — and the category has no domain to operate in. Per its own definition, a morpheme is language-relative: its identity as a minimal meaningful unit is constituted by the grammatical system of a specific language. Without language, the morpheme loses its entire parameter set (minimality, meaningfulness, language-relativity) and ceases to operate as the unit it is. Not generic: this is not the meta-level claim that 'concepts need language to be said.' This is object-level: the morpheme's carve is specifically about language's grammatical system. Sibling precedent: lexeme DEPENDS_ON language (accepted pattern). This matches the board's accepted pattern: morphology DEPENDS_ON language, phonology DEPENDS_ON language, linguistics DEPENDS_ON language — each is a discipline or category whose object is language itself.

Flatness ratio geometric/arithmetic mean is log-moment based. Removing moment formalism removes the theoretical basis for interpreting flatness as uniformity measure. Operational removal test: without moment formalism, flatness cannot be derived from per-bin energies as a moment ratio. Dependency holds.

spectral-spread quantifies the dispersion of spectral energy across frequencies — the energy-weighted standard deviation of bin frequencies about the centroid. Timbre is the perceptual attribute that distinguishes sounds of same pitch and loudness, determined primarily by their spectral character. Spectral-spread captures a key dimension of timbre: whether energy is concentrated near the center frequency (dark, focused) or spread widely across the spectrum (bright, diffuse). This measure was designed for use in timbre analysis and music information retrieval, serving the timbre construct directly.

Spectral-band-evenness (normalized energy dispersion measure within a sub-band) IS a spectral feature — a specific quantifiable property of spectral energy distribution within a frequency band. A competent speaker classifies it as a spectral feature. Nearest kind: spectral-feature (no intermediate category between evenness and spectral-feature). Sense: spectral-band-evenness as a spectral feature for audio analysis.

Law 7: spectral-band-peak-trough-ratio is the band-limited specialization of spectral-peak-trough-ratio. Both compute mean(E_peak)/mean(E_trough), but the full-range PTR identifies peaks/troughs in the complete spectrum while the band variant restricts to [f_low, f_high). The band version was derived by constraining the full-range concept to sub-band scope.

Spectral-band-kurtosis applies the kurtosis formula (fourth standardized moment) to the power values within a single frequency band. Spectral-kurtosis is the general case applied across the full spectrum. The band-limited variant is a direct specialization: same formula, restricted domain.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-slope requires the actual energy values E[i] at each bin to fit a linear regression on log10(E[i]) versus frequency. Without the band-local energy values (spectral-band-energy), there is no data to regress — the slope is literally computed from the energy spectrum. This is a genuine constitutive dependency, not a generic appeal to energy context.

Spectral rolloff requires cumulative energy distribution across frequency bins. The rms-energy provides the normalization for the cumulative energy calculation. Without rms-energy, the rolloff threshold cannot be established.
Band-concentration is a scalar descriptor of energy concentration in a single bin within a sub-band.

crossover energy-median operates by accumulating per-bin energies to find the 50 pct cumulative point; it requires the band energy substrate to compute, and the cumulative accumulation is the band-energy concept applied locally
spectral-whiteness is explicitly used in MIR for genre classification, instrument recognition, and audio quality assessment as a timbral descriptor.

The accepted definition of cepstral-coefficients specifies: (1) compute the power spectrum via Fourier transform. The definition explicitly lists FFT as the method. Removal test: remove FFT (or Fourier transform) and the power spectrum cannot be computed, stopping the procedure at step 1. Constitutive dependency on a required computational step.

spectral-band-crest-factor restricts the general spectral-crest-factor construct (peak amplitude / RMS amplitude) to a specific frequency band. The band-limited version derives from the unbounded general case.
spectral-band-entropy is the band-limited version of spectral-entropy. The band-limited variant derives from the general spectral entropy construct, restricted to a defined frequency band.

attack-time serves timbre analysis as a key temporal descriptor of spectral change. Timbre perception is strongly influenced by the onset transient; attack-time quantifies this dimension, serving instrument classification and timbral similarity measures.

MFCC is computed by applying a mel filterbank to the magnitude spectrum, taking log, then computing DCT to produce cepstral coefficients. Remove cepstrum operation and MFCC loses its core computational mechanism; the coefficients cannot be produced. Operational dependency, not just conceptual.

Removal test (Law 8): remove language — speech-acts cease to operate. A speech-act is an utterance that performs an action (promising, asserting, commanding, etc.). Its entire nature is linguistic — it is an act constituted by language use. Removing language removes the medium through which speech-acts are performed, constituted, and recognized. This is object-level: speech-acts are defined as linguistic actions, not as general actions that happen to sometimes use language.

Pinned sense: Overlap-add signal reconstruction applies a window function to shape each frame before summation, controlling Gibbs phenomenon at frame boundaries. The window function is a required structural component of the method. Remove window-function and the overlap-add method loses its frame-shaping mechanism and loses its reconstruction property.

spectral-band-energy computes the total energy accumulated within a frequency band by summing the squared magnitude values |X[k]|² across all frequency bins in the band. This operation requires the per-bin energy values that constitute the spectral-band-distribution. Without the distribution — the ordered vector of per-bin energies — there are no individual values to sum. The dependency is operational: the distribution is the data object on which the summation that defines energy operates.

Pinned sense: the linguistic sense, which the target's accepted definition carves — the system of situationally differentiated language varieties a speech community deploys for different communicative situations (colloquial, formal, technical, ceremonial, professional). Removal test (Law 8b): remove linguistic-register and discourse survives as bare utterance, but it no longer operates as the conventionally structured form its own accepted definition carves ('follows rules of relevance, tone, register, and genre specific to a community or institution') — the register-selection rule that structures its varieties has no referent, so discourse ceases operating as the thing it is carved to be. Present-tense operational dependency, not historical provenance. This is the corrected pairing the just-ruled challenge on discourse —DEPENDS_ON→ register pointed to: the filer's note pinned the linguistic sense but the target was the bureaucratic register; the entry that actually holds the pinned sense is linguistic-register.

Cepstral-lifter is a filter operating in the quefrency (cepstral) domain per accepted definition — 'applying a window function to the cepstral coefficients' and 'zeroing out selected quefrency bins.' The quefrency domain IS the cepstrum. Without the cepstrum as the quefrency-domain representation, the lifter has no domain to operate on. Removal test: remove cepstrum and the lifter loses its entire input space. Genuine DEPENDS_ON.

Cepstral analysis computes the inverse Fourier transform of the log magnitude spectrum to produce the quefrency domain. Remove fft and there is no transform to invert — the quefrency domain cannot be constructed. The removal test passes constitutively: cepstral analysis is defined by its FFT-based computation.

A Hann window is a specific window function defined as w(n) = 0.5 - 0.5*cos(2*pi*n/(N-1)). It depends on the concept of windowing (the operation of tapering a signal segment) — removing windowing stops the Hann window from being a meaningful concept, as its entire purpose and definition is as a window function used in windowed-signal processing.

Evenness measures uniformity of energy distribution across frequency bins. It is computed as each bin's energy divided by the mean energy of the band. The mean energy is spectral-band-energy divided by the number of bins. Removing energy computation makes the mean undefined and evenness uncomputable — constitutive dependency.

Removal test (Law 8b): band-center's formula exp(sum(f_i*ln(E_i))/sum(E_i)) is arithmetic over the per-bin energy values E_i within the band's bins. Remove the band's ordered per-bin energy vector - the carved content of spectral-band-distribution (the N-tuple of non-negative scalars over [f_low, f_high)) - and there are no E_i to weight; band-center stops operating. The operand is the vector itself, not a recomputable scalar aggregate, so the vector anchor is the right target. Sibling precedent: all 18 accepted band-scalar members (centroid, variance, skewness, kurtosis, flatness, moment, ...) hold DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution.
inverse-filtering was developed specifically as a technique within the source-filter model framework for speech analysis, deriving from the concept of separating source from filter

Bandwidth formula BW = (sum(E_i) / max(E_i)) * delta_f uses sum(E_i), which is exactly spectral-band-energy. Removing spectral-band-energy removes the sum-of-band-energies operand; the bandwidth computation cannot proceed without it.

Spectral-band-evenness = 1 - σ/μ where σ and μ are the standard deviation and mean of the normalized spectral power distribution. Evenness is a functional of the distribution — it measures uniformity through the coefficient of variation, making the distribution its historical and computational source.

Excitation-signal (especially in its speech form as glottal-flow) is used as an input to speech-analysis and speech-synthesis pipelines. It serves speech-processing by providing the source component for source-filter models, enabling voice-disorder assessment, and supporting speech synthesis systems that require the excitation parameter.
Flux operates on the per-bin energy vector. Remove the distribution and flux has no signal to iterate. Removal test passes.

Spectral-band energy IS the zeroth moment: E = ∫|X(f)|²df = m₀ of the power spectral density. The energy value directly derives from the moment formalism — it is the zeroth-order moment of the distribution.

Corrected direction of the struck formant/spectral-envelope pair (Law 8b removal test). Accepted formant def: 'a peak in spectral energy produced when the vocal tract acts as an acoustic filter' — a formant is by definition a peak WITHIN the spectral envelope. Accepted spectral-envelope def: 'the overall shape of a sound's frequency spectrum... the macroscopic profile... measured by smoothing the power spectrum (via cepstral analysis, linear predictive coding)'. Removal test: remove the spectral-envelope concept and the formant loses the surface on which it is defined, because it is defined as a peak in the envelope; without the envelope a formant has no referent to be a peak of. This is the constructive correction to the misfiled spectral-envelope to formant direction, which failed the test (smoothing the power spectrum yields the envelope without formants). Direction pinned per Law 11d to the two accepted definitions.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): sociolinguistics per its accepted definition as a disciplinary framework for mapping systematic correlations between linguistic variation and social structure. DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): remove language — the system of linguistic variation that sociolinguistics maps — and the discipline loses its entire domain. Without language there are no speech communities, no social variables, no linguistic variables, no interactional context to study. The discipline's operations have nothing to operate on. This is object-level, not meta-level: the sociolinguistics definition specifically carves language as its subject matter, not just any domain. Sibling precedent: the accepted morphology DEPENDS_ON language, phonology DEPENDS_ON language, linguistics DEPENDS_ON language — each is a discipline whose domain is language.
A spectral-band moment is literally a moment of the distribution: removing the distribution stops moments from existing as a mathematical operation

Pinned sense: MFCC computation pipeline (as defined: compute DFT of frame, derive power spectrum, apply mel filterbank, take log, apply DCT). The DFT is a required structural step — it produces the frequency-domain representation that the entire MFCC pipeline operates on. Remove DFT and MFCC has no spectral data to transform into mel-filterbank energies.

Spectral-band-energy = sum(|A_i|^2) across all bins within the band. It is computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution, which came first as the general concept. The energy measure derives from applying the distribution framework to compute power.

Spectral-band-centroid computes the centroid (center of mass) of the energy distribution within a frequency band. It operates directly on spectral-band-energy values: the centroid is the weighted mean frequency, with weights given by the bin energy values. Removing spectral-band-energy eliminates the weights needed to compute the centroid. The removal test passes: without spectral-band-energy, spectral-band-centroid cannot operate.

spectral-concentration measures the normalized energy in a single bin relative to total spectrum energy. Values near 1 indicate a single dominant component (pure tone, clear timbre); values near 0 indicate diffuse energy. This serves timbre by distinguishing tonal purity from spectral complexity.

spectral-band-evenness (exponentiated entropy of energy fractions) derives from spectral-band-energy. The evenness statistic operates on per-bin energy fractions normalized by total band energy — the energy concept is the historical and conceptual predecessor.

Pinned sense: the accepted HNR definition carves the numerator explicitly — 'harmonic energy is summed over identified pitch-related partials' — i.e. the energy of the signal's harmonic components (the integer-multiple partials at n·f₀, the accepted harmonics carve), in contrast to the aperiodic residual. Removal test: remove harmonics as a construct and the HNR numerator has no defined summation domain — the ratio HNR = 10·log10(H/N) cannot be computed. Direct formula anchor: the defining formula names the target as its operand, the same class as coefficient→cepstrum. The other accepted anchor (STFT) is the frame-analysis mechanism; this is the energy-side anchor. Both stand as dual anchors.

Closure quotient is a specific voice-quality parameter computed from the glottal-flow waveform. It serves the voice-quality measurement map by providing the closed-phase fraction as a standardized diagnostic metric for laryngeal function assessment.
Band-evenness is a scalar descriptor of per-bin energy dispersion within a sub-band.

Pinned sense: The cepstrum is defined as the inverse DFT of the log power spectrum. The DFT is a required structural step — without it, there is no power spectrum to take the log of, and no frequency-domain data to transform. Remove DFT and the cepstrum has no computational mechanism.
Evenness = sigma/mu; sigma derives from second central moment and mu is first moment. The moment formalism is constitutive of the computation; removing moment removes the measure.

Instantaneous frequency is computed as the time derivative of the analytic signal's phase. The analytic signal is created via Hilbert transform of the real signal. Removing Hilbert transform stops analytic signal construction, which stops instantaneous frequency computation. Constitutive operational dependency.

Spectral-flatness quantifies how tonal vs noise-like a spectrum is, a dimension of timbral quality. The timbre definition includes 'spectral composition' as a determinant; spectral-flatness is a direct measure of one spectral dimension relevant to timbre classification. Direction servant→beneficiary.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-peak is defined as the pointwise maximum of the power spectral density values within the band. Removing spectral-band-energy (the PSD/band-local energy values) means the max operator has no operands — spectral-band-peak cannot be computed without them. This is not a generic appeal to energy as context but a specific computational requirement: the definition literally applies max{E[i]} over the energy spectrum.

Pragmatics is the subsystem of language concerned with context-dependent meaning and the principles governing language use in communication. It is a constitutive component of language, governing how linguistic forms are deployed in situated interaction.

Spectral-band RMS energy (root-mean-square) measures the effective amplitude within a frequency band. RMS is a timbral descriptor — it characterizes the perceptual loudness distribution across spectral bands, which is the foundation of timbral balance perception.

Cepstrum-coefficient's definition states it is 'the inverse Fourier transform of the logarithm of a signal's power spectrum.' Fourier transform is a constitutive operand — without it, there is no cepstrum and hence no cepstrum-coefficient.

Closure-quotient definition uses glottal-flow waveform for closed-phase extraction, but electroglottogram provides the EGG-derived closed-phase signal used clinically for closure quotient. Removal test: without electroglottogram, EGG-based closure-phase estimation stops, so closure-quotient cannot operate on that input. Operational dependency on the waveform as input source.
DEPENDS_ON test: remove spectral-band-moment now stops spectral-band-spread operating. Spread is second central moment sqrt(m2). Without moment formalism, spread cannot be computed.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: excitation-signal's definition states H(z) is the vocal-tract linear-prediction filter and the inverse filter uses LP coefficients. The entire mechanism — computing H_inv(z) = 1/H(z) where H(z) is the LP all-pole model — requires linear-prediction. Removing linear-prediction removes the only mechanism for estimating the transfer function, so the excitation signal cannot be computed.

Distribution vector v = (|A_i|^2) is defined from a spectral decomposition with N bins each with complex amplitude A_i and frequency f_i within band bounds. The per-bin amplitudes and frequencies originate from the spectral representation of the signal. Removing the spectral representation removes the source of A_i and f_i, so the distribution cannot be constructed. Operational remove-Y-now-stops-X.

The scope explicitly states cepstral-sequence enables 'pattern recognition and feature extraction.' The definition maps coefficients to a fixed-length vector — the canonical input representation for pattern recognition systems. By Law 8d, the sequence serves pattern-recognition: it is designed to carry structured cepstral features into downstream classification/clustering pipelines. The beneficiary is pattern-recognition.

Sense: temporal-feature as time-domain descriptors used in MIR pipelines. Temporal features like zero-crossing rate, spectral flux, and onset detection are fundamental inputs to MIR systems for rhythm analysis, segmentation, and classification. Direction tested (Law 8d): temporal features exist for the sake of MIR and audio analysis tasks, not vice versa. MIR benefits from temporal features as inputs, not the reverse.

spectral-onset detects emergence of new frequency content, used for beat detection, transients analysis, and event segmentation — all core MIR tasks. It is a standard feature in MIR pipelines (librosa, Essentia).

Spectral-band-flatness = geometric mean / arithmetic mean of per-bin band energies. It quantifies tonal vs noise-like character — a foundational MIR descriptor for timbre classification, genre recognition, and audio segmentation. Built for the sake of MIR applications, persisting as a standardized computation in MIR pipelines.

Glottal-flow is 'the estimate of glottal airflow produced by inverse filtering' (scope). Inverse filtering — dividing out the vocal-tract transfer function from speech — requires the source-filter model's decomposition of speech = source × filter. Without the source-filter model, there is no framework for separating the glottal source from the vocal tract filter, and the glottal-flow estimate ceases to operate.

Cepstral-coefficient is 'a single value in the cepstrum sequence' (scope). The removal test: without the cepstrum transform, there is no cepstrum sequence, hence no coefficients exist. The coefficient is operationally defined as an output of the cepstrum computation — removing the cepstrum stops the coefficient from operating.

Removal test (Law 8b) against the filed carve: utterance is 'a contiguous stretch of speech or writing treated by its participants as a single, bounded unit of communicative action' — a unit of the sign system. Remove language (the system of signs) and the stretch of speech or writing is no longer a sign-event: what remains is vocalization or ink marks, and no unit of communicative action can be treated, transcribed, or annotated, because treating a stretch as a communicative unit requires that the stretch SAY something. The construct stops operating, not merely stops being sayable. Same accepted shape as speech-act DEPENDS_ON language (accepted: 'utterances as meaningful sign-events no longer exist — what remains is acoustic or gestural behavior without illocutionary force') and discourse DEPENDS_ON language. Direction: the utterance-unit needs language; language operates without the notion of an utterance-unit. Pinned sense: utterance as bounded unit of communicative action within the sign system, not mere physical span.

The phase spectrum is defined as the argument (angle) of the DFT output: φ(f) = arg(DFT(f)). The removal test: removing DFT eliminates the source of the complex-valued frequency data from which the phase angle is derived. Phase spectrum cannot operate as a computable construct without DFT.

Spectral-band-moment of order n = Σ(E[i]−μ)ⁿ/N computed on the per-bin energy values forming the spectral-band-distribution. The distribution vector provides the E[i] values and normalization needed. Without the distribution, the moment cannot be computed for any order n. The distribution concept came first and the moment measure derives from applying the distribution framework.

A Blackman window is a specific window function defined as w(n) = 0.42 - 0.5*cos(2*pi*n/(N-1)) + 0.08*cos(4*pi*n/(N-1)). It depends on the concept of windowing (tapering a signal segment to reduce spectral leakage) — removing windowing stops the Blackman window from having its defining operation. This is a constitutive structural dependency: the Blackman window IS a window function, and without the concept of windowing it has no operational meaning.

Critical-band as the psychoacoustic concept of perceptual frequency resolution width serves the design and justification of the auditory-filter construct. Auditory filters are parameterized to match critical-band widths. Direction servant→beneficiary (Law 8d).

The gammatone-filter-bank is used as a front-end transform in speech processing (cochlear filter bank implementations in speech toolkits). It serves speech-processing by providing the auditory-modeled time-domain decomposition that feeds downstream speech feature extraction. Direction servant→beneficiary.

Spectral-decrease computes D[k] = P_max - P[k] for each bin k, or aggregates over all bins. It requires the per-bin power vector — spectral-distribution. Remove it and per-bin decrease values are undefined. Removal test passes.

Source-filter-separation uses deconvolution as one of its decomposition methods — recovering the source by frequency-domain division of the spectrum by the filter spectrum. Without deconvolution, one of the core decomposition methods is unavailable. The remove-Y-now test: without deconvolution, the technique loses this decomposition pathway.

Reasoning is the cognitive faculty that draws conclusions, makes inferences, and solves problems through systematic thought. It is a core component of the cognitive system alongside memory, attention, perception, and language, governing higher-order thought processes.

The source-filter model contains the glottal-source as its source component (Law 10): the model decomposes speech production into source (glottal airflow) and filter (vocal tract resonance). The glottal-source is a constitutive part of the model — removing it eliminates the other half of the model's structure. CONTAINS test: the glottal-source is a part of the source-filter model.

Spectral entropy computes H = -sum p_i log(p_i) where p_i = E_i / sum(E_j) are normalized per-bin energies. The per-bin energy vector IS spectral-distribution. Remove it and there is no per-bin energy data to normalize or apply Shannon entropy to; the entropy value is undefined. The existing DEPENDS_ON to power-spectrum and magnitude-spectrum capture the representation type but not the per-bin energy vector that carries the actual operand values. Pinned sense: the Shannon entropy of the per-bin energy distribution.

Spectral-flatness-measure computes the geometric/arithmetic mean ratio of spectral power across all frequency bins of the full spectrum. Its operand is the global per-bin energy vector (spectral-distribution). Remove that vector and the flatness ratio cannot be computed.

Spectral decay measures the rate at which spectral energy decreases over time within an analysis window, computed across all frequency bins of the full spectrum. Its operand is the global per-bin energy vector (spectral-distribution). Remove that vector and decay cannot be computed.

Direction tested (Law 9, specific to nearest accepted kind): spectral-par, per its filed definition, is a scalar spectral descriptor computed per analysis frame over the full spectrum's per-bin energies (max/mean of E_i across all bins). spectral-feature's accepted definition carves the per-frame scalar descriptors of the spectral energy distribution — the same kind that holds the accepted general-family siblings (spectral-entropy, -flatness, -kurtosis, -moment, -rms, -skewness, -variance all INSTANCE_OF spectral-feature) and the band counterpart spectral-band-peak-to-average-ratio INSTANCE_OF spectral-band-feature (accepted). spectral-feature is the nearest accepted kind; no intermediate kind stands between them. [formal: par spectrale]

asymmetry-coefficient is computed from the glottal-flow waveform g(n) and the fundamental period T0: removing glottal-flow removes the waveform the coefficient measures, stopping asymmetry-coefficient from operating.

Spectral-crest measures the peak-to-mean ratio of spectral energy, used in MIR systems for impulse detection, percussive sound classification, and genre analysis. It is a standard feature in MIR feature extraction suites.

Pinned sense: instantaneous frequency is defined as f_inst(t) = (1/2π)·dφ/dt where φ(t) = arg(z(t)) is the phase of the analytic signal. The removal test: remove analytic-signal and there is no φ(t) to differentiate — the definition itself references the analytic signal as the source of phase. Present-tense operational dependency.

spectral-band-peak restricts the general spectral-peak construct (frequency of maximum energy in a spectrum) to a specific frequency band. The band-limited version derives from the unbounded general case.

Gammatone-filters model cochlear frequency selectivity and are used in timbre analysis to approximate how the human auditory system decomposes sound into perceptual bands. Timbre perception depends on cochlear filterbank processing; gammatone filter banks serve timbral classification, timbre similarity measures, and instrument identification by providing perceptually-motivated spectral decomposition.

spectral-par quantifies the peak-to-average energy ratio across the spectrum, used to characterize timbral brightness and spectral concentration — a core timbral attribute in audio classification and music analysis.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is text-linguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its definition, it is a discipline that studies extended stretches of language (texts, discourses) as structured wholes — a specific subfield within the discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: text-linguistics as the subdiscipline studying textual coherence, cohesion, and organization.

The glottal-source model constitutively depends on fundamental frequency as its primary parameter: F0 specifies the vibration rate of the vocal folds and determines the pitch of the source. Remove F0 from the model and the glottal source loses its defining characteristic — it becomes an undifferentiated airflow with no periodicity. The removal test (Law 8b) passes: without the parameter F0, the model cannot specify which voice it produces.

Spectral-band-rolloff computes the frequency below which a specified percentage of the total spectral energy within a band is concentrated. It requires spectral-band-energy to first compute the total energy and cumulative sums across bins. Removing spectral-band-energy eliminates the energy-per-bin values needed for the cumulative sum. The removal test passes: without spectral-band-energy, spectral-band-rolloff cannot operate.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: the glottal pulse is identified per pitch period as the airflow excursion whose onset coincides with glottal opening. The definition requires T0 from pitch tracking for period segmentation — without pitch tracking, the fundamental period cannot be determined, so the glottal pulse cannot be located or measured. Removal of pitch-tracking stops the construct from operating.

spectral masking is a psychoacoustic model defining how sounds at one frequency mask others — it is the foundation of perceptual audio coding (MP3, AAC, Opus) which uses masking thresholds for bit allocation. The model exists for the sake of compression systems.

Removal test (Law 8b): a speech act is, per its accepted definition, 'a spoken or written utterance that functions as an action — promising, ordering, declaring, questioning'. The utterance is an instance of the sign system: remove the language entry and utterances as meaningful sign-events no longer exist — what remains is acoustic or gestural behavior without illocutionary force, and no promising, ordering, declaring, or questioning can be PERFORMED, because performing them requires a system of signs. The construct stops operating, not merely stops being articulable. Constitutive dependency of the same accepted shape as discourse DEPENDS_ON language and rhetoric DEPENDS_ON language. Pinned sense: utterance-as-action (parameters: locutionary, illocutionary, perlocutionary), not the bare psychological effect — perlocutionary effects are parameter 3 and can follow any stimulus.

Spectral-band-smoothness quantifies how smoothly energy changes across bins within a sub-band. It serves timbre characterization by measuring spectral continuity — a key perceptual correlate of timbral brightness and roughness used in instrument classification.

spectral-sparseness measures how concentrated spectral energy is across frequency bins (ratio of squared sum to sum of squares). High sparseness = tonal signals (few active bins); low sparseness = diffuse/noise-like (many active bins). Tonal vs noise quality is a fundamental timbral distinction — this measure directly serves timbre characterization.

LPC was developed to solve the inverse problem of the source-filter model: given a speech signal, estimate the vocal tract filter parameters that produced it. The LPC algorithm operates by modeling the source-filter relationship — removing it removes the theoretical foundation of the method. Historical (1960s) and structural dependency.

Removal test (Law 8b): the accepted definition carves linguistic register as 'the map of the system of situationally differentiated language varieties a speech community develops and maintains', persisting as the stable sub-field of register analysis. Remove the language system — the system of symbolic signs — and the map has no territory: there are no varieties of a sign system to inventory, and the sub-field loses its object. The varieties persist as social conventions OF a sign system and the map persists as a subfield OF linguistics; both presuppose the sign system they organize. Follows the accepted DEPENDS_ON language edges from every other subfield (phonology, morphology, pragmatics, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics, linguistics). Pinned sense: the map and its sub-field, not individual utterances.

Cepstral peak picking locates peak in low-quefrency region. Quefrency is the independent axis of cepstrum where periodicity is measured. Removing quefrency means losing the axis along which peak is sought; picking cannot operate without the quefrency concept. Operational dependency holds.

FFT is an algorithm for computing the discrete Fourier transform. It implements the Fourier transform in O(n log n) time. Removing Fourier-transform as a concept stops FFT from having its mathematical foundation — FFT IS a specific efficient implementation of Fourier transform.

Removal test (L8b): the energy envelope is defined by windowed magnitude squaring - remove the windowing function and there is no per-frame energy computation left (raw per-frame sums are a degenerate case that still applies a rectangular window). Instance-level precedent accepted: short-time-energy DEPENDS_ON windowing-function, and short-time-energy is the per-frame scalar projection of this series. Same operand pairing one rung down the same ladder.

DEPENDS_ON removal test on the pinned sense: parameter (2) of the accepted definition is 'the fundamental period T0 from pitch tracking'; the closed phase is the interval between the flow minimum and the next flow maximum within one period, and CQ = closed phase / T0. Remove pitch-tracking and the period segmentation stops, so the quotient cannot compute. Same T0 pairing as the family's accepted jitter and shimmer edges; distinct from the accepted glottal-flow edge, which carries the signal-source sense.

Spectral centroid is computed as the center of mass of the magnitude spectrum in each frame: Σ(f·|X(f)|) / Σ|X(f)|. The calculation requires a spectrogram as its input — there is no spectral centroid without a time-frequency representation to compute over. The removal test: removing spectrogram eliminates the data structure that spectral-centroid operates upon.

Stress is a core component of prosody — the syllable-level prominence dimension. Prosody as a suprasegmental system contains stress (syllable prominence), pitch contour (intonation), duration patterns (rhythm), and intensity variations as its constituent dimensions.

Crest factor CF = max(E_i)/RMS requires peak amplitude max(E_i) to compute the numerator. Removing the concept of spectral-band-peak eliminates the numerator of the definition; the ratio cannot be computed. Operational dependency.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is speech-intelligibility a specific kind of cognitive-phenomenon? Yes. Speech-intelligibility — the degree to which speech is understood by a listener — is a cognitive phenomenon arising from the interaction of acoustic processing and language comprehension in the brain. Cognitive-phenomenon is the general kind of mind-substrate events and processes that this construct maps. Nearest accepted kind: cognitive-phenomenon (no intermediate kind interposes). Pinned sense: speech-intelligibility as the measurable phenomenon of how well speech is understood.

SERVES test (Law 8d: servant→master). prosody's accepted definition: "Prosody is the constructed linguistic framework for analyzing rhythmic, stress, and intonational patterns in spoken language." This framework provides the analytical categories (pitch contour, loudness, duration, syllable count) that phonetics uses to measure physical speech-sound properties. For whose sake? Phonetics — the discipline of physical speech-sound analysis. prosody (servant/analytical framework) → phonetics (master/user of the framework). The phonetics definition carves its method as "analysis proceeds by measurement and cross-linguistic description" — prosody provides the analytical categories for those measurements.

spectral-density IS a spectral-feature. Its accepted definition quantifies how signal power is distributed across frequency (ESD = |X(f)|², PSD = F{R(τ)}). This is a measurable aspect of frequency-domain structure. The nearest accepted kind is spectral-feature. spectral-density is a specific descriptor, not a distinct kind.

A spectrogram is a time-frequency representation computed by applying a windowed FFT (or equivalent DFT via FFT) to successive frames of a signal. Removing FFT means the DFT must be computed by direct summation — but FFT IS the algorithm that makes spectrogram computation tractable for practical frame lengths. Wait: the removal test asks if removing FFT stops the operation. Spectrogram can still compute via direct DFT. But FFT IS the DFT algorithm — removing the FFT concept removes the only practical DFT implementation for frame-based analysis. The removal test: without FFT, the spectrogram operation becomes impractical but not impossible (direct DFT exists). This is not a constitutive dependency — it's an implementation detail. STRIKE on DEPENDS_ON.

The glottogram is produced by inverse filtering the speech signal using the inverse of the linear-prediction filter. Without linear-prediction coefficients, the vocal-tract transfer function cannot be estimated, and the glottal flow waveform cannot be recovered.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): linguistic-register is the variety of language deployed according to setting, purpose, and participant relationships — one specific type of language-variety alongside dialect, sociolect, idiolect. Nearest accepted kind: language-variety.

Spectral flatness (or Wiener entropy) is computed as the ratio of the geometric mean to the arithmetic mean of the power spectral density: 10*log10(geometric mean / arithmetic mean). The logarithm is constitutive to this definition — it is used to compute the geometric mean and to express the final result. Removing logarithm stops the spectral flatness concept from having its defining mathematical operation.

Removal test (Law 8b): spectral-energy, per its accepted definition, is the total power of a frame — the sum of squared magnitude (per-bin energy) values across all frequency bins of the full spectrum. That sum is taken over exactly the per-bin energies that spectral-distribution stores as its ordered N-tuple (v_i = |A_i|², all bins). Remove spectral-distribution now and the per-bin energies the total is summed over are gone — the integration has no operand and the scalar is undefined. This is the full-spectrum mirror of the accepted anchor spectral-band-energy —DEPENDS_ON→ spectral-band-distribution (g790af750aa4f95a9d7db396f), which fixes the band case; the full-spectrum energy scalar was the one descriptor in the family missing its distribution anchor. The sense pinned is the frame-total power of the full spectrum (the definition's integration across all bins), not any sub-band restriction.

Spread computed as sqrt(sum E_i*(f_i - c)^2 / sum E_i) where c is spectral-band-centroid of same band per accepted definition v2. Removing centroid now eliminates c from the formula, so spread cannot be computed. Operational dependency, not just chronology or identity.

gammatone-filter-bank is a specific kind of filter-bank: an array of parallel gammatone filters (each a bandpass filter) tuned to ERB-spaced center frequencies, decomposing audio into cochlear-channel-like subbands. The filter-bank definition explicitly mentions 'the 40-band gammatone filter bank' as a standard perceptual filter bank. Nearest kind is filter-bank.

Pinned sense: INSTANCE_OF tests whether contact-quotient is a specific named member of the voice-quality family. The voice-quality definition carves the family as 'a fixed, named set maintained as the measurement map of voice-disorder assessment' and explicitly lists 'source-contact measures derived from electroglottography (contact quotient, open quotient)' as members. Contact quotient IS one of these named members, computed as contact phase / T0 with its own standardized reporting unit and maintained reference range. Nearest kind is voice-quality itself — same pattern as jitter, shimmer, open-quotient, closure-quotient each filing INSTANCE_OF→ voice-quality.

Rolloff (frequency at which cumulative spectral energy reaches a threshold) computes the cumulative sum of per-bin energies sorted by frequency. Removing spectral-band-energy would eliminate the per-bin energy values needed to compute cumulative sums for the rolloff threshold determination.

Spectral-band-complexity = exp(H)/N where H = -Σp_i·log(p_i) is the Shannon entropy of the normalized spectral power distribution {p_i = P_i/ΣP_j}. The complexity metric is a functional derived from the distribution — it computes an effective bin count from the entropy of the normalized distribution, making the distribution its historical and computational source.

Grammar as a formal rule system depends on computation — grammars are defined as computational devices that compute whether strings belong to a language and derive their structure. The rules of grammar operate as algorithms (computational procedures). Removing computation (the formal mechanism for systematic state transformation) would stop grammar from operating as a formal system.
Band-flatness is a scalar descriptor of the per-bin energy distribution within a sub-band, fitting the definition of a spectral-band feature.

The whole-spectrum spread formula (energy-weighted standard deviation of bin frequencies about the centroid, sqrt of the second central moment) is the general construct from which the band-limited variant was carved: spectral-band-spread restricts the same formula to bins within [f_low, f_high). The general full-spectrum measure existed first and fed into the band-restricted version. Chronology, not identity or dependency. [formal: dispersio spectralis]

Power spectrum is the squared magnitude of the magnitude spectrum as a function of frequency: |X(f)|². Frequency is the domain variable that gives the power spectrum its structural meaning — removing frequency stops the power spectrum from having a coordinate system or operational definition. The power spectrum IS a mapping from frequency to power; without frequency as a concept, this mapping has no meaning.

Removal test (Law 8b): lexicography compiles, defines, and records the lexicon of a language — its accepted definition ties the practice to the vocabulary of a sign system, and the board has already accepted lexicography DEPENDS_ON dictionary (the record) and lexicography INSTANCE_OF linguistics. Remove the language system and there is no lexicon to compile: the dictionary-making practice loses its object and stops operating. Follows the accepted DEPENDS_ON language edges from every other subfield (grammar, phonology, morphology, semantics-adjacent, pragmatics, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics). Pinned sense: lexicography as the practice of documenting a language's lexicon.

Syntax is the subsystem of language concerned with the rules and principles governing the combination of linguistic elements into well-formed structures. It is a constitutive component of language alongside phonology, morphology, and semantics, governing structural composition.
A spectral-band feature requires the per-bin energy vector of the band as its input — without the band distribution, no band-local scalar can be computed.

Pinned sense: auditory-filter serving speech-processing. Auditory-filter models cochlear channel response and is used as the element from which filter banks are built for speech processing front-ends (gammatone filter banks, bark filter banks). It serves speech-processing by providing the periphery model underlying auditory-based speech representations. SERVES direction: servant→beneficiary.

Pitch-class distribution is computed from chroma features: summing spectral energy into 12 pitch class bins. Removing chromagram eliminates the mel-warped frequency bins from which pitch classes are derived. The PCP histogram requires chromagram as its data source.

Cepstral coefficients are values defined in the quefrency domain — they are the output of the cepstrum operation which transforms from the frequency domain to the quefrency domain. Removing the concept of quefrency stops the cepstral coefficients from having their defining domain of operation. The quefrency domain IS the structural space in which cepstral coefficients exist and operate.

The STFT operates by dividing a signal into overlapping frames and applying the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) to each frame. The DFT is the core computational mechanism — STFT is literally DFT applied to windowed segments. Removing the DFT concept eliminates the mathematical operation that defines STFT; the technique cannot operate without it.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): syntax is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Accepted pattern mirrors linguistics CONTAINS phonology (Ezra, accepted): the accepted linguistics definition explicitly names syntax as one of its constituent subfields alongside phonology, morphology, semantics, and pragmatics. Syntax is a part of linguistics conceptual structure.

Spectral-band energy quantifies the total acoustic power within a frequency band — the raw energy sum that defines the brightness and weight of a timbre. It is the fundamental scalar from which timbral balance (energy ratios across bands) is derived. Without band energy, no timbral characterization via spectral balance is possible.

SERVES beneficiary: glottal-pulse is the periodic excitation of airflow generated by vocal fold vibration — the source excitation that, when filtered by the vocal-tract transfer function, produces the speech signal. It serves speech-processing applications including speech synthesis (where the pulse parameters drive synthesis), voice disorder analysis (where pulse shape deviations indicate pathology), and voice-analysis toolkits that model the glottal source. The pulse IS the fundamental input to the source-filter model used across speech processing.

Skewness computes the normalized third central moment of the per-bin energy distribution. The third moment requires the individual per-bin values to assess asymmetry. A scalar energy value cannot carry asymmetry information.

The glottogram is a fundamental intermediate representation in speech processing: it is the per-frame time series of estimated glottal airflow from inverse filtering, serving as the foundation for speech synthesis, voice conversion, and disordered speech analysis.

Direction tested (Law 9, specific to nearest accepted kind): per its accepted definition, spectral-peak-occupancy is a dimensionless scalar in [0,1] computed per analysis frame — the fraction of power-spectrum bins exceeding a noise-floor threshold — a numerical descriptor extracted from the signal's spectral representation that quantifies a measurable aspect of its frequency-domain structure (active bandwidth / tonal density). That is exactly what spectral-feature's accepted definition carves. Nearest accepted kind: no accepted kind entry stands between it and spectral-feature; the 29 accepted siblings (spectral-par, spectral-crest-factor, etc.) all run to the same kind. Not a leap: nothing on the ladder already reaches it.

Pinned sense: the cepstral-domain definition explicitly constructs the domain by computing the power spectrum of a signal via FFT. Removal test: without FFT as the computational mechanism for the power spectrum, step 1 of the construction fails. DEPENDS_ON holds — this is constitutive, not merely derived through the ladder, as the definition specifically identifies FFT as the implementation mechanism, not just power-spectrum as an abstract input.

Spectral-band skewness quantifies the asymmetry of energy distribution within a frequency band. This asymmetry is a discriminative feature in MIR for instrument classification, genre recognition, and audio retrieval — instruments with skewed spectral energy profiles (e.g., brass vs. woodwind) are separable using this descriptor.

Spectral peak occupancy computes O = (1/N) * sum_k I(P[k] > T) where P[k] is the power spectrum per-bin and T is a noise-floor threshold. It requires per-bin power values to compare each bin against the threshold. The per-bin energy vector IS spectral-distribution. Remove it and there is no per-bin data to iterate over; peak occupancy is undefined. The existing DEPENDS_ON to power-spectrum captures the representation type but not the per-bin energy vector needed to compute the indicator sum. Pinned sense: the fraction of frequency bins exceeding a noise-floor threshold.

Cepstral coefficients ARE the spectral envelope represented in the cepstral domain. Remove the spectral-envelope concept and cepstral coefficients lose their defining property — they would be uninterpretable mathematical values with no signal-theoretic meaning. The spectral envelope is constitutive to what cepstral coefficients represent.

Spectral-band-concentration = exp(-H) where H = -Σp_i·log(p_i) is the Shannon entropy of the normalized spectral power distribution {p_i = P_i/ΣP_j}. Concentration is a functional of the distribution — it computes a concentration index from the entropy of the normalized distribution, making the distribution its historical and computational source.

INSTANCE_OF (Law 9): spectral-evenness is a specific spectral analysis measure — the coefficient of variation of the per-bin energies, a per-frame scalar read off the energy vector — the same kind of construct as the accepted INSTANCE_OF members of spectral-feature (centroid, rolloff, par, entropy, …); nearest accepted kind, no intermediate band or family entry sits between it and spectral-feature.

Spectral-band-peak finds max{E[i]} within a frequency band. Each E[i] is spectral-band-energy (energy per bin within the band). Remove spectral-band-energy and the peak has no data to compare — the removal test passes. Direction: newer (band-peak epoch 0.01) depends on older (band-energy epoch 0.01).
SERVES: band variance quantifies energy dispersion within a band, serving MIR for timbre analysis, instrument recognition, and audio classification pipelines.

Direction tested (Law 7, chronology): the full-spectrum ratio PAR = max(E_i)/mean(E_i) over all bins is the primitive form; the band variant is the same ratio with its bin set restricted to [f_low, f_high), a parameterization of the general form rather than an independent invention — the restriction reads directly off the general formula in the filed definitions of both endpoints. This mirrors the accepted family edges spectral-band-concentration DERIVED_FROM spectral-concentration and spectral-band-smoothness DERIVED_FROM spectral-smoothness (both accepted). Not a dependency: the band ratio does not stop operating if the general form's name were removed. [formal: par spectrale banded]

CMVN serves speech-processing pipelines by stabilizing speaker-independent recognition and removing channel effects. For whose sake? speech-processing systems that analyze and recognize speech benefit from normalized features.
Rolloff computes the frequency below which a cumulative fraction of total energy is reached. Remove spectral-band-energy and there is no total to normalize the cumulative sum. Removal test passes.

Law 9: closure quotient is a specific named member of the voice-quality family. The accepted voice-quality definition carves the family as 'a fixed, named set maintained as the measurement map of voice-disorder assessment' and explicitly lists 'source-contact measures derived from electroglottography (contact quotient, open quotient)' among its members; CQ is the complementary closed-phase measure of the same named set, with its own computation (closed phase / T0), standardized reporting unit (quotient), and maintained reference range. Nearest accepted kind: the family entry itself, exactly as jitter, shimmer, HNR and open-quotient each file against it. A topic is not an instance of its discipline; here the parameter IS a named member of the family set.

Grammar is the whole system of rules for a language, and syntax is one of its constituent components (alongside morphology, phonology, semantics). Grammar contains syntax in the part-of sense of Law 10: syntax is a part inside the whole grammar. Pinned sense: grammar as a structured system of linguistic rules, syntax as its sentence-structure subcomponent.

VOT computation requires pitch tracking to identify the first phonation cycle and establish the periodicity onset criterion for the acoustic endpoint. Without pitch tracking, the onset-detection criterion (periodicity onset by autocorrelation) cannot be applied to the acoustic signal.
spectral-band-skewness is a statistical descriptor extracted from spectral representation within a band. A competent speaker classifies it as a spectral feature. Nearest kind is spectral-feature.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-variance is the variance of the per-bin energy values within the band. It is computed as Σ(E[i] − μ)²/N where μ and E[i] are derived from the per-bin energy vector — i.e. the spectral-band-distribution. Removing the distribution (the per-bin energy vector) makes variance computationally undefined; the formula operates directly on that vector.

Law 8b removal test, full-spectrum sense pinned: spectral-crossover (per its accepted definition) is the frequency at which the cumulative energy reaches 50% of the spectrum's total, computed by ordering bins in ascending frequency and accumulating the per-bin energies E_i = |A_i|^2 until the running total first reaches half the total. Remove spectral-distribution now and there is no ordered full-range per-bin energy tuple to accumulate — the crossing frequency cannot be determined and the construct stops operating. Same quantile family as the accepted spectral-rolloff (85%) → spectral-distribution anchor; the band variant spectral-band-crossover anchors on the band vector. Not identity, not purpose.

Smoothness (sum(√E_i)/N) involves per-bin energies. The arithmetic mean of square roots requires normalization by the total band energy to produce a scale-invariant measure. Removing spectral-band-energy would eliminate access to the total energy value needed for the scale normalization.

Spectral-band-evenness = σ/μ (coefficient of variation) of per-bin energies in a band. It quantifies energy uniformity — a standard MIR descriptor for timbre classification, instrument ID, and tonal vs noisy signal characterization. Built for the sake of MIR: persists as a standardized computation in audio analysis toolkits (librosa, Essentia).

Delta coefficients are temporal derivatives (first-order differences) of cepstral coefficients over a sliding window. They require cepstral-coefficients as input; removing cepstral-coefficients eliminates the signal being differentiated.

The glottogram provides the glottal-flow waveform g(n) from which all voice-quality parameters are derived: contact quotient, open quotient, closure quotient, shimmer, asymmetry coefficient, return phase. Without the glottogram, the source-filter analysis pipeline cannot produce these measures.

spectral-band-mode is a spectral analysis parameter that identifies the mode (most common energy bin) within a frequency sub-band.
