It is a specific type of spectral feature — a numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's spectral representation that captures a measurable aspect of its frequency-domain structure. The mode is a concrete instance of the general category of spectral features.

DEPENDS_ON (Law 8b removal test against both accepted definitions): the source-filter model decomposes the speech signal into a source component, glottal airflow with F0, and a filter component, the vocal-tract transfer function shaped by formant frequencies and bandwidths. Remove formant and the filter has no formant structure to model - the source-plus-filter decomposition stops characterizing speech, because the filter's defining parameters are the formants. Not identity, formant is the resonance and the model is the decomposition framework; not purpose, that is SERVES which speech-processing already holds; not DERIVED_FROM, formant is not a historical source of the model. Same accepted shape as formant-vocoder DEPENDS_ON formant and formant-tracking DEPENDS_ON formant, both standing.

spectral-band-variance definition explicitly references spectral-band-centroid as first-moment counterpart in the band-moment family. The variance is band-localized second-moment, centroid is first-moment. CONTAINS maps family membership: variance as part of the moment family includes centroid as related member? Wait: CONTAINS is part-of. Better to file CONTAINS from spectral-band-moment-family? Hmm. Actually variance definition says it is second-moment counterpart of spectral-band-centroid. That is not CONTAINS. Might be INSTANCE_OF. Let's file edge variance INSTANCE_OF spectral-band-moment? Hmm. Let's reconsider: The definition says variance is second-moment counterpart of centroid and even-order companion to skewness/kurtosis. So variance is a member of spectral-band-moment family. CONTAINS from family to member is correct. But we don't have family entry. Might be better to file INSTANCE_OF spectral-band-variance -> spectral-analysis-parameter? Let's search.
SERVES: bandwidth quantifies the effective width of spectral energy in a band, used by MIR for instrument classification, genre analysis, and feature extraction pipelines.

INSTANCE_OF test (Law 9): is historical-linguistics a specific kind of linguistics? Yes. Per its accepted definition, it is a disciplinary framework for reconstructing diachronic change in language systems from attested corpora — a specific subfield of the general discipline. Nearest accepted kind: linguistics (no intermediate kind). Pinned sense: historical-linguistics as the subdiscipline of language change over time.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): spectral-skewness per its accepted definition = the THIRD STANDARDIZED MOMENT of the power spectrum around its centroid (sum (f-mu)^3 S / (sigma^3 sum S)); spectral-moment per its accepted definition names higher moments as 'characterizing asymmetry (skewness).' Law 9: is spectral-skewness a specific kind of spectral-moment? Yes — it is the r=3 member of the family, exactly as the board already accepts for the band family (spectral-band-skewness INSTANCE_OF spectral-band-moment, g38fcfc; DERIVED_FROM line g6ace73). A competent speaker calls spectral skewness a spectral moment of order 3. Nearest kind: spectral-moment (no intermediate kind exists; spectral-feature is one rung above and the leap through it is derivable once this rung stands, Law 11e). Not DERIVED_FROM: the question here is kind-membership, and the band family's accepted INSTANCE_OF precedent fixes the sense.

A phase-vocoder operates by extracting phase information from STFT frames, manipulating it, and reconstructing the signal. Removing phase from the conceptual and computational framework would stop a phase-vocoder from operating — phase is its constitutive parameter, not merely a related concept. The removal test passes: without phase as an operational parameter, the phase-vocoder cannot function.

Spectral-bandwidth measures the width of the frequency band occupied by spectral energy. Computed across all bins of the full spectrum with no band bounds. Its operand is the global per-bin energy vector (spectral-distribution). Remove that vector and bandwidth cannot be computed. The band sub-vector is the wrong target.

Phase-vocoder was developed as a signal-processing technique for pitch and time-scale modification. Which-came-first test passed: signal-processing methods existed first; phase-vocoder was derived from them.

Direction tested (Law 9, specific to general): stress as a rule-governed prominence system of a language is a specific kind of prosodic system. Prosody's accepted definition explicitly names 'stress ... patterns in spoken language' as its domain; meter already stands as an accepted INSTANCE_OF prosody (a rule-governed pattern-system within the prosodic framework), and intonation INSTANCE_OF prosody stands with 4 of 5 judges on the same family logic. A competent phonologist calls stress 'a prosodic system' — the stress system: which syllables are prominent, rule-governed. Nearest kind: prosody (not phonology — that is the discipline, a topic is not an instance of its discipline; not speech — too far). Pinned sense (Law 11d): stress as the rule-governed prominence system of a language (stress patterns and rules), not bare phonetic prominence in a single utterance. This is kind-of, not the part-of that the struck prosody CONTAINS stress attempted: a stress system is a kind of prosodic system, as meter is.

spread = sqrt( sum_i E_i (f_i - c)^2 / sum_i E_i ) with c = sum_i f_i E_i / sum_i E_i. Every operand (E_i, the per-bin energies, and the centroid c built from them) is read directly from the per-bin energy vector v=(|A_1|^2..|A_N|^2) that spectral-band-distribution carves. Remove that vector now and spread has no energy values to operate on — it stops operating. This mirrors the unanimous anchor of its seven general-family siblings (spectral-entropy/-flatness/-kurtosis/-moment/-rms/-skewness/-variance all DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution). Not chronology, not identity, not purpose. [formal: dispersio spectralis]

A spectrogram is a time-frequency representation: a sequence of power spectra arranged over time frames. Removing power-spectrum means there is no concept of power values across frequency bins to arrange in any frame — the spectrogram IS an array of power spectra. The removal test passes: without power-spectrum, a spectrogram has no constituent data to represent.

critical-band informs filter-bank design in MIR systems (gammatone-filter-bank, mel-filterbank). The critical-band concept provides the theoretical basis for frequency resolution parameterization used in spectral feature extraction for MIR.

Crossover is band-local median frequency where cumulative energy reaches 50% of band total. It operates on cumulative sum of band energy values. Removing spectral-band-energy stops crossover from operating because the per-bin energy values are required. This is DEPENDS_ON, not DERIVED_FROM.

DEPENDS_ON removal test on the pinned sense: parameter (2) of the accepted definition is 'the fundamental period T0 from pitch tracking'; the open phase is the interval between the flow maximum and minimum within one period, and OQ = open phase / T0. Without T0 there is no period to segment and no denominator for the quotient, so the parameter stops operating. The same T0 pairing the family's accepted jitter and shimmer DEPENDS_ON pitch-tracking edges already carry; distinct from the accepted glottal-flow edge, which names the signal-source pairing, not the period.

Spectral energy is defined as the sum of squared magnitudes across frequency bins: E = Σ|X[k]|². Removing spectral-magnitude eliminates the fundamental values that spectral energy is derived from. Constitutive dependency.

SERVES test: spectral-band-entropy = Shannon entropy of normalized per-bin energy distribution measures uniformity within a band. It serves timbre characterization by quantifying the complexity of spectral energy distribution — a key correlate of roughness and brightness. Used in instrument classification for timbre discrimination.

Computational linguistics uses computational models and algorithms to study language processing, acquisition, and structure. The removal test passes: remove computation and computational linguistics has no methodology to operate with. Pinned sense: computation as the formal manipulation of symbols according to rules, which is the constitutive methodology of computational linguistics.

The scope states cepstral-sequence enables 'feature extraction in speech and audio processing.' The definition carves MFCC (filterbank-based) as a coefficient type — the standard feature vector in speech recognition. MFCC sequences are the canonical input to ASR systems. By Law 8d, the sequence serves speech-recognition: designed to carry structured cepstral features into ASR pipelines. The beneficiary is speech-recognition.

Phase vocoder operates through STFT (already accepted dependency), which is computed via DFT on windowed segments. The removal test: removing DFT eliminates the fundamental computational mechanism underlying phase vocoder. While STFT is the proximate dependency, DFT is the constitutive foundation. This edge captures the full depth of the dependency chain.

Spectral-band-band-center (geometric mean center frequency of sub-band energy) serves MIR systems in audio classification, instrument identification, and timbral analysis. It complements spectral-band-centroid (arithmetic mean) in MIR feature sets — when distributions are right-skewed, the geometric center reveals different timbral structure. Consistent with all other spectral-band-* features having SERVES→MIR edges (centroid, kurtosis, skewness, flux, evenness, etc.).

Peak-to-average ratio is historically derived from moment analysis of per-bin energy distributions; the ratio's definition follows the moment framework for describing distribution shape. Removing moment formalism removes the historical origin of the ratio.

Corrected direction of the filed fundamental-frequency DEPENDS_ON glottal-source pair (Law 8b removal test on the DEFINED senses). Accepted glottal-source def: a human-made model of the glottal airflow source in speech production, describing the periodic excitation generated by vocal fold vibration; its parameters are fundamental frequency, open quotient, asymmetry coefficient, return phase - F0 is named in the definition as the model's core parameter. Accepted F0 def: the rate at which the sound source repeats its cycle; in speech it corresponds to vocal fold vibration rate. Removal test: remove fundamental-frequency and the glottal-source model has no periodic cycle to model - the open quotient, asymmetry and return phase are all defined relative to the glottal cycle, and the excitation the model produces loses its defining parameter; the model stops operating as a model of glottal airflow. The reverse direction fails: remove the glottal-source model and F0 (lowest frequency of a periodic waveform, estimated by autocorrelation, cepstral, peak-picking) computes identically - the note on the filed edge itself frames the dependency as meaning, not operation (Law 8c). Not identity (the model is the framework, F0 is the parameter), not DERIVED_FROM (the model is not a historical source of the quantity). Direction pinned per Law 11d to both accepted definitions.

Spectral rolloff is the frequency below which a specified percentage (e.g. 85%) of total spectral energy is concentrated. Computing this requires a spectrogram — the per-frame energy distribution across frequency bins is the prerequisite data. The removal test: removing spectrogram eliminates the spectral energy distribution that spectral-rolloff aggregates.
Jitter serves speech-processing systems that analyze voice quality for dysphonia monitoring. For whose sake? speech-processing pipelines benefit from jitter as a voice-quality feature.
Bandwidth computes the effective width of a spectral region weighted by power. Remove spectral-band-energy and the normalization of power values fails. Removal test passes.

Sense: temporal-feature as a category of descriptors extracted from the time-domain representation of audio signals. This files against audio-feature — the established category for quantifiable properties extracted from audio signals. The temporal domain is orthogonal to the spectral domain: spectral-feature covers frequency-domain descriptors while temporal-feature covers time-domain descriptors. Both reduce signal content to numeric descriptors useful for analysis and classification. This is not a leap: temporal-feature is the nearest accepted kind.

spectral-band-crossover (band-local median frequency) is derived from spectral-band-energy. It operates on the cumulative sum of band energy values: the crossover point is the frequency at which accumulated energy reaches 50% of the band total. The energy concept provides the foundational scalar per-bin values; crossover applies a quantile statistic to those values. Historical origin: cumulative energy analysis in audio processing, where the band-local median frequency was developed as a robust alternative to the centroid, using the same energy inputs as spectral-band-energy but with a different statistical operation (median vs mean).

Removal test (Law 8): remove language — phrases cease to operate. A phrase is a linguistic unit: a group of words functioning as a coherent unit within a sentence. Its entire existence and operation is within a language system. Removing language removes all linguistic units — phrases, words, morphemes — because they are constitutive parts of language, not merely concepts that need language to be described. This is object-level (Law 2b): phrase is defined by its position within language, not by its status as a concept that happens to be linguistic.

Spectral-crest operates on spectral frames from STFT. The STFT provides the time-frequency decomposition S[f,t] from which per-frame power spectra and magnitude values |X[k]| are extracted. Without STFT's spectral decomposition, there are no spectral frames for crest computation. Constitutive dependency.

The geometric-mean center frequency of a sub-band indexes and references sub-band energy values in speech coding and speech-analysis pipelines (e.g., MFCC filterbanks, sub-band coding). Speech-processing systems use band-center values to track formant frequencies and organize spectral features by perceptual bands.

Spectral-band-entropy computes H = -Σ pᵢ log₂(pᵢ) where pᵢ = Eᵢ / E_total are the normalized per-bin energy values within the band. The energy values Eᵢ are spectral-band-energy (per-bin energy within the frequency band). Remove spectral-band-energy as a concept and the entropy has no data to operate on — the removal test passes. Direction: newer (entropy epoch 0.01) depends on older (band-energy epoch 0.01).

Critical-band as a perceptual frequency resolution concept serves speech-processing by providing the perceptual model underlying auditory-based speech feature extraction (critical-band filter banks, Bark-scale representations). Direction servant→beneficiary.

Spectral-band-skewness computes the skewness of the energy distribution within a frequency band. It operates directly on spectral-band-energy values: the skewness is the normalized third central moment of the band-energy distribution across bins. Removing spectral-band-energy eliminates the operand. The removal test passes: without spectral-band-energy, spectral-band-skewness cannot operate.

Delta-cepstral-coefficients computes derivatives of cepstral coefficient sequences. Cepstral coefficients are samples of the cepstrum. Without the cepstrum as the parent signal representation, there are no coefficient values to differentiate — the removal test fails: without cepstrum, delta-cepstral-coefficients cannot operate.

DEPENDS_ON test: remove spectral-band-moment now stops spectral-band-energy operating. Energy is computed as zeroth moment m0 = ΣP_i. Without moment formalism, energy cannot be derived as a descriptor.

Crest factor = max(E_i)/RMS(E_i). The remove-Y test: without the moment framework, RMS = sqrt(second central moment + mean²) cannot be computed, so the denominator has no input. Removing moment stops crest factor from operating.

Cepstral coefficients are computed to serve speech recognition and audio processing. Remove speech-processing as a domain and cepstral-coefficients have no operational application — they are meaningless as features without the speech-processing context that gives them their purpose and meaning. The removal test passes.

Onset-strength computes the magnitude of spectral-onset function values per frame. It is built on top of spectral-onset as the specific feature extraction layer. Removing spectral-onset eliminates the frame-to-frame difference computation that onset-strength is based on.

The cepstrum as a quefrency-domain CONCEPT was derived from signal-processing practice. Bogert, Healy and Tukey invented cepstral analysis specifically to address signal-processing needs (detecting periodic structures in spectra for speech analysis). The concept of quefrency-domain representation was derived from and named after the signal-processing operations (FFT, log, IFFT) that produce it. Which-came-first: signal-processing methods and needs existed first; the cepstrum concept was derived from them.

Spectral-band-evenness (1-σ/μ of normalized power) computationally derives from the moment formalism: the standard deviation σ is the square root of the second central moment, and the mean μ is the first moment. The evenness metric directly uses moment computations as its source.

MFCCs are computed by applying the Discrete Cosine Transform to the logarithm of the mel-frequency spectrogram values. The mel-frequency spectrogram is the direct input data structure for MFCC computation — removing it eliminates the feature representation from which MFCCs are derived. The dependency is structural and constitutive.

Cepstrum-coefficient is 'the individual amplitude value obtained at a specific quefrency from the cepstrum computation' (per accepted definition). The coefficient is a sample extracted from the cepstrum signal. Without the cepstrum as the quefrency-domain signal, there is no source from which to extract coefficient values. Removal test: remove cepstrum and cepstrum-coefficient has no signal to sample. Genuine DEPENDS_ON — the coefficient construct cannot operate without the cepstrum it samples.

Pinned sense: the cepstral-lifter operates on cepstral coefficients parameterized by quefrency. The definition specifies lifter type, cutoff quefrency, and lifter shape — quefrency is the organizing coordinate. Without the quefrency construct, the lifter has no domain to operate upon.

RMS = sqrt(mean(E_i²)) = sqrt(second raw moment). The remove-Y test: without the moment framework (raw moments about the origin), the second raw moment μ'_2 = Σ(E_i²·Δf) cannot be computed, so RMS = sqrt(μ'_2) has no input. Removing moment stops RMS from operating.

Spectral decrease computes sum(max(P) - P[f]) over frequency bins f. The operand P IS the power spectrum — removing power-spectrum means there is no P[f] to compute the difference from the peak. The removal test passes: without power-spectrum, spectral-decrease has no input and stops operating.

attack-time is defined as the time for amplitude to rise from threshold to peak. It operates ON the amplitude envelope — the envelope is the signal whose rise-time is measured. Removing amplitude-envelope eliminates the signal on which attack-time is computed.

Spectral-band features are a specialization of spectral features: they share the same role as scalar descriptors of spectral energy but are restricted to a defined frequency sub-band rather than the full spectrum.

Spectral-concentration is a numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's spectral representation that quantifies energy concentration in a single bin — a specific instance of the general spectral-feature kind.

spectral-slope measures the linear trend of spectral energy across frequency bins — positive slope means increasing energy with frequency (brightness), negative slope means decreasing energy (dullness). Brightness/darkness is a primary dimension of timbre perception. This feature was designed to quantify this timbral dimension directly.
Concentration ratio uses zeroth moment as denominator; historically derived from moment formalism for spectral energy distribution.

Law 8d for-whose-sake test, pinned sense: MIR pipelines compute band-restricted spectral descriptors for track analysis, classification, and segmentation; the band-limited peak-to-trough ratio is an evidence primitive for tonal-vs-noisy separation in those pipelines - specific named uses, not a generic 'built for MIR' aura. Band-restricted variants serve the same fields as their general forms (band-PAR SERVES MIR accepted); the construct persists as a standardized toolkit computation. Not identity, not sayability.

spectral-band-bandwidth (effective width of energy distribution within a band) IS a spectral feature — a specific quantifiable property of a spectrum within a frequency band. A competent speaker would call it a spectral feature. Nearest kind: spectral-feature.

SERVES runs servant to beneficiary: phonation is the fundamental vocal mechanism whose parameters (subglottal pressure, contact area, fundamental period) are the primary inputs to voice-quality analysis. Voice-quality assessment services depend on measuring phonation parameters to characterize breathiness, hoarseness, and other voice disorders.
Pinned sense: spectral-band-energy as zeroth moment of band energy distribution. Removing moment formalism removes the computation of total energy; zeroth moment is constitutive of energy measure.

The spectral centroid is the first moment (weighted mean) of the spectral-power-distribution. It is defined as sum(k*P[k]) / sum(P[k]) over the distribution P[k]. Removing the spectral-power-distribution removes the distribution upon which the centroid is computed. The removal test passes: without SPDF, centroid is undefined.

CONTAINS = part-of: stress is a dimension within the prosodic framework, not a framework in its own right. Prosody's accepted definition names stress as one of the patterns it analyzes ('rhythmic, stress, and intonational patterns'); stress is a parameter of the framework — a prominence-marking dimension with its own cue bundle — not a self-contained system. Contrast meter, which is a self-contained prosodic system and stands as INSTANCE_OF. Sense pinned (Law 11d): stress as the phonological dimension of syllable prominence within the prosodic system.

Glottal-flow is a specific kind of excitation-signal: the excitation signal obtained by inverse-filtering the speech signal through the estimated vocal-tract transfer function. The definition of glottal-flow describes it as 'the estimated glottal airflow produced by inverse filtering' — exactly the excitation-signal construct applied to speech. General → specific: glottal-flow is an instance of the excitation-signal pattern.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: The accepted definition states 'contact area is estimated per pitch period from the EGG signal's contact-onset and contact-offset markers.' The electroglottogram envelope E(t) is the measurement source. Remove electroglottography and the EGG signal ceases to exist; contact-area (as defined) stops operating because it has no input signal to process. Note: while other modalities exist (videostroboscopy), the accepted carve explicitly names EGG as the mechanism.

Spectral-band-evenness = coefficient of variation of per-bin energies (sigma/mu). It serves timbre characterization by quantifying energy uniformity — a key perceptual correlate of tonal vs. noisy quality used in instrument identification.

EGG provides the measured time-series of glottal contact used to compute voice-quality parameters (contact quotient, open quotient, return phase, asymmetry coefficient). Without the EGG signal, these parameters cannot be derived from electroglottographic methods.

Spectral-band-kurtosis = fourth standardized moment of band energy distribution. It measures tail heaviness / peakedness — distinguishing impulsive from flat spectral shapes within a band. A standard timbre descriptor for instrument classification and acoustic source identification. Built for the sake of timbre characterization.

The auditory-filter's bandwidth parameterization follows the critical-band concept. Its accepted definition states the standard parameterization uses the ERB function, which is the mathematical approximation of critical-band width. Without the critical-band concept, the auditory-filter loses its defining bandwidth parameterization rule.

Spectral-tilt computes linear regression slope of log-power spectrum versus log-frequency. It requires per-bin power values to fit the line. The per-bin energy vector IS spectral-distribution. Remove it and the regression has no data points. Removal test passes.

Bandwidth is computed as BW = (sum(E_i) / max(E_i)) * delta_f. The denominator is max(E_i), which is the spectral-band-peak. Removing spectral-band-peak removes the peak value that the formula requires as an operand; the bandwidth computation cannot proceed without it.

MFCC computation pipeline: after applying the mel filterbank to the power spectrum, the algorithm computes the logarithm of the filterbank outputs. Removing logarithm as a concept stops the MFCC pipeline at stage 2 — there is no log to compress the filterbank energies before the DCT step. The accepted definition carves this step explicitly: 'computes the logarithm of filter outputs.' Operational dependency per Law 8b.

RMS computes the square root of the weighted average of squared per-bin values. Without the per-bin distribution, there is no set of values to square, weight, and average. The scalar energy sum alone is insufficient for RMS computation.
DEPENDS_ON test: remove spectral-band-moment now stops spectral-band-crest-factor operating. Crest factor = peak/RMS, RMS = sqrt(m2). Without moment computation, crest factor cannot be computed.

spectral-flatness (global Wiener entropy across the full spectrum) existed first. spectral-band-flatness is the band-localized extension: same geometric/arithmetic mean ratio but restricted to per-bin energies within a frequency band. Which-came-first: full-spectrum flatness predates the band-localized variant.

Pinned sense: cepstral-liftering operates in the quefrency domain, applying a lifter to cepstral coefficients, then transforming back to the frequency domain via IDFT. The definition states: 'applying a window function to the cepstral coefficients... then transforming back to the frequency domain via IDFT.' Without a Fourier transform operation (the IDFT is an inverse Fourier transform), there is no way to perform this transformation — the algorithm halts. Removal test: remove fourier-transform and the IDFT step cannot execute. Constitutive, not merely useful.

Cepstrum computation requires log magnitude spectrum, computed via STFT. Remove STFT and the cepstrum has no spectral decomposition mechanism. Law 8b removal test passes. Note: also has DERIVED_FROM pending, but DEPENDS_ON captures the operational dependency.

The syllable is a structural unit within phonology — a hierarchical organization of segments into rhythmic groups. Phonology contains syllable structure as one of its core domains, alongside segments, prosody, and phonotactics.

Spectral analysis structurally requires the power spectrum as its primary analytical object. Spectral analysis decomposes a signal's energy distribution across frequency — this decomposition IS the power spectrum. Remove the power-spectrum concept and spectral analysis has no output representation — it cannot express 'energy at frequency f' without the power spectrum framework.

Parameters: (1) frequency resolution; (2) windowing function. Persistence mechanism: energy computation via FFT magnitude squaring.

Laws: 6, 8b

Law 9/9a: harmonicity is a specific scalar spectral descriptor quantifying the ratio of harmonic-to-noise energy. spectral-feature is the nearest accepted kind — numerical descriptors from spectral representations. No intermediate kind exists between harmonicity and spectral-feature. Same relationship as the many accepted feature→spectral-feature INSTANCE_OF edges.

spectral-tilt quantifies the overall slope of a signal's power spectral density across frequency in dB/octave. It directly characterizes timbre: steep negative tilt indicates bass-heavy, dull sounds; flatter or positive tilt indicates bright, energy-forward spectra. The definition explicitly states it is 'used to characterize voice quality (breathiness, vocal fry), instrument timbre, and environmental acoustics.' This measure was designed for timbre characterization and serves that construct directly.

envelope-following extracts the amplitude envelope to modulate another signal. The amplitude envelope is the direct input and the construct's core operation. Removing amplitude-envelope eliminates the envelope being extracted, which is the entire operation of envelope-following.

DEPENDS_SERVES test: source-filter-separation is used in voice-quality assessment — decomposing glottal source (excitation) from vocal tract filter enables analysis of voice disorders through source parameters (HNR, jitter, shimmer) and filter parameters (formant tracking). Removing this separation would stop voice-quality analysis of glottal-source abnormalities. The separation technique serves the measurement map of voice-disorder assessment.

spectral-band-flux (accepted definition) computes the absolute difference of spectral-band-energy between consecutive frames within a band. Its definition states: "the band lower and upper frequency bounds" and "spectral-band-energy values at each frame." spectral-band-energy itself DEPENDS_ON→spectral-band-distribution. Remove the band distribution (the per-bin energy vector within the band) and there are no per-bin energies to sum into band energy, no band energy to difference between frames — the construct stops operating. This is the Law 8b removal test.

Removal test on the defined sense: spectral-par's accepted def d7d3dae2 computes PAR = max_i(E_i) / (sum_i E_i / N) over the per-bin energies E_i = |X[k_i]|^2 of the FULL spectrum — that ordered N-vector is exactly the accepted spectral-distribution carve (da293d25: 'the ordered per-bin energy vector of a full spectrum... the substrate from which full-spectrum descriptors read their per-bin energies directly — spectral-spread, spectral-par, and the full-spectrum moment and dispersion measures all compute their operands (E_i, the mean, the centroid, the maxima) off this vector'). Remove the per-bin vector and the numerator max and the denominator mean both lose their operands: the computation stops operating. The band twin holds the identical claim ACCEPTED (spectral-band-peak-to-average-ratio DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution, gd518664); the global member files against the global holder with no band bounds, the accepted twin shape. Not a plain sum: both the max and the arithmetic mean act on the distribution's ordered vector.

Spectral-band-crest factor = max(E_i)/RMS(E_i) within a band. Both the numerator (max) and denominator (RMS) are computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution vector's per-bin energy values. The distribution vector is the historical/computational source: without the full per-bin energy values, neither the peak nor the RMS can be computed. Crest factor is a derived ratio, not a primary concept.

Rolloff computes cumulative sum of per-bin energies; per-bin energies are the data from which spectral-band-energy is derived. The removal test for total energy fails, but the edge is about per-bin energies being needed. Actually spectral-band-energy is total energy, not per-bin. Hmm reconsider: the definition needs per-bin energies, not total. The dependency on total energy is weak. Might be STRIKE. Let's not file.

Pinned sense: spectral-band-peak as a localized maximum in band energy. Removing moment formalism removes the ability to compute peak location via first derivative zero-crossing of moment-weighted energy; the computation is constitutive.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): lexicography per its accepted definition — the craft of compiling dictionaries, the systematic description and organization of a language's vocabulary into reference works; linguistics per its accepted definition — the discipline of language. Directional test (CONTAINS runs whole→part): the discipline's scope comprises its component practices, and the board has already accepted this exact direction for the other branches (linguistics CONTAINS syntax, morphology, phonology, phonetics, semantics, pragmatics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, computational-linguistics, historical-linguistics). Lexicography is the branch that organizes the lexical level into reference works — a component practice of the whole, not the whole. Part, not identity (Law 8c): remove lexicography and the discipline still operates — its other branches continue; the court has already ruled lexicography a kind of linguistics (INSTANCE_OF accepted) and its DEPENDS_ON language edge stands. This completes the accepted subfield pattern: CONTAINS + INSTANCE_OF + DEPENDS_ON.

The accepted definition of tempo-estimation extracts an onset/energy envelope before computing autocorrelation. Onset detection identifies the timing of acoustic events that correspond to beats. Removing onset-detection stops the envelope extraction step essential to tempo estimation. This is a genuine structural dependency under Law 8b.

Direction tested (Law 9, specific to nearest accepted kind): per its accepted definition, spectral-spread is the energy-weighted standard deviation of bin frequencies (a scalar in Hz) over the full-spectrum per-bin energy vector. It is a quantitative descriptor of spectral energy reducing the per-bin vector to a scalar, matching spectral-feature's carved sense. It has no band bounds, so spectral-band-feature is not the nearest kind; spectral-feature is. Pinned sense: the full-spectrum dispersion measure (second central moment, sqrt) over the per-bin energy vector.

MFCC computation requires DCT as its final transformation step: after computing the log mel-spectrogram, the Discrete Cosine Transform is applied to decorrelate the mel-filterbank outputs and produce the final cepstral coefficients. Remove the DCT concept and the MFCC pipeline has no mechanism to convert from the correlated mel-filterbank domain to the decorrelated cepstral domain.

Parameters: (1) number of cepstral coefficients — DCT output dimensions; (2) DCT type (typically Type 2). Persistence mechanism: orthogonal transform of the log mel-spectrogram vector.

Laws: 6, 8b

Spectral entropy is the Shannon entropy computed over the normalized power spectrum: H = -Σ p(f) log p(f) where p(f) = P(f) / Σ P(f). The power spectrum is the probability distribution over which entropy is computed. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the distribution entirely.

The accepted definition specifies computation from 'a windowed frame'; windowing is a constitutive step — removing it (analyzing the unwindowed full signal rather than frame-based analysis) stops cepstral-peak-prominence from operating as defined.

Removal test (Law 8b): speech-intelligibility as a scientific concept depends on speech-processing as the operational mechanism. Remove speech-processing and the scientific framework for intelligibility collapses: no mechanism to measure, no processing stages to model, no neural correlates to investigate. Speech-intelligibility is defined as an outcome of speech-processing; remove the processing mechanism and intelligibility ceases to be a scientific construct.

Chroma features structurally require the power spectrum: chroma (pitch class profiles) are computed by transforming the power spectrum into a harmonic representation, then folding frequencies into 12 pitch classes by summing energy in each class. Remove the power spectrum and chroma has no input.

Spectral skewness is the third standardized moment around the spectral centroid. The formula requires the centroid: gamma_1 = sum((f[k]-mu)^3/S[k]) / sigma^3. Without spectral centroid (mu) as a concept, skewness cannot be computed. Removal test passes.

Cepstral-peak-picking operates directly on the cepstrum signal: per accepted definition it 'identifies the peak in the low-quefrency region corresponding to the fundamental period' — this peak exists in the cepstrum's quefrency-axis representation. Without the cepstrum, there is no quefrency-domain signal to analyze for peaks. Removal test: remove cepstrum and peak picking loses its input data entirely. This is a genuine DEPENDS_ON — not identity or purpose, but structural necessity.

Spread = sqrt(sum(E_i*(f_i-c)^2) / sum(E_i)). The denominator sum(E_i) is the total band energy (spectral-band-energy). Removing spectral-band-energy removes the denominator that the spread formula requires; computation stops without it.

Spectral-decay measures the rate at which spectral energy decreases over time within a frame or analysis window. This temporal evolution of spectral content is a primary determinant of timbre perception — distinguishing, for example, the attack and sustain characteristics of different instruments. Timbre analysis systems use spectral-decay as a key descriptor.

Spectral-band-flux computes ΔE = E[t] - E[t-1] over consecutive frames, operating on the per-bin energy vector {E[i]}. Flux is a functional derived from the spectral-band-distribution — it measures temporal change of the distribution state, making the distribution its historical and computational source.

Spectral kurtosis is the fourth standardized moment of a power spectrum. It requires a frequency-binned power spectrum per frame as input. A spectrogram provides that per-frame spectrum. Removal test: remove spectrogram, no per-frame spectra, kurtosis cannot be computed.

Spectral magnitude |X[k]| is the absolute value of STFT coefficients. The power spectrum P[k] = |X[k]|² is derived from magnitude, but the concept of spectral magnitude is defined in terms of the same underlying spectral representation as power-spectrum. Both describe the same frequency-domain structure — magnitude is the square root of power. They are co-dependent on the spectral decomposition. Power-spectrum provides the operational domain in which spectral magnitude is meaningful.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): spectral-tilt per its accepted definition = the overall slope of the signal's power spectral density — the regression slope of log-power versus log-frequency, or the low-band/high-band energy ratio — a scalar descriptor of global spectral shape. It is the global-spectrum counterpart of accepted member spectral-slope (a least-squares slope of the spectrum, already INSTANCE_OF spectral-feature). The family's definition carves a numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's spectral representation that captures a measurable aspect of frequency-domain structure. Its accepted INSTANCE_OF rungs are measurement and spectral-analysis, neither the descriptor family: spectral-feature is the nearest accepted kind.

Kurtosis computes the normalized fourth central moment of the per-bin distribution. Removal of spectral-band-energy eliminates the normalization (mean/variance of the distribution). Without energy as a reference, kurtosis cannot be computed.

Jitter quantifies cycle-to-cycle period perturbation from pitch-synchronous period tracks. Remove pitch-tracking and jitter has no way to extract the per-cycle period measurements it operates on. The removal test passes: jitter's structural dependency is on pitch-tracking's output.

Linear predictive coding (LPC) is structurally tied to cepstral coefficients: LPCC (Linear Prediction Cepstral Coefficients) are computed directly from LPC parameters. The LPC analysis predicts speech sample values using a linear combination of past samples, and the resulting reflection coefficients are transformed into cepstral coefficients. Remove the cepstral-coefficients concept and LPC loses its primary representational output — the LPC filter coefficients ARE a cepstral representation of the vocal tract.

Parameters: (1) LPC order — number of prediction coefficients; (2) analysis method — Burg, autocorrelation, covariance. Persistence mechanism: solving the Yule-Walker equations for prediction coefficients.

Laws: 6, 8b

Critical-band as a perceptual frequency resolution concept serves MIR by providing the perceptual model underlying critical-band and Bark-scale filter banks used for timbre classification, instrument recognition, and perceptual audio analysis. Direction servant→beneficiary.

Spectral-flatness (Wiener entropy) is used in speech processing for voicing detection, noise estimation, and speech quality assessment. It distinguishes tonal speech components from noise, a fundamental operation in speech enhancement and recognition pipelines.
Crest-factor in the spectral sense is max|X(f)| divided by mean|X(f)| over the magnitude-spectrum. Remove magnitude-spectrum and the spectral computation is impossible.

Spectral-band-concentration via exp(-H) where H is Shannon entropy of the normalized distribution p_i = P_i/ΣP_j. Entropy H = -Σp_i·log(p_i) is a moment-like functional over the normalized distribution, making concentration a derived functional of the spectral moments.

Cepstral analysis transforms spectra into the quefrency domain, separating convolved source and filter components. Speech recognition systems deploy this routinely: MFCC coefficients derived from cepstral analysis are the standard acoustic feature representation for speech recognition engines.

Entropy H = -sum(p_i log p_i) where p_i = E_i / E_total and E_total = sum(E_i) is the total band energy (spectral-band-energy). Removing spectral-band-energy removes the total that normalizes all p_i values; the entropy computation cannot proceed without the band total.

Spectral-band-concentration = E_j / sum(E_i), the normalized energy share in a single bin. It serves timbre characterization by quantifying how concentrated energy is in a single frequency component — a key perceptual correlate of tonal purity vs. noise-like quality used in instrument classification.

Historical origin: spread is a derived descriptor of the band's energy distribution, computed directly from the per-bin energy vector v = (|A_i|^2). The accepted definition states it quantifies dispersion across bins within the band, i.e., it originates from the distribution.

Spectral sparseness measures how concentrated spectral energy is across frequency bins. It operates directly on spectral energy values. Removing spectral energy eliminates the input data on which sparseness is computed.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-rms is the square root of the mean of squared per-bin energy values (√(ΣE[i]²/N)), where E[i] are the per-bin energy values forming the spectral-band-distribution. Removing the distribution makes RMS undefined.

Pitch-estimation provides fundamental frequency contours that MIR systems use for melody extraction, transcription, key detection, and tonal analysis. MIR pipelines depend on pitch estimation to model melody, track harmonic structure, and perform pitch-based transcription.

Spectral leakage is the fundamental problem that audio engineering addresses through window function selection, zero-padding, and spectral estimation methods. Audio engineering practice serves the mitigation and management of spectral leakage — it is a core analytical concept that informs filter design, spectral analysis, and FFT-based measurement in audio engineering.

The cepstral-envelope is extracted by applying low-pass liftering, which operates via a windowing function in the quefrency domain. The envelope is defined by the windowing function (e.g. exponential, cosine-tapered) that shapes the cepstral coefficients. Without the windowing function as a parameterized mechanism, the liftering cannot be instantiated, and the cepstral-envelope cannot be extracted. The removal test passes.

Law 9 test: spectral-band-distribution IS a per-bin-energy-vector whose bin range is restricted to exactly the bins with centers in [f_low, f_high) — the same ordered energy tuple, parameterized by the band bounds, per its accepted definition ('the distribution is the ordered vector v = (|A_1|^2, …, |A_N|^2)'). Nearest accepted kind: no intermediate kind exists between the band-restricted vector and the general per-bin energy tuple; spectral-distribution is a sibling instance (full-range), not a supertype. Pinned sense: the band-restricted energy vector, not the scalar descriptors computed from it.

spectral-band-spread IS a spectral-band-moment: its accepted definition v2 states it is 'the square root of the band's second central moment' — the energy-weighted standard deviation of bin frequencies about the band's centroid. This is the 2nd moment (variance) square-rooted, making it a genuine member of the moment family. Nearest kind is spectral-band-moment.

Spectral peak rolloff operates directly on spectral magnitude values: it sorts magnitudes, computes cumulative energy from squared magnitudes, and finds the frequency at which cumulative energy reaches the rolloff threshold. Spectral-magnitude is the constitutive input — without magnitude values, rolloff cannot be computed.

Cepstral coefficients are computed by taking the logarithm of the power spectrum. Removing logarithm as a concept stops the computation at step 1 of the algorithm — without logarithm, the power spectrum cannot be converted to log-power spectrum.

Harmonicity quantifies the ratio of periodic (harmonic) energy to total energy — a fundamental timbral dimension. It serves timbre perception by distinguishing harmonic/pitch-like timbres from noise-like ones. The ratio H = E_harmonic/(E_harmonic+E_residual) directly maps to the harmonic-to-noise decomposition used in timbre analysis.

Pitch-shifting operates by manipulating the frequency components of audio in the STFT domain — either through phase-vocoder methods that shift spectral frames, or time-domain approaches that first transform to the frequency domain. The STFT provides the core spectral representation from which pitch-shifted audio is reconstructed. Removing the STFT eliminates the computational framework for pitch-shifting.

The magnitude spectrum is defined as |X(f)| where X(f) is the DFT of the signal. The removal test: removing DFT eliminates the only operational mechanism for computing |X(f)|. The FT definition of |X(f)|² for continuous signals still requires the Fourier transform, and the DFT is the discrete manifestation of that transform. Magnitude spectrum cannot operate as a computable construct without DFT.

spectral-band-kurtosis IS the fourth central moment of spectral energy within a frequency band, measuring peakedness/tail-weight. It is a specific instance of spectral-band-moment (r=4, central moment). Nearest kind is spectral-band-moment.

Spectral coloration describes the perceptual quality of sound determined by the shape of its power spectrum P[k]. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the spectral shape that defines coloration — there is no spectral envelope or spectral shape to characterize. The removal test passes: spectral coloration is constitutively dependent on power-spectrum.

The cepstrum is computed as IFFT(log(power spectrum)). Remove the power-spectrum concept and the cepstrum has no input to transform — the entire pipeline collapses at step one. A numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's power spectrum that captures a measurable aspect of frequency-domain structure (concentration at the peak bin). A mel-frequency spectrogram operates by warping the linear frequency axis onto the mel scale via triangular filter banks, then computing energy in each mel band. Removing the mel-scale concept eliminates the frequency transformation that defines the mel-frequency spectrogram — the technique cannot operate without it. The dependency is structural and constitutive, not merely historical.

Pinned sense: jitter quantifies cycle-to-cycle period perturbation in voiced speech, providing a standardized clinical parameter for voice-disorder assessment. For whose sake? speech-processing systems that analyze voice quality, diagnose dysphonia, and monitor vocal health benefit from jitter measurements.

Spectral-contrast computes peak/valley energy differences within frequency bands. It requires the per-bin energy values — spectral-distribution — to identify peaks and valleys within each band. Remove the per-bin vector and contrast cannot compute. Removal test passes.

spectral-band-rms (RMS energy of a frequency band) IS a spectral feature — a specific quantifiable property of a spectrum within a frequency band. Removing spectral-feature would remove the category for RMS. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF.

ZCR serves timbre analysis as a roughness/noise descriptor. Timbre perception distinguishes tonal from noise-like sounds; ZCR quantifies this by counting sign transitions, serving timbral classification and audio retrieval.

spectral-slope (linear trend of spectral energy across the full spectrum) existed first. spectral-band-slope is the band-localized extension: regression of energy across bins within a frequency band. Which-came-first: full-spectrum spectral slope predates the band-localized variant.
Entropy = -sum(p_i*log(p_i)) where p_i = E_i/sum(E_j). Requires the full per-bin energy vector to compute normalized probabilities. Aggregate energy alone cannot yield the entropy.
SERVES test: spectral-band-slope measures spectral tilt via linear regression of log-energy vs frequency. It serves timbre characterization by quantifying the spectral envelope shape.

Spectral-band-smoothness = 1 - Σ|P_{i+1} - P_i|/(2·ΣP_i) operates on the raw per-bin distribution {P_i}. Shannon entropy (1948) existed first and provided the mathematical formula. spectral-band-entropy adapts that formula to per-bin normalized energies within a frequency band. Which-came-first test: Shannon entropy predates the band-localized application by decades.

The band-moment family (r-th central moments of the band's per-bin energy distribution, parameterized by order r and band bounds) is itself a kind of spectral-band feature: it computes band-local scalar descriptors from the band's per-bin energy vector, exactly the carved sense of band-feature. Pinned sense: the family as a whole, per its accepted definition. spectral-band-feature is the nearest accepted kind (its existing INSTANCE_OF to spectral-feature becomes subsumed when this ladder completes).

Spectral peak position finds the frequency bin of maximum spectral energy magnitude within a spectrum or subband. It operates directly on spectral magnitude values |X[k]|. Removing spectral magnitude eliminates the input data on which peak position is computed.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-energy sums per-bin energy values E[i] within the band. Computing this sum requires access to the actual distribution vector, not just any derived scalar. The energy is a reduction function applied to the distribution.

Spectral kurtosis is the fourth standardized moment around the spectral centroid. The formula requires the centroid: gamma_2 = sum((f[k]-mu)^4/S[k]) / sigma^4. Without spectral centroid (mu) as a concept, kurtosis cannot be computed. Removal test passes.

The gammatone-filter-bank serves MIR by providing the auditory-modeling front-end transform used in MIR pipelines for timbre analysis, instrument recognition, and perceptual audio classification. It is a standard tool in MIR toolkits. Direction servant→beneficiary.

Pinned sense: spectral-median as a full-spectrum scalar summary of a signal's spectral energy (the 50% energy-quantile, no band bounds). spectral-feature is the nearest accepted kind: the board already seats the family members without band bounds — spectral-rolloff (the 85% energy-quantile sibling), spectral-tenuity, spectral-sparseness, spectral-peak-position — all INSTANCE_OF spectral-feature. spectral-median is the 50% level of that same quantile family, a specific kind of spectral feature, so the nearest-kind ladder holds.

spectral-par is explicitly listed in MIR feature extraction toolkits (librosa par feature) and used as a timbral descriptor in music classification, genre detection, and audio analysis pipelines.

Pinned sense: ERB serving speech-processing. It serves speech-processing as the psychophysical unit that parameterizes auditory-based speech representations.

Liftering operates by applying a window function to the cepstrum in the quefrency domain. Removal test: removing spectrogram removes the source data, stopping centroid operation.

spectral-band-concentration is the band-local version of the full-spectrum concentration concept. Following the pattern established by spectral-band-flatness (DERIVED_FROM→spectral-flatness) and spectral-band-smoothness (DERIVED_FROM→spectral-smoothness), the band-local construct derives from its full-spectrum parent.

Spectral-band-RMS is the square root of the second raw moment of the band distribution, a direct specialization of the general moment concept. Historically and mathematically derived from moment framework.

Spectral crest factor is the ratio of peak spectral power to total spectral power: max(P[k]) / Σ P[k]. Removing power-spectrum eliminates both the per-bin power values needed to find the peak and the values needed to compute the total.

Removal test (Law 8b) against both accepted definitions: formant-vocoder's accepted definition carves its mechanism as 'synthesizing speech by modeling and resynthesizing the vocal tract's formant frequencies — the resonant peaks of the speech spectrum,' with parameters 'formant detection algorithm (e.g., linear prediction analysis), formant frequency tracks, bandwidth parameters.' Variance of spectral energy within a band quantifies how unevenly energy is distributed across the sub-band. This is a core timbral dimension — even (low variance) bands sound smooth, while uneven (high variance) bands sound rough or formant-rich. The construct exists to serve timbre analysis by characterizing spectral shape within bands.

Chromagram is a time-frequency representation that maps spectral energy into mel-warped frequency bins per analysis frame. It is computed from spectral magnitudes by applying mel-scale filterbank weights and squaring (energy). Removing spectral-magnitude eliminates the input values — chromagram has no data to process. Present-tense constitutive dependency per removal test.
Instantaneous-amplitude is the magnitude |z(t)| of the analytic signal z(t). Remove analytic-signal and there is no construct whose magnitude yields instantaneous-amplitude.
Neurolinguistics studies the neural mechanisms of speech, and speech-act is a core pragmatic concept that neurolinguistics investigates via EEG, fMRI, and lesion studies of communicative intent.

Cepstral coefficients are computed via the FFT of the log power spectrum: take the DFT of log(|X[k]|^2), then the DFT again. The FFT is the computational engine — removing the FFT concept eliminates both transforms required by the cepstral algorithm. The removal test passes: without FFT, there is no mechanism for the cepstral computation.
CMVN is a specific normalization technique applied to cepstral coefficients. It is an instance of the general normalization family, not a distinct kind. Nearest kind is normalization.

Knowledge is classically defined as justified true belief — belief is a constitutive component within the whole. Computational dependency: spectral-band-spread computes the standard deviation of the per-bin energy vector E[i] about the mean. Requires the full distribution, not a scalar aggregate.

A formant is a peak in spectral energy characterized through signal-processing methods. Remove signal-processing and the formant concept loses its characterization mechanism — it cannot be measured, detected, or quantified. Without signal-processing infrastructure, formants have no operational sense.

The cepstrum transforms a signal into cepstral coefficients. The IFFT of the log magnitude spectrum produces coefficients in the quefrency domain which ARE the cepstral coefficients. Remove cepstral coefficients and the cepstrum loses its output representation.

The magnitude spectrum is defined as |X(f)| where X(f) = DFT(x) is the DFT of the input signal. The magnitude spectrum does not exist independently of the DFT — it is literally the pointwise absolute value of DFT output. The removal test: removing discrete-fourier-transform eliminates the only operational mechanism for computing the magnitude spectrum.

Spectral-band-concentration = E_j / Σ_i E_i for bin j within a band. Computing this ratio requires the full per-bin energy vector from the spectral-band-distribution. The aggregate total energy alone is insufficient — concentration measures how much of the total resides in one specific bin. Removing the distribution concept removes the substrate on which concentration is computed.

Spectral-peak-trough-ratio quantifies the contrast between spectral peaks and valleys — a discriminative signal in MIR for tonal vs noise classification, instrument identification, and speech analysis. MIR systems use PTR to distinguish harmonic sources from noisy ones.

The gammatone-filter-bank decomposes audio into gammatone-filter channels that model cochlear frequency resolution, providing the perceptual analysis underlying timbre classification and analysis. Direction servant→beneficiary: the bank serves timbre analysis by producing the spectral-temporal decomposition timbre features operate on.

Spectral band flux computes the frame-to-frame change of spectral energy within a specific frequency band. It operates directly on spectral-band-energy values: the flux is the difference of band energy across consecutive frames. Removing spectral-band-energy eliminates the input data on which flux is computed, so the construct cannot operate without it.

Harmonicity is a foundational MIR feature used in source separation, instrument classification, voice vs instrument discrimination, and speech quality assessment. MIR systems use the harmonic-to-noise ratio as a discriminative signal for audio categorization tasks.

The accepted definition of cepstrum-coefficient specifies: (1) computing the power spectral density of a signal via FFT. Without FFT, the power spectral density cannot be computed and the coefficient cannot be derived. Removal test: remove FFT and the computation procedure stops at step 1. Constitutive dependency on a required computational step.

Nearest-kind ladder: spectral-band-feature —INSTANCE_OF→ spectral-feature (ga530eb0) is the accepted family edge, and spectral-band-feature itself is a band-local member of the family; the global scalar family sits one step above. It is the full-spectrum global member of the family, as spectral-bandwidth and spectral-energy already are.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): The cepstrum is used to estimate the spectral envelope of a signal via quefrency-domain low-pass filtering. Remove spectral envelope and the cepstrum loses its interpretive purpose — it becomes computation without meaning. Constitutive.

Direction tested (Law 9, specific to nearest accepted kind): per its accepted definition, spectral-tenuity is a dimensionless scalar metric reducing the full-spectrum per-bin energy vector to a single value (peak-to-mean energy ratio). It has no band bounds, so spectral-band-feature is not the nearest kind; spectral-feature is. Pinned sense: the peak-to-mean energy ratio over the per-bin energy vector.

spectral-band-flux (ΔE = E[t] - E[t-1] of per-bin energy) IS A spectral-feature — one type of descriptive statistic computed from spectral data. The nearest accepted kind.

spectral-band-peak-to-average-ratio measures the ratio of peak energy to average energy within a frequency band. This is a core MIR feature for instrument classification, audio segmentation, and tonality analysis — distinguishing tonal instruments (high PAR) from noisy ones. The feature is operationally used as an evidence primitive in MIR systems.

A spectral peak is a local maximum in the power spectrum P[k]. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the values P[k] that define what a 'peak' is — there is no spectral shape to identify maxima in. The removal test passes: spectral-peak is constitutively dependent on power-spectrum.

Removal test: spectral-peak-rolloff sorts spectral magnitudes in descending order, accumulates their squared values, and finds the frequency at which cumulative sum reaches rolloff_percent of total. Remove spectral-distribution and rolloff has no per-bin energies to sort/accumulate: the computation stops. Mirror: spectral-band-rolloff DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution (accepted edge ga61f6f48c4c3d34c3d3a7c).

Rolloff freq = threshold where cumulative band energy reaches X% of total. Requires ordering per-bin energies and cumulative sum of the full vector v.

Flatness ratio geometric mean / arithmetic mean of per-bin energies requires per-bin energy distribution statistics. Spectral-band-moment provides the moment framework for interpreting distribution shape. Removal of moment formalism eliminates the statistical basis for interpreting flatness as uniformity measure.

Spectral-band-flux = the sum of squared differences between consecutive spectral-band-distribution vectors across time frames. It is computed directly from the distribution: the per-bin energy vector v = (|A_1|^2, ...) for each frame provides the values on which the frame-to-frame difference is computed. The distribution concept came first and flux derives from applying the distribution framework to measure spectral change over time.

DERIVED_FROM (Law 7): the full-spectrum energy-median formula (cumulative energy reaching 50 percent, crossing bin's center frequency) is the historical origin — the band variant restricts the same cumulative test to bins within [f_low, f_high); the general form existed first and fed the band-limited one, matching the accepted band-variant pattern (e.g., spectral-band-par DERIVED_FROM spectral-par, spectral-band-rms DERIVED_FROM spectral-rms).

Spectral-band-slope IS a spectral feature. It measures a specific quantifiable property of the spectrum within a frequency band — the gradient of energy across bins. Removing spectral-feature as a category would remove the kind under which spectral-band-slope operates.

return-phase is a named voice-quality measurement parameter: a specific member of the voice-quality family of standardized clinical parameters for assessing laryngeal function, computed from the glottal-flow waveform and fundamental period.

Spectral-band-asymmetry measures energy concentration bias within a frequency band — a timbral descriptor. Higher asymmetry indicates energy concentrated toward one edge of the band, affecting the perceived brightness or warmth of the timbre. It complements centroid (center) and spread (width) with a directional descriptor of band-local energy structure.

Cepstral coefficients are computed as IFFT(log(|DFT(x)|²)). The DFT is the first operational step in this chain — without DFT there is no |DFT(x)|² to take the log of, and consequently no IFFT to compute. The removal test passes: removing DFT stops cepstral coefficients from operating.

Language is a structured system composed of several components: phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, and vocabulary. spectral-band-flux is the band-limited variant of spectral-flux. The band-limited construct derives from the general flux concept applied to spectral data within a frequency band.

spectral-rolloff (frequency below which 85% of total spectral energy is concentrated) existed first. spectral-band-rolloff is the band-localized extension: percentile of energy within a frequency band. Which-came-first: global spectral rolloff predates the band-localized variant.

spectral-whiteness measures flatness of spectral energy distribution, used as a timbral descriptor in music information retrieval for genre classification, instrument recognition, and audio quality assessment.

Crest factor = max(|A_i|) / RMS(|A_i|). The RMS amplitude is the second constitutive input to the crest factor formula — it came first and is required to compute crest factor. Without the RMS concept, crest factor cannot be defined.

Evenness is coefficient of variation sigma/mu where mu is first moment and sigma derives from second central moment. Removing the ability to compute moments from the band energy distribution stops evenness from operating; evenness is computed using the first and second moments of the energy distribution. This is DEPENDS_ON, not DERIVED_FROM.

Peak-to-average-ratio within a sub-band measures the disparity between the highest energy region and the mean energy. The construct exists to serve timbre characterization.

spectral-tile T[t,f] IS the 2D arrangement of magnitude/power values from spectral frames. Spectral-band-flatness = geometric mean / arithmetic mean of per-bin energy values within the band. Spectral leakage shifts energy away from the true centroid, biasing the spectral-centroid calculation. Without spectral-leakage as a concept, the centroid would be defined as an exact moment with no bias correction needed. The removal test passes.

spectral-band-flux computes the temporal difference of spectral band energies between consecutive frames. It operates on the per-bin energy vector within the band, computing |E_n(k) - E_(n-1)(k)| for each bin k in the band and summing. Without the per-bin distribution, flux cannot compute the within-band temporal energy changes that define it. The dependency is operational: the distribution is the data object on which flux operates.

Spectral gating applies threshold-based masking in the frequency domain: bins below a threshold of P[k] are zeroed. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the per-bin power values that gating operates on. The removal test passes: without power-spectrum there is nothing to gate.

Spectral-peak identifies the maximum magnitude or energy across frequency bins of the full spectrum with no band bounds. Its operand is the global per-bin energy vector (spectral-distribution). Remove that vector and peak cannot be identified.

Removal test on the defined sense: spectral-par's accepted def d7d3dae2 computes PAR = max_i(E_i) / (sum_i E_i / N) over the full spectrum; the numerator max_i(E_i) is the per-bin energy of the dominant bin — the accepted spectral-peak sense (cmsqc6fge0: 'a frequency bin whose spectral amplitude exceeds that of its neighboring bins'). Remove the peak and the numerator has no value: the ratio stops operating. The band twin holds the identical claim ACCEPTED (spectral-band-peak-to-average-ratio DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-peak, g6651139); the crest-factor family holds the same shape (spectral-crest-factor DEPENDS_ON spectral-peak is the accepted precedent line). The global member files against the global holder, the accepted twin shape. The denominator side runs to spectral-distribution (filed as a parallel edge), so each named operand is wired once.

The source-filter model explains how the vocal tract shapes sound into formants. Remove formants and the model loses its explanatory target — it becomes a model of nothing. The model was developed specifically to account for formant frequencies as resonances. Removal test: without formants, source-filter model has no purpose.
Spectral skewness operates on a power spectrum S[k]. Removing power-spectrum stops skewness from operating as a spectral statistic.

Pinned sense: the accepted glottal-flow definition names the operator in its formula — 'the speech signal x(n) is processed with the inverse of the estimated vocal-tract transfer function — the inverse linear-prediction filter 1/(1 - Σ_k a_k z^-k) over voiced frames — yielding the glottal-flow sequence g(n)'. Removal test (Law 8b): without the inverse-filtering technique there is no glottal-flow estimate; the waveform is the output of that technique in the pinned sense, and no other method in the carve produces it. Not chronology (that would argue DERIVED_FROM), not identity (the measurement is not the filter), not purpose (that would be SERVES).

Spectral leakage is the smearing of energy in the power spectrum caused by windowing. The construct operates on the power spectrum — it IS a property of the power spectrum. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the spectral energy distribution in which leakage is computed.
inverse-filtering is a specific type of filter that operates by inverting the system transfer function to recover the original excitation signal

Spectral-band-crest-factor = max(E)/RMS, measuring impulsiveness within a band. It serves timbre characterization by quantifying how spike-like vs. distributed the energy is — a key perceptual correlate of percussive vs. sustained timbral quality.

Source-filter separation extracts the glottal source waveform (excitation) from speech, which is the prerequisite for computing all glottal source parameters (open quotient, closure quotient, return phase, asymmetry coefficient). Without this separation, the source component cannot be isolated for voice-quality analysis.

Mel-spectrogram structurally requires the mel-scale: the mel-scale defines the triangular filterbank applied to the power spectrum to produce the mel-spectrogram. Remove the mel-scale and the mel-spectrogram loses its defining frequency warping mechanism.
Computing peak-to-average requires per-bin spectral energies within the band. Removing the distribution removes the input data needed to compute the ratio.

Pinned sense: gammatone-filter as a kind of filter. Nearest kind test: auditory-filter is a closer kind than generic filter (gammatone-filter IS a kind of auditory-filter which IS a kind of filter). Auditory-filter already accepted as nearest. INSTANCE_OF→ filter would be a ladder leap already derivable through auditory-filter. Refused if ladder applies.

Pinned sense: spectral decay measures the rate at which spectral energy decreases over frequency within a frame, typically computed as the slope of the spectral envelope. It operates on the per-frame power spectrum S[k] produced by the spectrogram. Removal test: without spectrogram, there is no mechanism to produce the frequency-binned power spectrum that spectral decay requires as input. No nearer rung exists.
Crest-factor as ratio peak/RMS contains RMS energy as its denominator component. Pinned sense: crest-factor = peak amplitude / RMS amplitude. RMS energy is a constituent metric in the definition.

CONSTITUTIVE: chromagram definition states it is computed by applying a mel-scale filterbank to spectral energy and summing energy within each mel band. Spectral energy provides the input domain — removing spectral-energy eliminates the per-bin energy values the filterbank sums. The chromagram is literally a re-binning of spectral energy, so it cannot operate without it.

The cepstrum is computed as the IFFT of the log magnitude spectrum, which is mathematically equivalent to applying the DCT to the log power spectrum (the quefrency domain IS a DCT-domain representation). The cepstral decomposition uses the same orthogonal transform structure as the DCT to separate convolved signal components.

Parameters: quefrency range, cepstral order.

Pitch is the perceptual construct that MIR systems analyze to extract melody, harmony, key, and tonal structure. MIR pipelines compute pitch contours, pitch-class distributions, and pitch transcriptions as core features. Removing pitch from MIR eliminates the ability to model melody, identify key, transcribe notation, and analyze intonation.

Direction tested (Law 9, specific to nearest accepted kind): a spectral moment, per its accepted definition, is a quantitative scalar descriptor obtained by weighting each frequency bin of a spectral energy distribution by a power of its center frequency and summing (mu_n = sum_i f_i^n E_i) — a numerical descriptor extracted from the signal's spectral representation that quantifies a measurable aspect of its frequency-domain structure (shape: mean frequency, variance, skewness, kurtosis). That is exactly what spectral-feature's accepted definition carves. Nearest accepted kind: no accepted kind entry stands between spectral-moment and spectral-feature, and the accepted band-side analogue — spectral-band-moment INSTANCE_OF spectral-band-feature — shows the family-to-feature link is the standing pattern for moment families (the 4 moment members already run to it; centroid additionally runs direct to spectral-feature). Not a leap: the ladder reaches no intermediate kind, and this mirrors the accepted band family structure.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: contact-quotient is computed from the EGG (electroglottogram) envelope — it measures the fraction of the glottal cycle where vocal folds are in contact, using the EGG signal's contact-onset and contact-offset markers. Remove electroglottography and the EGG signal ceases to exist; contact-quotient has no signal source and cannot be computed. This is the same signal-source pairing the glottal-cycle definition already accepts ('measured per pitch period from the glottal-flow waveform or the electroglottogram envelope') — contact-quotient uses the EGG envelope branch.

spectral-band-slope per its accepted definition = the least-squares slope of log10(E[i]) against f_center[i] across the band's bins, expressed dB/Hz: computed from the band's per-bin energy values within defined bounds, it reduces the band-local energy vector to a scalar summary — the carved sense of band-feature. Pinned sense (Law 11d): the band-local regression slope, not the full-spectrum spectral-slope (which is its DERIVED_FROM ancestor, a different construct). No order-r parameter, so band-moment is not a kind for it; band-feature is the nearest kind. The existing direct INSTANCE_OF→spectral-feature is its true first connection and retires as SUBSUMED without penalty when this rung and the family's spectral-feature rung complete the ladder (Law 11e).

Spectral rolloff is the frequency below which a certain percentage (e.g. 85%) of the total spectral power is concentrated. It is computed by accumulating the spectral-power-distribution P[k] and finding the bin where cumulative sum reaches the threshold fraction. Removing the SPDF removes the distribution that rolloff accumulates over. Constitutive.

Spectral-band-entropy = -Σ(p_i·log(p_i)) where p_i = E_i/ΣE_j, the normalized per-bin energy values from the spectral-band-distribution. The distribution vector is the historical and computational source: without it, the probability normalization and per-bin energies required for entropy cannot be computed. The entropy concept derives from applying the distribution framework.
Centroid = weighted-mean freq = sum(E_i*f_i)/sum(E_i). Requires both the energy vector AND the frequency coordinates of each bin. spectral-band-energy aggregate loses per-bin frequencies.
Bandwidth is computed from the extent of the spectral-band-distribution: removing the distribution stops bandwidth from being a meaningful measure

Pinned sense: INSTANCE_OF tests whether period-perturbation is a specific named member of the voice-quality family.
