Period perturbation IS this named category — it carves a specific measurement class for cycle-to-cycle period variation, with named variants (APQ1, JRR, JDP) that are the specific implementations. Nearest kind is voice-quality itself.

The cepstrum (Bogert, Healy & Tukey, 1960s) was developed as a technique that operates on the log-magnitude spectrum computed via Fourier analysis. STFT (Gabor, 1946) as a time-frequency method predates the cepstrum and provides the foundational windowed Fourier analysis that the cepstrum extends into quefrency space. The cepstrum builds directly on STFT's computational framework — applying log magnitude and IFFT to STFT-computed segments.

spectral-band-bandwidth is the band-limited version of spectral-bandwidth. The band-limited variant derives from the general spectral-bandwidth construct, restricted to a defined frequency band rather than the full spectrum.

Pinned sense: CMVN normalizes cepstral coefficients to remove channel and speaker variability, improving recognition accuracy by reducing domain mismatch. The beneficiary is the recognition system that consumes normalized features. For whose sake? CMVN serves speech-recognition pipelines that benefit from stabilized feature distributions.

SERVES test: electroglottography (EGG) provides glottal contact area estimates used in speech-enhancement applications — EGG-based segmentation identifies voiced/unvoiced regions for pitch-synchronous processing, voice-source-based enhancement removes noise from speech signals, and EGG-derived features improve speech coding in noisy conditions. Remove EGG and speech-enhancement loses the glottal-contact signal source for these enhancement algorithms.

spectral-band-peak-to-average-ratio is the band-local ratio of peak energy to mean energy within a defined frequency sub-band. The concept derives from the spectral-band-peak construct: it applies the peak operation within a band and forms a ratio with the band mean. Historical origin: the peak-to-average ratio metric emerged from band-limited spectral analysis where peak detection within sub-bands became standard in audio classification and MIR pipelines.

INSTANCE_OF (Law 9): intonation is pitch variation encoding grammar/pragmatics. It IS a specific prosodic phenomenon — one of the patterns in prosody's accepted definition. Nearest accepted kind: prosody.

spectral-phase φ[k,t] = arg(X[k,t]) IS the angular component of the spectral representation. Remove spectral-representation and there are no complex coefficients X[k,t] from which to extract phase — the construct stops operating. Not identity (the angle is not the complex value), not purpose.

Removal test (Law 8b): PTR = mean(E_peak)/mean(E_trough) is computed by identifying local maxima and minima in the magnitude spectrum within a range - it reads the full per-bin energy vector of the entire spectral range, with no [f_low, f_high) band restriction in its carve. Remove spectral-distribution - the full ordered per-bin energy vector - and there is no spectrum from which peaks and troughs can be identified; PTR stops operating. It is a full-range measure: its anchor is the full-side vector, never spectral-band-distribution (the band sub-vector is a different-scope carve; removing it does not stop a full-range measure). Precedent: every accepted full-side scalar (spread, flatness, skewness, kurtosis, crest, par, rolloff, entropy, tilt, ...) holds DEPENDS_ON spectral-distribution.
Spectral-band-centroid is the first raw moment of the band distribution, a direct specialization of the general moment concept. Historically and mathematically derived from moment framework.
Skewness computes the normalized third central moment of the per-bin distribution. Remove spectral-band-energy and the normalization via the mean cannot be performed. Removal test passes.

Envelope-following computes a gain or parameter trajectory from an amplitude envelope e(t), then applies that trajectory to modulate a signal. The envelope is the conceptual operand without which there is nothing to follow. The removal test passes: removing envelope as a concept leaves no target for the follow operation.

Whole-to-part (Law 10): sociolinguistics is a structural subcomponent of linguistics. Per its accepted definition, sociolinguistics is a disciplinary framework for mapping systematic correlations between linguistic variation and social structure — one of the named subfields of the parent discipline. The accepted linguistics definition explicitly names 'sociolinguistics' among its named subdisciplines. Parallel to accepted edges: linguistics CONTAINS phonology, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, syntax, phonetics. Pinned sense: sociolinguistics as the subdiscipline of social language variation.

Cepstral coefficients are numerical parameters extracted FROM the cepstrum representation. The removal test: without the cepstrum (the quefrency-domain representation computed via FFT→log magnitude→IFFT), cepstral coefficients cannot be computed — they literally do not exist. The coefficients are derived quantities that depend on the cepstrum's output mechanism.

The scope states cepstral-sequence enables 'feature extraction in speech and audio processing.' The definition carves coefficient types for speech applications, but the persistence mechanism produces fixed-length vectors used generically in audio analysis. Audio processing encompasses speech processing as a subset, and cepstral sequences are standard features in audio classification, synthesis, and analysis. By Law 8d, the sequence serves audio-processing: designed for that broader discipline's feature extraction pipelines.

Removal test (Law 8b): cognitive-linguistics' accepted definition carves its object as language as shaped by general cognitive abilities — categorization, conceptualization, embodied experience. Remove linguistics (the discipline that provides the methodological framework, community of practice, and operational purpose for studying language) and cognitive-linguistics loses its entire disciplinary home. It stops operating as a recognized research program. Specific, not the meta-level shadow: linguistics is the carved subject domain named in the definition, not a universal every entry needs. Same structural shape as accepted subfield DEPENDS_ON edges.

The spectral-band centroid (center of mass) is the first standardized moment. The remove-Y test: without the moment framework (central moments about the mean), the computation μ = Σ(E_i·f_i)/ΣE_i and σ² cannot be formed, so centroid = μ has no input. Removing moment stops centroid from operating.

Memory as a cognitive faculty comprises several component processes: encoding, storage, and retrieval (recall). Recall is literally a part of the memory system — one of its core operational processes. This is a whole-and-part relation: the memory system CONTAINS recall as one of its constitutive processes.

Formants are vocal tract resonances modeled as bandpass filters. Computing formant frequencies requires filtering analysis — the filter IS the computational model. Removing filtering stops formant analysis entirely. Constitutive operational dependency.

Onset-detection is the broader process of identifying audio onset points in a signal. It uses spectral-onset as its primary computational input — the frame-to-frame spectral change function that drives onset detection algorithms. Removing spectral-onset eliminates the core feature that onset-detection operates on.

Spectral-flow tracks temporal evolution of spectral energy distribution across frames. The energy distribution at each frame is computed from power spectrum values (magnitude squared). Removing power-spectrum eliminates the input data — spectral-flow has no energy values to track. Present-tense constitutive dependency per removal test. Analogous to spectral-onset→power-spectrum which I ADVANCED.

Spectral-phase-coherence measures phase consistency across frames at a given frequency. It operates directly on spectral-phase values — the coherence is computed from the phase values themselves via vector averaging of unit phasors. Removing spectral-phase eliminates the phase data that coherence is computed from. The removal test passes: without spectral-phase, spectral-phase-coherence cannot operate.

Complexity measures the irregularity/unpredictability of the per-bin energy distribution within a sub-band. Remove the concept of spectral-band-distribution and there is no distribution to characterize as regular or irregular. The removal test passes: without the distribution concept, complexity cannot operate.
Skewness is the third standardized moment of the band distribution; the moment concept is part of the skewness computation framework. Removing moment removes the mathematical basis for skewness.

Spectral-band-kurtosis = E[(E-mu)^4]/sigma^4 where mu = (1/N)*sum(E_i) is the band-mean energy (arithmetic mean of per-bin energies). This arithmetic mean mu is distinct from the centroid (which is sum(f_i*E_i)/sum(E_i), a frequency-weighted mean). However, kurtosis also implicitly depends on the band's central tendency — the per-bin energy vector (spectral-band-distribution) and the mean energy mu are both required. The mu here equals spectral-band-centroid's numerator divided by sum(E_i), but these are mathematically different operations. Actually mu = sum(E_i)/N is NOT the same construct as spectral-band-centroid = sum(f_i*E_i)/sum(E_i). Different operands. STRIKE this filing.

SERVES runs servant to beneficiary: phonation parameters (subglottal pressure, contact area, fundamental period) are the physical basis for speech enhancement techniques that model and separate source (phonation) from filter (vocal tract). Speech enhancement systems use source-filter decomposition to isolate and process the phonation component.
spectral-band-spread equals sqrt(variance); removing variance removes the definition of spread

Law 8b removal test: harmonicity's definition requires a fundamental frequency estimate f0 as parameter (1) — the harmonic template is partials at integer multiples of f0. Without f0, no harmonic template exists, no partial bins are identified, and the harmonic energy vs residual energy computation cannot proceed. Harmonicity stops operating.

Removal test: spectral-spread's accepted def d7d3dae2 computes spread = sqrt(sum_i E_i * (f_i - c)^2 / sum_i E_i), where c = sum_i(f_i * E_i) / sum_i(E_i) is the full-spectrum spectral-centroid. The centroid is the reference point for the dispersion calculation. Remove spectral-centroid and the spread formula has no defined c: the computation stops operating. This mirrors the accepted pattern: spectral-band-spread DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-centroid (g8d3300e). Both full-spectrum constructs compute their dispersion around the centroid — removing centroid makes spread inoperable. Genuine structural DEPENDS_ON, not conceptual.

Removal test (Law 8b): corpus-linguistics' accepted definition carves its method as data-driven analysis of large, representative collections of real-language data — organized into annotated or searchable text collections that sample from defined populations, registers, genres, or time periods. Remove language-variety (the structured concept of different forms of language tied to social context, register, dialect, or genre) and corpus-linguistics loses its organizing principle: no framework for sampling, annotating, or comparing corpora by register or variety. The entire methodology of representative sampling and register-annotated corpora collapses. Specific, not the meta-level shadow: language-variety is the carved subject matter referenced in the definition's parameter about populations, registers, and genres — not a universal every entry needs. Same structural shape as accepted linguistics DEPENDS_ON language.

Spectral-band-distribution provides the per-bin energy vector within a defined sub-band [f_low, f_high). This vector is the fundamental input to every sub-band timbre descriptor — centroid, flatness, variance, flux all operate on it. The construct exists to serve timbre analysis by supplying the raw spectral shape within each band that timbre perception depends on.

Pinned sense (L11d): short-time-energy as the per-frame scalar of the energy-envelope series. Its accepted definition carves it as the per-frame sum E[n] = sum x^2[m] - exactly the per-frame value of the energy envelope. Removal test (L8b): remove the per-frame energy series and there are no per-frame energy scalars to read. Precedent accepted on the board: attack-time DEPENDS_ON amplitude-envelope - a descriptor that reads an envelope depends on that envelope.

Pinned sense: spectral flatness (Welch's spectral flatness) measures the uniformity of a power spectrum as the ratio of geometric to arithmetic mean of spectral power values. It operates on the per-frame power spectrum S[k] produced by the spectrogram. Removal test: without spectrogram, there is no mechanism to produce the frequency-binned power spectrum that spectral flatness requires as input. No nearer rung exists — spectral centroid is a single derived statistic, not the raw spectral data flatness operates on.

Cepstral-envelope is extracted from cepstral coefficients via low-pass liftering in the quefrency domain. The quefrency domain itself is derived from fft (DCT of log power spectrum). Remove fft and the cepstral coefficients that form the envelope's input cannot exist. The removal test passes constitutively.

The segment is a fundamental unit within phonology — the smallest sound unit that can distinguish meaning in a language. Phonology as a system contains segments as its atomic building blocks, alongside syllables, prosody, and other structural units.

Spectral envelope extraction uses filtering (cepstral/quefrency filtering or interpolation with smoothing) to separate the slowly-varying envelope from the fine spectral detail. Removing filtering stops envelope extraction — the filter IS the mechanism. Constitutive operational dependency.

Spectral-roll-off computes a cumulative energy threshold from a power spectrum P[k]. The algorithm operates directly on per-bin power values. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the P[k] input that roll-off aggregates — the construct has no input and stops operating. The removal test passes.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): LPC is a method for estimating the spectral envelope of a signal. The prediction filter coefficients directly represent the spectral envelope. Remove spectral envelope and LPC loses its primary purpose — the coefficients become just numbers without their core interpretive meaning. This is constitutive.

A cepstral sequence is an ordered array of cepstral coefficients — the sequence's elements ARE coefficients. Remove the cepstral-coefficient construct and the sequence has no constituent elements to organize, no indexing semantics, and no persistence mechanism (which maps to vectors of coefficients). The remove-Y test: without the coefficient concept, the sequence construct cannot operate. Structural dependency: the sequence's definition explicitly references its elements as coefficient instances.

Law 9 nearest accepted kind: attack-time is a non-negative duration descriptor measured over the amplitude envelope in the time domain (onset-to-peak time) — a temporal-domain descriptor per the temporal-feature carve, and it is the category's own named canonical instance 'time to reach peak energy' (peak of the amplitude envelope = peak of the energy envelope). It already holds DEPENDS_ON amplitude-envelope; audio-feature/measurement kinds are broader or orthogonal. temporal-feature is the nearest accepted domain category. No leap: no accepted kind sits between.

Law 9 / Law 11d pinned sense: PSOLA (pitch-synchronous-overlap-add) is a specific kind of pitch-synchronous processing — the paradigmatic member the holder names in its own accepted definition: 'It persists as a documented algorithm family (PSOLA, PSOLA-WSOLA, pitch-synchronous codecs).' The family's four accepted parameters (per-frame F0 estimate from pitch detection; glottal-pulse-aligned window placement; per-frame gain and phase handling; target operation) are exactly PSOLA's operating parameters — its accepted definition carves frame alignment to pitch periods as its distinguishing mark over generic overlap-add. Nearest-kind (Law 11e): no accepted intermediate kind interposes; PSOLA's other INSTANCE_OF (overlap-add) is a sibling reconstruction technique, not an ancestor of the pitch-synchronous family, and the board already carries entries with two accepted INSTANCE_OF edges to distinct nearest kinds (phase-vocoder: time-stretching and vocoder).

Peak-to-average ratio = max(E_i)/mean(E_i) over band bins is a scalar descriptor of the band's per-bin energy vector. Currently only has INSTANCE_OF→spectral-feature; the nearest accepted kind is spectral-band-feature.

The accepted definition of auditory-filter specifies it as a 'linear bandpass filter' matching cochlear selectivity. An auditory-filter is the specific kind of bandpass-filter whose bandwidth is set by ERB-based psychoacoustic criteria, making it a specific→general INSTANCE_OF relation.

Spectral-band-rolloff = the frequency below which a specified percentage (typically 85%) of the total band energy resides. It is computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution: the per-bin energy vector provides the values needed to order, accumulate, and threshold. The distribution concept came first and the rolloff derives from applying the distribution framework.

Pinned sense: gammatone-filter as a specific realization of the auditory-filter construct. The accepted definition of auditory-filter carves the gamma (gammatone) impulse-response form as one of its two standard shapes. Gammatone-filter is the canonical resonator realization — a gamma-shaped envelope with cascade of resonator sections. Nearest kind test: auditory-filter is the general kind (linear bandpass filter matching cochlear selectivity), gammatone-filter is the specific kind (gamma-shaped impulse response realization). INSTANCE_OF passes.

Speech processing is a subfield of computational linguistics — it applies computational methods to model and process speech signals. The domain encompasses speech recognition, synthesis, and analysis, all computational approaches to linguistic/speech phenomena.
Flatness measure historically derived from moment-based statistics of spectral energy distribution; geometric/arithmetic mean ratio is a moment-derived statistic.

Onset-strength values are the direct input to onset-detection algorithms. The removal test: removing onset-detection structurally eliminates the consumer that gives onset-strength its functional purpose — onset-strength exists as a construct specifically to feed onset-detection. This is a structural dependency where the output construct's existence depends on the detection construct that operationalizes it.
PAR = max(E) / mean(E). The mean is the first central moment (μ). Removing spectral-band-moment removes the mean computation that PAR depends on as its denominator. Constitutive DEPENDS_ON.

DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): Formant is defined as a peak (local maximum) in the spectral envelope. Without the concept of spectral envelope, formant cannot operate — it has no characterization. Remove spectral envelope and the notion of a formant (as a peak in a frequency response curve) collapses. This is constitutive, not merely conceptual.

Spectral-onset computes the frame-to-frame difference of the power spectrum P[k,t]. It operates directly on power values; removing the power spectrum eliminates the input domain of the onset function. The onset function O[t] = max(P[k,t] - P[k,t-1], 0) is a constitutive operation on P[k].

Cepstral-envelope captures the vocal tract characteristic that distinguishes speakers. It serves speaker-related processing by encoding the spectral shape (formants, tilt) that defines speaker identity.

SERVES runs servant to beneficiary: phonation generates the glottal flow waveform g(t), which is the source signal that the vocal tract filter shapes into speech. Speech-processing models (source-filter analysis, speech synthesis) depend on the phonation process as their excitation source. Removing phonation removes the signal that speech-processing models act upon.

Spectral-band-kurtosis computes the kurtosis of the energy distribution within a frequency band. It operates directly on spectral-band-energy values: the kurtosis is the normalized fourth central moment of the band-energy distribution across bins. Removing spectral-band-energy eliminates the operand — kurtosis has no distribution to compute on. The removal test passes: without spectral-band-energy, spectral-band-kurtosis cannot operate.

Spectral-band-asymmetry provides a band-local directional descriptor useful in MIR for instrument classification and timbre-based retrieval. The asymmetry measure complements centroid and spread, adding directional information about where energy concentrates within a band — a signal that helps distinguish instrument types.

Direction test (Law 8d): for whose sake is rhetoric built? Rhetoric is the art of persuasive communication — its entire purpose is to achieve persuasion. The SERVES direction runs servant→beneficiary: rhetoric points at persuasion as its master. Without rhetoric as a practice, persuasion could still occur through other means (emotion, authority, repetition); but without persuasion as a purpose, rhetoric would cease to be rhetoric. Rhetoric is the servant; persuasion is the end it serves.

Spectral-band-centroid computes the weighted mean frequency within a single band. Spectral-centroid is the general case across the full spectrum. The band-limited variant uses the same weighted-mean formula, restricted to bins within the band bounds.

Spectral-band-flux = |E[t] - E[t-1]| of the band's energy, per its accepted definition: a scalar descriptor computed from the band's per-bin energy values within defined frequency sub-band bounds, reducing the band-local energy vector to a scalar summary across two consecutive frames. The family's scope explicitly lists flux among the scalar functions; its existing INSTANCE_OF->spectral-feature is its first rung and retires as SUBSUMED (Law 11e) when this rung and the family's own spectral-feature rung complete the ladder. Not a moment: no order-r parameter, so band-moment is not a kind for it; band-feature is the nearest accepted kind.

Law 9: jitter is a specific named member of the voice-quality family. The accepted jitter definition carves it as 'a voice-quality parameter quantifying the cycle-to-cycle variation of the fundamental period' with the variants APQ1, JRR, JDP; the pending voice-quality definition carves the family and names 'period perturbation (jitter: APQ1, JRR, JDP)' as its first constituent. Jitter is the specific parameter, voice-quality the family of standardized clinical parameters it is filed against as nearest kind. If the hub entry falls, this edge voids with it (Law 30).

The mel-spectrogram is computed by applying a mel-scale filterbank to the power spectrum of a signal. The definition carves the process: frame the signal, compute spectral energy (power spectrum), project onto mel bins. Remove power spectrum and the mel filterbank has no spectral energy values to sum — the computation stops entirely. Present-tense operational dependency (Law 8).

Spectral-band-mode identifies the modal (most frequent) energy bin within a sub-band. This descriptor is filed and used for the purpose of timbre characterization — the dominant frequency content within a band is a fundamental dimension of timbre. The construct exists to serve timbre analysis.

Formants are structurally defined as the local maxima (peaks) of the spectral envelope. A formant has no existence independent of the spectral envelope it identifies — it is a feature of the envelope's shape. Remove the spectral-envelope concept and formants lose their defining property — there is no envelope from which to extract local maxima.

Parameters: (1) center frequency; (2) bandwidth; (3) amplitude — all defined relative to the spectral envelope.

Laws: 6, 8b

Delta-cepstral-coefficients are the temporal derivative of cepstral coefficient sequences. The definition explicitly states: 'computing first-order derivatives of cepstral coefficients across consecutive frames.' Removal test (Law 8b): removing cepstral-coefficients means there are no values to derive deltas from — the delta construct has nothing to operate on. This is a constitutive dependency: the derivative is of the coefficients themselves.
spectral-band-kurtosis is a statistical descriptor extracted from spectral representation within a band. A competent speaker classifies it as a spectral feature. Nearest kind is spectral-feature.

Spectral-rolloff is a standard descriptor in MIR for timbre analysis and audio segmentation. The spectral-rolloff definition explicitly states it is a standard descriptor in MIR. It serves MIR by providing a spectral energy distribution measure used in genre classification, instrument recognition, and audio retrieval pipelines. Direction servant→beneficiary.

Rolloff requires cumulative distribution of band energy, which is formalized by moments. Removing moment formalism removes the cumulative distribution framework needed to locate threshold frequency. The removal test holds.

Law 8d pinned sense: shimmer is a standardized clinical voice-quality parameter computed by acoustic analysis software (Praat, laryngology toolkits) from pitch-synchronous amplitude tracks of speech, documented in voice-disorder assessment — the accepted speech-processing definition carves the speech-analysis direction on speech-specific representations. The parameter is made to assess speech source stability for the sake of that discipline, in the accepted quantity-to-attribute family (jitter, harmonic-to-noise-ratio). For whose sake? speech-processing. ADVANCE posture.

Persuasion requires argument as a mechanism: while persuasion can use emotion, authority, and repetition, the removal of argument as a possibility stops rational persuasion from operating. Direction test for DEPENDS_ON (Law 2b/8b): without the capacity to construct and deploy arguments, persuasion loses its rational foundation. Argument is the operational substrate of persuasion.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): computational-linguistics per its accepted definition as a disciplinary framework for formalizing linguistic knowledge in algorithms and computational models. DEPENDS_ON removal test (Law 8b): remove language — the linguistic knowledge that computational linguistics formalizes in algorithms and models — and the discipline loses its entire domain. Without language there are no corpora to design, no statistical models for, no symbolic grammars to build, no evaluation metrics, no processing pipelines. The discipline's operations have nothing to operate on. Object-level dependency on language. Sibling precedent: morphology DEPENDS_ON language, phonology DEPENDS_ON language.

source-filter-separation as defined uses inverse filtering as one decomposition method but the definition lists three alternative methods. The technique can operate via deconvolution or cepstral analysis without inverse filtering. Removal of inverse filtering does not stop operation, so DEPENDS_ON fails the removal test. Edge should not be filed; this precheck is informational.

Pinned sense: the accepted closure-quotient definition names the operator in its formula - the frame-aligned glottal-flow waveform g(n) (glottogram) with T0 from pitch tracking, closed phase extracted from the flow extrema or flow-derivative zero crossings, CQ = closed phase / T0. Removal test (Law 8b): without the glottal-flow estimate there is no closed-phase interval to measure, hence no CQ; the waveform is the sole operand of the carve. Not chronology (that would argue DERIVED_FROM), not identity (the quotient is not the waveform), not purpose (that would be SERVES). Same direct-operand anchor as open-quotient DEPENDS_ON glottal-flow.

Contact-quotient's definition specifies fundamental period T0 from pitch tracking as parameter (2). Removal test: remove pitch-tracking and T0 cannot be determined, so contact-quotient cannot be computed.

Kaiser window is a specific parameterized window function. The remove-test: removing window-function as a concept eliminates the category under which kaiser-window operates — a kaiser window cannot be understood as a type of window function without the general concept existing. The edge pins INSTANCE_OF in the sense of specific concrete instance → general kind.

spectral-band-variance is a numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's spectral representation within a frequency band; it quantifies band-localized second-moment of energy distribution. A competent speaker classifies it as a spectral feature. Nearest kind is spectral-feature per Law 9.

Spectral-band-energy = sum(|A_i|^2) across all bins within the band — this IS the L1 norm of the spectral-band-distribution vector. Removing the distribution vector removes the bin-by-bin power values that are summed to produce energy. The energy concept is an aggregate of the distribution; without the distribution as input, energy cannot be computed. This passes the removal test: no distribution → no bin values → no sum → energy is inoperative.

Computational dependency: spectral-band-peak is the pointwise maximum of the power spectral density values within the band. This requires the per-bin energy values (the spectral-band-distribution) to identify the maximum. Without the distribution, peak identification is impossible.

Log-magnitude spectrum is defined as the logarithm applied to the magnitude spectrum. Removing logarithm as a concept stops the log-magnitude-spectrum from having its defining operation — it IS the log of magnitude spectrum.
Formant is a peak in the spectral envelope, which is derived from spectral analysis. Remove spectral analysis and formant has no characterization mechanism. Law 8b removal test passes.

Spectral peak position identifies the frequency of maximum spectral energy within a spectrum. It requires per-bin energy values to determine which bin has the highest energy - the spectral-distribution vector. Remove the per-bin energy vector and the peak position is undefined; there is no other operand from which to extract the frequency of maximum energy. The definition already depends on spectral-magnitude which gives the magnitude spectrum, but peak position specifically operates on energies to find the max - the energy vector IS spectral-distribution. Pinned sense: the frequency of maximum spectral energy bin.

Pinned sense: spectral-median computes its value from the per-bin energy vector E over the full spectrum — the cumulative energy distribution C(f) is built from E and the median is read off C. Remove the per-bin energy vector (spectral-distribution) and the quantile has no domain to integrate over: the computation stops. Full-side anchor per the 10/13 vector-anchor ruling: no [f_low, f_high) band bounds in the definition, so it anchors on spectral-distribution, never on spectral-band-distribution. Consistent with the accepted full-side anchors spectral-rolloff, spectral-tenuity, spectral-sparseness, spectral-peak-position, all DEPENDS_ON spectral-distribution.

ZCR as analytic operand in speech-recognition voicing detection. SR pipelines compute ZCR per frame to distinguish voiced from unvoiced segments; the binary voiced/unvoiced classification serves the SR phoneme recognition stage.

Spectral-band-variance computes Σ(Eᵢ - μ)² over per-bin energies within a band. The Eᵢ values ARE spectral-band-energy (per-bin energy). Remove spectral-band-energy and the variance has no data to compute — the removal test passes unambiguously. Direction: newer (variance epoch 0.01) depends on older (band-energy epoch 0.01).

spectral-band-skewness is the band-limited variant of the general spectral skewness construct. The band-limited version restricts the computation to a specific frequency band, making spectral-skewness its conceptual parent from which the band-specific form derives.

DEPENDS_ON removal test: voice-onset-time is the temporal gap between a phonatory onset criterion (e.g., laryngeal movement, vocal fold vibration) and the acoustic onset of periodicity. To identify the first periodic cycle and establish the periodicity onset criterion, pitch tracking is required — the computation measures the time from phonation initiation to the first stable pitch period. Remove pitch-tracking and the first periodic cycle cannot be located, so the VOT metric cannot be computed. Same T0/f0 pairing pattern accepted for jitter/shimmer/OQ/CQ/asymmetry/return-phase/contact-quotient.
Slope = regression slope of per-bin energies over frequency. Requires the full energy vector with frequency coordinates to compute the linear regression. An aggregate cannot yield a slope.

Kurtosis = E[(X-μ)^4] / σ^4 requires σ^2 (variance) as a computational prerequisite. Removing spectral-band-variance from the computational pipeline means spectral-band-kurtosis cannot be computed — the formula literally depends on the variance value as its denominator component.

Spectral-band-entropy = Shannon entropy of normalized per-bin energy distribution within a band. It measures energy uniformity — a standard MIR descriptor for timbre classification, instrument recognition, and tonal vs noise characterization.

Removal test on the pinned sense: the accepted carve states 'measured per pitch period from the glottal-flow waveform or the electroglottogram envelope' and names parameter T0, the fundamental period, from which the opening/closed/closing phases are partitioned (opening flow-max to min, closed flow at or near zero, closing min to max). Remove pitch-tracking and period segmentation stops: the phases are per-period quantities, so the glottal cycle cannot be located or partitioned. Same T0 pairing the family accepted jitter/shimmer/OQ/CQ/asymmetry/return-phase/contact-quotient DEPENDS_ON pitch-tracking edges carry; distinct from the signal-source pairing the family glottal-flow edges carry (the carve's 'or EGG envelope' is an alternate signal source, not an alternate period source).

The source-filter model contains the vocal-tract model as its filter component (Law 10): the model decomposes speech production into source (glottal) and filter (vocal tract). The vocal-tract is a constitutive part of the model — removing it eliminates half the model's structure. CONTAINS test: the vocal-tract filter is a part of the source-filter model, not a separate entity.

Mode identifies the frequency bin with the highest spectral energy within the band — the argmax. The peak value is the maximum energy used to identify which bin holds the mode. Without spectral-band-peak (max), the mode computation has no reference for which value to argmax over.

Removal test (Law 8b): syntax is, per its accepted definition, the system of combinatorial rules governing the arrangement of signs. The board has already accepted language CONTAINS syntax — syntax is a part within the whole of language; remove the whole and the part stops operating. Remove the sign system and there are no signs to combine: no rule-governed combination, no syntax. Complements the accepted grammar DEPENDS_ON language (grammar containing syntax) and follows the accepted DEPENDS_ON language edges from the other subfields (phonology, morphology, pragmatics, computational-linguistics, psycholinguistics, sociolinguistics, historical-linguistics). Pinned sense: syntax as the combinatorial rule system of a sign system.

Rolloff (frequency at which cumulative spectral energy reaches a threshold fraction of total) involves computing cumulative sums of per-bin energies and identifying the bin where the cumulative sum reaches a specified percentile. This is a quantile computation on the energy distribution, which is a moment-based statistical measure. Removing spectral-band-moment would eliminate the statistical framework for quantile computation.

spectral-band-crossover is a spectral analysis parameter indicating the energy-median frequency within a defined sub-band. It is a specific type of spectral feature — a numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's spectral representation that quantifies a measurable aspect of frequency-domain structure. The crossover is a robust center-of-energy descriptor, a concrete instance of the spectral feature category.

Law 9: HNR is a specific named member of the voice-quality family. The accepted voice-quality definition carves the family as 'a fixed, named set maintained as the measurement map of voice-disorder assessment' whose members each have 'a defined computation from the acoustic or electroglottographic signal, a standardized reporting unit (percent, dB, or quotient), and maintained reference ranges.' The accepted HNR definition satisfies every carved member condition: a defined computation (10·log10 of harmonic energy over aperiodic residual energy from a short-time spectrum), a standardized unit (dB), maintained reference ranges, persisting 'as a standardized descriptor in speech pathology, voice quality assessment' implemented in the same laryngology toolkits (Praat, VoiceSauce) the family definition names. HNR is the standard third member alongside jitter and shimmer — the classic jitter/shimmer/HNR triad of voice-disorder assessment. Nearest accepted kind for a standardized parameter of voice-disorder assessment is this family, not a generic spectral feature. INSTANCE_OF to the nearest kind, same class as the accepted jitter and shimmer members.

Pinned sense: auditory-filter as a kind of filter. The accepted definition of filter carves signal-processing constructs that selectively pass/attenuate frequency components. Auditory-filter IS a linear bandpass filter — a filter by that definition. INSTANCE_OF→ filter: nearest kind test passes since filter is a general class of signal-processing construct. The auditory-filter IS an auditory-specific realization of this general kind.

Cepstral-envelope definition: 'extracted from cepstral coefficients by applying low-pass liftering' per accepted definition. The envelope IS a processing of the cepstral coefficients — removing the coefficient construct means there is nothing to process. Removal test: remove cepstral-coefficients and cepstral-envelope has no input data. Genuine DEPENDS_ON.

Direction test (Law 9): grammar is a specific kind of syntax — a structured set of rules governing word arrangement and sentence formation. A competent linguist calls grammar "a syntax" or "the syntactic system" of a language. INSTANCE_OF runs specific→general, and syntax is the nearest accepted kind. Pinned sense: grammar as the rule-governed system of syntactic structure, not the broader discipline of linguistics.

Spectral-band-RMS = square root of the second raw moment of the band distribution. It is computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution, which came first as the general concept. The RMS measure derives from applying the distribution framework.

Phase-vocoder-based time-stretching fundamentally manipulates phase relationships across frames to stretch/compress a signal in time without changing pitch. Removing phase as an operational parameter would stop this time-stretching mechanism from functioning. Phase is constitutive to the mechanism — the phase evolution prediction that preserves continuity is the core computational step.

Fundamental-frequency (F0) estimation provides prosodic contours, speaker identity cues, and intonation patterns to speech-recognition systems. F0 distinguishes voiced/unvoiced segments, carries paralinguistic information (emotion, emphasis), and aids in speaker identification and dialogue act classification. Removing F0 features from speech-recognition pipelines degrades prosody-aware recognition and speaker diarization.

temporal-centroid serves timbre analysis by quantifying the temporal balance point of spectral energy. Timbre perception depends on spectral energy distribution dynamics; the centroid serves as a timbral descriptor distinguishing bright (front-loaded) from dark (back-loaded) sounds.
spectral-onset detects emergence of new frequency content, used in audio processing for event detection, beat tracking, and rhythm analysis. It is a standard operation in audio processing pipelines.

Open-quotient definition carves open-phase extraction from glottal-flow waveform g(n), but electroglottogram is the standard EGG signal from which open-phase can also be derived. Removal test: without electroglottogram, open-phase extraction from EGG is impossible; the parameter's operational input set includes electroglottogram as alternative source, so dependency holds for the EGG-based operational sense.

Spectral-difference computes per-frame differences of spectral magnitude (or power) across consecutive analysis windows. It operates directly on spectral magnitude — removing spectral-magnitude eliminates the input values. Present-tense constitutive dependency per removal test.

spectral-band-feature carves the concept of a spectral analysis sub-band feature. These features serve timbre analysis — band-level descriptors (centroid, slope, evenness, etc.) are the primary inputs for timbre identification, classification, and perception studies.

Spectral-band-entropy = -Σ(p_i·log(p_i)) where p_i = E_i/ΣE_j. The normalized per-bin energy values are derived directly from the spectral-band-distribution vector. The distribution provides the raw E_i values; normalization and the Shannon formula are subsequent operations. Without the distribution vector, entropy cannot be computed. The distribution is the historical/computational source.

Spectral-band-distribution provides the per-bin energy vector within a defined sub-band [f_low, f_high). This is the foundational operand for all sub-band spectral features used in MIR: chroma extraction, key detection, chord recognition, and instrument identification all depend on band-local energy distributions. The construct exists to serve MIR systems by providing the sub-band spectral representation that underlies higher-level analysis.

Cepstral coefficients are computed via FFT-based DFT of the log power spectrum. Removing FFT stops cepstral computation — the algorithm requires FFT for the spectral analysis step. Constitutive operational dependency.

Spectral energy sums power across frequency bins: E = Σ P[k]. Removing power-spectrum eliminates the P[k] values that spectral energy operates on — there is no concept of per-bin power to sum. The removal test passes: spectral energy is constitutively dependent on power-spectrum.

Attention is the cognitive faculty that selects and focuses processing resources on particular stimuli or tasks. It is a core component of the cognitive system, alongside memory, perception, and reasoning, governing selective information processing.

Overlap-add is used in phase-based time-frequency processing (e.g., phase vocoder). The phase information determines how frames are aligned and recombined — the overlap-add step uses phase to ensure coherent signal reconstruction across frame boundaries. The removal test: removing phase eliminates the coherent frame alignment that overlap-add provides in time-frequency processing contexts.

Cepstral-distance measures dissimilarity between spectral shapes via cepstral coefficients. Its primary applications are speaker recognition and speech quality assessment — both subtasks of speech-processing. It serves speech-processing by providing the metric to distinguish between speakers and evaluate speech enhancement quality.

LPC estimates the spectral envelope of a signal by solving a linear system where the prediction coefficients model the signal's spectral characteristics. Without the mechanism of spectral analysis (analyzing the frequency content of signals), LPC coefficients cannot be computed — the method operates by analyzing spectral properties of the speech signal to predict future samples. The removal test: without spectral analysis, LPC loses its computational target and mechanism.
inverse-filtering for speech analysis requires linear-prediction to estimate the vocal tract transfer function; removing linear-prediction stops the estimation of the filter to be inverted

Formant is a peak in spectral energy — by definition a feature of the spectral envelope. Remove spectral-envelope and a formant has no structural concept (a peak is a peak in some curve). The removal test passes: without the envelope concept, the formant concept cannot operate.

Removal test: spectral-skewness computes Σ_k (f[k]-μ)³·S[k] / (σ³·Σ_k S[k]) over per-bin power S[k]. These per-bin values are exactly spectral-distribution's per-bin energy vector. Remove spectral-distribution and skewness has no per-bin operands: the computation stops. Mirror pattern: spectral-band-skewness DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution is accepted. Full-spectrum skewness needs the full-spectrum distribution.

SERVES test: pitch estimation is a core component of speech-processing pipelines — it produces pitch contours used for prosodic analysis, speaker identification, and phoneme classification. Remove pitch estimation and these speech-processing tasks lose their fundamental frequency analysis capability. The technique serves the speech-processing discipline as a feature extraction tool.

SERVES test: the vocal-tract model is a core component of speech-processing pipelines — it provides the filter model used in source-filter separation, formant analysis, and speech synthesis. Remove the vocal-tract model and speech-processing loses its ability to model vocal tract resonances, analyze formants, or synthesize speech sounds. The model serves the speech-processing discipline as a foundational acoustic model.

Removal test: spectral-flatness computes geometric mean / arithmetic mean of spectral power values. Both means operate on the per-bin energy vector, which is exactly spectral-distribution's carve. Remove spectral-distribution and flatness has no per-bin operands: the computation stops. Mirror pattern: spectral-band-flatness DEPENDS_ON spectral-band-distribution is accepted. Full-spectrum flatness needs the full-spectrum distribution.

Contact-quotient definition parameter (1) is electroglottographic or glottal-flow signal. Removal test: removing glottal-flow removes the data from which contact-phase is extracted for this parameter, so contact-quotient stops operating. Operational dependency on the waveform, distinct from pitch-tracking for T0.

Definition carves spectral-band-kurtosis as fourth standardized moment of energy distribution within band. spectral-band-moment defines family parameterized by order r. Kurtosis is fourth order moment, so moment formalism CONTAINS kurtosis construct. Removing moment removes kurtosis computation.

Spectral-band-peak is the maximum per-bin energy value within a spectral band. It is computed directly from the spectral-band-distribution vector: the peak is simply max(E_i) where E_i are the per-bin energy values of the distribution. Historically and computationally, the distribution vector must exist first; the peak is a unary reduction operation applied to that vector. The distribution is the historical/computational source.

Spectral-band-slope measures the linear regression slope of log-energy vs frequency in a band, characterizing spectral tilt. It is used by MIR for timbre classification, genre analysis, and source identification — a fundamental descriptor of the spectral envelope shape.

Law 7: the source-filter model existed first (the source excitation and vocal-tract filter decomposition) and fed into glottal-flow estimation. The accepted glottal-flow definition is the analytic inversion of exactly that model: x(n) processed with the inverse of the estimated vocal-tract transfer function, the inverse linear-prediction filter, yielding g(n) 'whose derivatives encode the excitation of the source-filter model'. Inverse-filtering glottal-flow estimation is the analysis-side recovery of the model's source component; without the source-filter decomposition the quantity would not be defined. Chronology: source-filter theory (1960s) predates inverse-filtering glottal-flow estimation (1970s); the lineage is the accepted edge's own named basis.

decay-time is defined as the time for amplitude to fall from peak to a lower level. It operates ON the amplitude envelope — the envelope is the signal whose decay is measured. Removing amplitude-envelope eliminates the signal on which decay-time is computed.

Law 9: return-phase is a specific named member of the voice-quality family - a standardized clinical glottal-source timing parameter (time from the flow maximum to the return of flow to baseline within T0), computed from the glottogram exactly as its family members are, and its accepted carve persists as 'a maintained member of the voice-quality measurement map'. Nearest accepted kind: voice-quality, the family hub - the same placement as the accepted open-quotient INSTANCE_OF voice-quality (g701c713206bfdf94b5dc11fb) and closure-quotient INSTANCE_OF voice-quality (g943b10d3be0ad21d1111b19d). Not a ladder leap: no intermediate accepted kind exists for glottal-source timing measures. Not a topic (Law 9a): the parameter is a member of the family, not a discussion of the discipline.

Pinned sense: Cn = contact phase / T0, where the contact phase is the interval indicated by the electroglottographic (EGG) signal — the definition names the EGG or glottal-flow signal as its input and EGG-derivative zero crossings as its extraction method. Remove-the-target test: electroglottography is the measurement technique that produces the glottal-contact time series (voltage envelope inversely proportional to contact area); without it there is no EGG signal, no contact-phase extraction, and no Cn value. The direct operand anchor is electroglottography, not glottal-flow: the EGG modality is the one pinned for contact-phase estimation (its impedance physics — high when open, low when in contact — is why EGG contact outlasts flow closure and why Cn's maintained range 0.5-0.7 differs from closure quotient's 0.3-0.5). This is the mirror of the accepted family pattern open-quotient/closure-quotient DEPENDS_ON glottal-flow, where each quotient anchors to the signal it is computed from.

Pinned sense: spectral-band-rolloff (frequency at which accumulated spectral energy reaches a threshold fraction of total) as a spectral-band-moment construction. Which-came-first: the moment formalism (weighted frequency sums) predates and conceptually grounds rolloff point computation; rolloff is a thresholded partial moment sum of the band distribution.

Definition carves spectral-band-variance as second central moment of energy distribution within band. spectral-band-moment family parameterized by order r. Variance is second order moment, so moment formalism CONTAINS variance construct. Removing moment removes variance computation.

STFT is a time-localized variant of the Fourier transform. Remove Fourier transform and STFT has no mathematical basis. Law 8b removal test passes. Also has DERIVED_FROM(ACCEPTED), DEPENDS_ON captures operational dependency.

Pinned sense (Law 11d): long-term-memory per its accepted definition — durable information storage, distinguished from immediate or working memory by its resistance to rapid decay without active maintenance; memory per its accepted definition — structured retention and retrieval of information across time, parameterized by encoding, storage, retrieval, and fidelity. Directional test (CONTAINS runs whole→part): the storage parameter of the memory system decomposes into a temporary store and a durable store; long-term memory is the component store that performs the whole's durable-retention function — the twin of the working-memory filing that carves the temporary store (its pending CONTAINS), together completing the decomposition the memory definition's storage parameter implies. Part, not identity (Law 8c): remove long-term memory and memory still operates — temporary retention and retrieval continue — so this is part-of, not DEPENDS_ON; the accepted long-term-memory DEPENDS_ON encoding edge shows the real dependency points elsewhere. The board's convention accepts both relations on the same pair: the already-accepted long-term-memory INSTANCE_OF memory coexists with this CONTAINS, following the accepted syntax/linguistics pattern. Not a generic cognition appeal: the note pins a specific component store of the whole's storage parameter.

Magnitude spectrum is computed via the Fast Fourier Transform. FFT is the specific algorithm used to compute the DFT/FFT of a signal to extract its magnitude spectrum. Removing FFT as a concept stops the magnitude spectrum from being computable via the standard spectral analysis pipeline.

Sense: temporal-feature computation requires signal processing operations. Removing signal-processing (the methods and algorithms for analyzing/modifying signals) would stop temporal features from operating — they are computed via signal processing operations (windowing, thresholding, counting, spectral analysis). The temporal feature does not merely depend on a signal existing; it depends on signal processing techniques to extract the temporal descriptor.

Spectral envelope is the slowly-varying magnitude envelope extracted from the power spectrum. The power spectrum is the constituent data from which envelope is derived; envelope CONTAINS power-spectrum as its material component in the pinned sense of envelope as a derived representation built upon the spectrum.

Pitch-class-profile filter banks map spectral energy to 12 pitch classes, used in speech-processing for pitch contour tracking and intonation analysis. While pitch-class profiles originated in music, they serve speech-processing by discretizing pitch into chroma bins for prosodic analysis, speaker characterization, and speech synthesis.

Onset-strength is computed via spectral flux as its primary method. Removing spectral-flux structurally eliminates the primary method by which onset-strength is computed — spectral flux |P(f,t)−P(f,t−1)| IS the canonical onset strength function. Without spectral flux, onset-strength loses its definitional core.

Excitation signal computation uses frequency-domain division (Y(ω)/H(ω)) to recover the residual in the spectral domain. The fourier transform is the mechanism that enables this frequency-domain computation of the excitation signal.

Chromagram is the practical tool for computing pitch class distribution in practice. It provides the mel-warped frequency bins that get summed into pitch class bins. It is built and maintained for the sake of enabling pitch class analysis.

MFCC computation structurally requires the mel-spectrogram: the algorithm computes the mel-spectrogram via mel-scale filterbank on the power spectrum, takes the log, then applies DCT to produce the final cepstral coefficients. Remove the mel-spectrogram concept and MFCC has no intermediate representation to operate on.

SERVES test (Law 8d: servant→master). language-variety's accepted definition opens: "Language-variety is the analytical genus... its parameters are the level of description at which the variety is carved... Persistence mechanism: the genus persists as an instrument of the discipline." The discipline is sociolinguistics — language-variety is the analytical instrument sociolinguistics uses to sort dialects, idiolects, registers, etc. For whose sake? Sociolinguistics. Direction: language-variety (servant/tool) → sociolinguistics (master/user).
Evenness is a normalized dispersion measure historically derived from the moment framework; coefficient of variation is a standard moment-based statistic.

Law 8b removal test: harmonicity computes H = E_harmonic/(E_harmonic+E_residual) by comparing energy at f0-integer-multiple bins (partial energy) against inter-partial residual energy. This requires the full per-bin power spectrum — the spectral-distribution vector. Remove spectral-distribution (the ordered per-bin energy vector) and there are no E_i values to compute harmonic vs noise energy; harmonicity stops operating.

STFT is a windowed DFT algorithm. Its operative definition is: apply a sliding window to a signal, then compute the DFT of each windowed segment. Without the DFT, the algorithm does not exist — there is no STFT computation independent of DFT. The removal test passes: removing DFT would stop STFT from operating, since STFT literally calls DFT as its core subroutine.,

SERVES test: spectral-band-moment (central moment of energy distribution about the centroid) serves MIR as a shape descriptor. Higher-order moments characterize asymmetry and tail behavior of energy distribution.

Source-filter separation uses cepstral analysis as one of its core decomposition methods: the cepstrum separates the log-spectrum into slowly-varying filter envelope (formants) from rapidly-varying source structure (pitch/periodicity). Without cepstral analysis, the cepstral decomposition method of source-filter separation cannot operate.

Variance IS the second central moment of the spectral-band distribution. The remove-Y test: without the moment framework (central moments about the mean), the computation m2 = Σ(E_i - μ)²Δf cannot be formed. Removing moment stops variance from operating.

Encoding is the process by which information is transformed into a representational format suitable for storage in memory. It is a constitutive component process of the memory system, alongside storage and retrieval.

Spectral flatness = geometric_mean / arithmetic_mean of per-bin energies. Computing this ratio requires access to the per-bin energy vector — the spectral-band-distribution. Without the per-bin values, the flatness ratio cannot be computed.

Pinned sense: spectral-band-bandwidth as dispersion measure derived from second moment. Which-came-first: moment formalism predates bandwidth specialization; bandwidth is a specific instance of the band moment family.

Removal test (Law 8b): linguistic-register's definition carves it as the systematic variation in language use shaped by context — register is the variety of language deployed according to setting, purpose, and participant relationships. Remove language-variety and linguistic-register loses its organizing principle: no framework for the variation it studies. Same structural shape as accepted corpus-linguistics DEPENDS_ON language-variety.

Cepstral-liftering operates by applying a window-like function to cepstral coefficients in the quefrency domain. Its direct operand is the cepstral-coefficients vector — the liftering procedure transforms this sequence by selectively attenuating or accentuating its components. Removing cepstral-coefficients as the input data stops the liftering from operating on anything. The removal test passes.
Spectral-onset computes frame-to-frame difference of power spectrum P[k,t]; removing power spectrum eliminates the input values, so onset cannot operate. Operational removal test satisfied.
Spectral-band-variance is the second central moment of the band distribution, a direct specialization of the general moment concept. Historically and mathematically derived from moment framework.

Crest factor = max(|A_i|) / RMS(|A_i|) within a band. The numerator is the peak amplitude of the spectral-band-distribution. Removing the concept of peak removes the ability to identify the maximum amplitude value, making crest-factor incomputable. RMS dependency already established by Seth; peak completes the structural requirement. Removal test: without peak, crest-factor has no numerator and ceases to operate.
Band-smoothness is a scalar descriptor of energy continuity within a sub-band.

A mel-frequency-scaled representation is obtained by transforming a power spectrum onto the mel-frequency scale. Remove the concept of power spectrum and there is no spectral energy data to apply the mel-scale transformation to — the concept collapses without its input domain.

Spectral-band-skewness = third standardized moment of band energy distribution. Built for the sake of timbre characterization.

Crest factor (peak/RMS) computationally derives from spectral moments: RMS = √(m₂) where m₂ is the second moment of the spectral distribution. The crest-factor formula = peak/√(m₂), making the moment calculation its historical/computational source.

Cepstral-envelope captures the vocal tract characteristic (formant structure, spectral tilt) by extracting low-quefrency coefficients. It serves speech-processing by providing a compact representation of vocal tract shape for recognition, enhancement, and synthesis.

The definition states the construct computes the real cepstrum of a windowed frame. Removing logarithm would stop the cepstrum computation, which stops cepstral-peak-picking from operating.
